tei:div.tei:p: ༈ñtsa7༄khyalhud ṣṭha 111/nyakhri skatso 9ḍa/ /rtosmo rmazoyo olha lornye1
khro/ ོ྅oṃñtsa khokhye1sko6o4྅)kuho:slo/tshechokṣa111 6255tsu('jam dbyangs bla ma ngag dbang bkra shis dpa/'a bzang po'i rnam dpar thar ba)

rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhabs la sgo gsu ma gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o//tshe rabs thams cad du brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas rjes su bzung du gsol/ rab dkar chu shel dkyil 'khor yongs gang ji bzhin gzugs sku'i mdzes sdug cha shas rdzogs/ /rab 'byams rgyu skar do zhal dang mtshungs pad dkar chun 'phyang rin chen rgyan gyis spud/ /rab mdzes dkyus ring zur mda' 'phangs pas rmongs pa'i sbub 'byed ye shes snang bas rtsecha// /rab snyan dri za'i phang 'gro phyag sor rtser 'khrol dbyangs can lha kye ngag mchog stsol/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum g.yo med chos sku'i ngang las thugs rje rtag 'gros yongs rdzogs/ bshes gnyen mchog gi rol bar shar/ /phan dang bde ba'i rtsa lag thub bstan padmo'i gnyen gcig lung rtogs 'od zer stong 'bar gdul bya gling bzhi'i dpal du gyur/ /'chad dang rtsom pa'i —bdud rtsi'i zegs mas skal ldan yongs kyi nyes pa'i tsha gdungs rab bcil mchog gi zhi la rnam par bkod/ /rgyal dang de sras yongs kyi 106

mdzad bzang ma lus khyod 'ba' zhig gis bdag gir byas pas nor 'dzin rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod/ /mchog kun gcig bsdus gzugs sku'i dpal mnga' zhing / /zhing mang mgon gyur khyab bdag dam pa gang / /gang 'tsham mdzad pa'i 'phrul la rgyal kun yang / /yang dag gzigs pa mi rdzogs mkha' mtha' bzhin/ /rnam dag tshul khrims dri bsung phyogs bcur 'phro/ /mang thos rig pa'i nyin byed 'od gzi bkra/ /rab brtan ting 'dzin ro mchog ci dgar rol/ /legs gsung bdud rtsi'i sgo brgya rab tu phye/ /mkha' la dgu tshigs 'khyud pa bzhin/ /khyod thugs brtse bas rtag tu bcings/ /bu sdug ma yis skyongs pa bzhin/ /khyod kyis 'gro 'di rtag tu bskyangs/ /chu gter hub kyis 'jal ba dang / /mkha' mtha' bye'us tshol ba ltar/ /mgon po khyod kyi rnam thar yang / /bdag lta byis blos spyod yul ci/ /'on kyang dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /dpyad gsum dag pas legs sbyangs ba/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi dbang rgyal mchog /bkod de kun bzang mchod sprin spro/ /gting zab yangs pa'i chu gter las/ /rnyog bral ro mchog brgyad ldan chab/ /cung zad thos pa'i snyim pa ru/ /thog ste 107

dga' ba'i gar bgyid do/ /kunda'i tshal la zla zer dang / /gtsug phud can la dbyar rnga bzhin/ /skal ldan snying la dam pa yi/ /mdzad pas rab dgalwa cis mi skyed/ /de la dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi gsang gsum ma lus pa'i ngo bo nyes pa'i sa bon dang bcas pa drungs phyung ste spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi lus rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa rig dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dam par gyur kyang ring nas bdag pos gzhan gces pa'i snying rje chen po'i mdza' bo dang rtag tu 'grogs pa'i gshis kyis/ ris med pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag yongs su 'dren pa la mchog tu gzhol ba/ dpal ldan bla ma bka' drin mtshungs med khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i dpal zhes/snyan pa/'i rnga gsang 'og min gyi bar du grags shing bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu ma lus ba'i gtsug gi cod pan la zhabs kyi padmo ngal gso bgyid pa de nyid gyi rnam par thar ba thun mong du grags shing bdag blos dpog pa cung zad cig 'dir brjod par bya'o/ /de yang chos kyi rje 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ mdo khams smad kyi sa'i cha reb gong du grags pa sa kur dge gsum gyi 108

mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs kyis bcag byin gyis brlabs pa'i yul/khyad par du lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgru ba gnas tan tig shepa gyi yeng dgon dang nye zhing bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'phel bzhin pa'i gnas/ bla chen po dang rong bo'i grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs kyi 'khrungs yul/ dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i gnas bdag su gu bya khyung gi nye 'dab nya lung zhes bya ba'o/ /rigs ni dpon rigs/ gdung rus ni bod kyi rus chen bzhir gyes ba'i ya gyal bse/ yab rin chen skyabs dang / yum rong bo dge ring za snying mo byams zhes bya ba/ yab yum gnyis ka yang / dad gzhi che zhing ya rabs kyi spyod tshul la gnas pa ste/ des shing rnam dkar la brtson pa/ gtong phod che zhing blo rno ba sogs yon tan du ma'i mdzes zhes thos so/ /des/ na sgrib thog mi mnga' ba'i ye shes kyi spyan ras gzigs pa lnga yi tshul du yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su chas te/ mngal du gnas pa na yum sku bde zhing dge la spro ba dang rmi lam dge ba rmi ba sogs ya mtshan gyi dga' ston du ma mngon du gyur to/ /sgyu 'phrul lhums su/ don 'grub dang / /a chos mngal du kun snying bzhin/ /bag 109

yod mdzes ma mngal khur gyi/ /sim pa'i dga' ston ci yang myong / /de ltar zla ba tshang nas yum la gnod pa med cing bde ba'i ngang du dus gyi pho nya zhes pa sa pho rta la nye bar bltams so/ /de ltar sku 'khrungs snga na bsod nams rlabs po che'i 'o mtsho brtse ba'i byed po dang legs smon nye dbang zung gis ma da ra yi srub shing gis bsrubs pa las mdzes shing lta na sdug pa thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba'i khye'u'i zla tshes gsar pa zhig bskrun pa ni 'di lta ste/ srid 'byor rmi lam bslu brid dong / /rang zhi mnar med me lta bur/ /gzigs phyir zhi la mi gnas shing / /srid par skye ba brgyud mar 'dzin/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mos rjes 'gro ba'i/ /yum mchog mngal gyi sprin rum nas/ /legs par thon pa'i rta ljang can/ /thub bstan padma'i gnyen gcig shar/ /chu skyes chu yi gos min ltar/ /mngal skyes mngal gyi skyon bral ba/ /yid 'ong yid 'phrog mtshan ldan sku/ /mig du mig gi bdud rtsi byung / /de lta bu'i khye'u de nyid kyi sku ni drang zhing rgyas la chu zhing gab pa/ pags pa'i mdog ni dkar zhing dag la dbu gdugs ltar mdzes pa/ dpral pa'i dbyes che zhing smin ma 'byar la shangs kyi gzengs 1 10

mtho zhing rim par 'tsham pa/ snyan shal ring du 'phyang zhing sku lus skabs phyed pa/ dbang po yongs su gsal la spyan gyi dkar nag ma 'dres shing mchog tu mdzes pa/ 'jig rten phal las 'das shing lta bas mi ngoms pa zhig go zhes nye ba'i skye bo thams cad ya mtshan gyi dpal la spyod par gyur to/ /de nas sku'i na tshod cher ma smin pa'i byis pa'i rol rtsed mdzad pa'i tshe na yang ring nas yongs su goms pa'i bag chags brtas pa'i stobs kyis stegs 'ga' zhig gi steng du nan tan gyis 'dzeg ste/ khri la bzhugs pa'i tshul ltar mdzad nas phyogs phyogs su bkra shis brjod pa'i rnam pa'i dbyig 'dzin gyi bye ma sogs ci rigs phyag tu thog te 'thor par mdzad pa dngaka skabs skabs su byis pa mang po la chos gsung ba lta bu'i rnam pa dang / yang skabs 'ga' zhig tu rdo dang bong ba sogs gral ltar bsgrig te/gnas brtan bcu drug yin zhes de dag la mchod pa 'bul ba dang /phyag dang skor ba mdzad pa la sogs pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba gzhan gyi blo las 'das ba'i rtsed 'jo 'ba' zhig las byis pa phal ba'i spyod tshul las ring du gyur zhes thos so/ /'khrungs pa'i tshe rtsis mkhan 111

— mkhas pa zhig gis ser gos gyon zhing / tshe dbang mang po bskur dgos zer ba ltar na bza' ser po gyon/ phyis su na bza' dkar po bzo zhes lab na ma dga' de mi gyon gsung nas gyon ma myong / lo de nas lo dgu'i bar du dbal shul bla rgan zer ba'i ri khrod pa zhig gis zla re'i nang la tshe dbang gcig gnyis re 'chag med du bskur/nyin gcig bla rgan gyis bum pa'i mchu nas ljang bu ngo mtshar ba zhig skyes 'dug pa yab la bstan nas/ de phyin chad bande la cham pa yang mi 'ong zhes bshad pa ltar/ de'i sngon la bar bar du sku cung zad mi bde bar yod kyang de nas sang song ngo/ /brda' legs par shes pa nas sa rdo sogs kyis mtshon pa'i chos gang gzigs kyang 'di la ming 'di zhes phar btags pa tsam las mi 'dug snyam du ngang gi 'byung ba cig yod gsung ba ni/ tshul bstan la'ang sngon gyi dbu ma'i lta ba ma bsnyel bar yod gsung ba yin par snang / dge slong rgyal mtshan dang lhun grub zer ba gnyis la klog slob bcug pa na/ g.yeng ba med par shin tu 'dun pas klog slob pa sogs la yang dka' tshegs med cing /skyen par shin tu byang byang ba lta bu'i legs par thugs su chud par 112

gyur to/ /na tshod sbubs rgya ma grol kyang / /zab don dbyings su 'dzer ba yi/ /ka la ping ku'i phru gu zhig /rnam mang chos kyi rtsed 'jo rog /de nas sku na cung zad smin pa'i dgung lo drug la khrag skyug ces pa chu phag la/ mkhar gong ba rigs pa'i dbang phyug brtan mkhas gnyis ldan nye bar 'khor lta bu'i 'dul 'dzin bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ srid gsum sgyu ma'i grong khyer ltar gzigs pas gcig tu sgrub pa la gzhol ba/ tshe brtan rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du bstan pa'i sgor thog mar zhugs shing rab tu byung ste ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bzhes pa na/ sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dpal zhes mtshan gsol to/ /khyod kyi sras 'di dbus phyogs su slob gnyer rdzong thabs byas na rang gzhan la phan thog 'ong zhes gsung ngo / /yab kyis skabs re la phyugs rdzi la mngags dus grogs po rnams grwal tu bsgrigs bcug nas khong rang gis kho bo ma ṇi ba yin zer zhing ma ṇi bskul bar mdzad do/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs sen nor bu rtag du spyi bor bcings pa'i bag chags legs par sad/ sngon sbyangs 113

bsnyel ba med pas byis pa'i gnas skabs nyid nas chos rnams ming rkyang tsam du gzigs/ /rtag tu bag yod du ku la gyon ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod 'dza' lcug dam por 'khyud/ /mtha' yas tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs kyang bla gos gsar ba'i rgyal mtshan la yang dgyes/ /na tshod chung yang rgan po'i blo/ /gtsug lag ma bslab mkhas pa'i rtse/ /bstan la gsar zhugs gnas brtan che/ /'dod la yid 'byung srid la chags/ /'khor ba dug sbrul gdug pa'i tshang / /srid 'byor mi bzad ha la dang / /mdza' bshes sgyu ma'i srin po las/ /bros te tshangs spyod dga' tshal snyegs/ /brtul zhugs lo brgyar goms pa'i dge slong gi /tshul lugs ma goms ngang gis byung ba 'di/ /khyod kyi gzhan las phrogs te bsnams pa'am/ /yang na mes pos sprul bar gor ma chags//de nas dgung lo bcu ba rab byung me yos la sngar gyi mkhan po nyid kyi drung du slob dpon zhus te/ tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par bzhes nas blang 'das so drug gi 'jug ldog ma nor bar mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrungs bar mdzad do/ /de nas rje rang gi khu bo bse'i rab 'byams pa khu dpon o lod kyis bkur ste/— 114

sog yul 'bal na gnas pa'i sar dgung lo bco lnga ba drag po lcags sprel la rje 'di phebs/ ston dgun la der bzhugs/ de'i tshe rje 'di'i thugs la mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ni gting zab/ skye ba dang 'chi ba ni chad pa med par lu gu ma brgyud du 'byung / byis pa'i skye bo dang 'grogs pa ni zang zing 'bod pa'i g.yab mor go/ dal 'byor gyi rten rin po che ni don gnyis kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i grur gzigs/ mdza' bshes kyi dung sems dang chos brgyad ni mi bzad pa'i gzeb tu mthong zhing / thos bsam/ gyi gru gzings la zhugs bshes gnyen ded dpon brten te/ don gnyis kyi nor bu blangs nas/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i re skong du gyur na ci ma rung snyam du mang thos kyi nor la sred pas thugs rab tu 'phrog go snyam du sems so/ /dpag yas rgyan ldan 'og min gzhal yas su/ /theg chen chos kyi longs spyod rdzosas pa zhig /zhing 'dir rgyal sras dpa' bor chos tshol tshul/ /gsal phyir byon nam yang na sgra dbyangs sras/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi chos rgyun ting 'dzin las/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas chos 'chad thos pa rdzun/ /bden na rgyal sras 'di yi chos tshol phyir/ /yid 115

la gdung ba 'di tsam skyed ci dgos/ /de lta bu'i dam chos tshol blo ni rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung gi rgyun ltar 'jug pa'i ngang la bza' ba dang bca' ba btung ba la sogs pa 'dod yon la sred pa 'jug pa'i go skabs ni bcom/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa dag gi yon tan dang / dge ba'i gshes gnyen bzang po'i yon tan gyi rgyu skar phreng ba'i snang brnyan rnams yid kyi dpal du shar ba ni nam yang g.yo ba med/ bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs su skyes chen dam pa'i nyi ma rim byon gyis bstan pa'i pad tshal rnam par phye bas grags snyan gyi yid drangs pas/ dgung lo bcu drug pa dpal gdong zhes pa chu bya la gya nom pa'i dgos chas khal rta bzhon pa bzang po'i skyes dang bcas te yab dang bsdebs nas dbus phyogs su phebs pa'i lam skabs su yang / rje 'di thugs skyo shas las ma g.yos pa'i gshis kyis/ lam gyi gnas bdag rnams la dam bca' phul te/ kho bo dbus phyogs nas rang gzhan la phan thog nges kyi yon tan zhig ma byung bar rang yul du logs pa na khyed kyis tshar chod ces drag tu bcol lo/ /lo de'i ston ga dbus phyogs su slebs nas/ yab 116

rang yul du ldog skabs ban chung sems sdug e yod snyam nas/ khyod kyis chos legs par slob/ nga rang yul du 'gro rgyu yin byas pas/ban chung na re/ nga chos yul 'dir bsdad na khyod kyang skyid nga rang yang skyid zer/ yab yong khar ban chung gis rab gsal nas yab la bltas te khyod yul du bde mor slebs zer/ de ma thag la dus snga ba de nyid du mkhas grub bye bas rol mtsho bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'dzam bu prikṣas mdzes ba'i gling gi rgyan gcig pu dpa'/ ldan 'bras spungs phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi grwa tshang phan tshun zhes pa'i ya gyal/ rigs pa smra ba'i 'jug ngogs zla dang bral ba bkra shis sgo mang gi dpon slob las thogs pa sog po rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i mkhas pa chen po/ rgyal sras thub pa'i zhal 'tshab che tshugs 'byor dregs skyungs shing / dam pa las legs bshad snyan rgyud spyod pa la ngoms pa mi mnga' ba dpon slob don 'grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi padmo 'a gtugs te/ ston chos gnyis bar bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag thog mar mnos shing chos grwar phebs pa na/ yun mi ring bar bsgro gling legs par mdzad thub pa byung / de dus dbu ma 'jug pa 117

thugs 'dzin mdzad pas/ de'i nang gi phyogs sde'i 'dod tshul dang zla bas de 'gog byed kyi gzhung dang rigs pa 'di lta bu'o snyam du thugs la dgongs pa rnams/ phyis su rje rin po che 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal dang bsdur ba'i tshe sngar gyi dgongs tshul ji lta ba bzhin 'dug gsung ngo/ /chos thog 'ga' la sgo mang gi chos grwar phebs/ de skabs sngon gyi bag chags kyis bskul bas/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gnyis kyi tshad ma'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs 'dod skom pa'i chu 'dod pa lta bu dang / stag tshang rā ba stod pa'i snyan grags kyi lcags kyus yid drangs te/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa dngos po zhes pa shing khyi la rwa bstod du phebs/ lo phyed bcas zung du 'dzin grwa gsum gyi tshig bzhag rgyun du thugs 'dzin gnang / zhor la grwa tshang de'i 'grig lam dang dbyangs 'don rta tshig bzhag rgyas bsdus ji ltar byed tshul rnams rang shugs kyis thugs la bcags pa cig byung gsung /de dus na grwa tshang de'i mkhas mang ri skyes dbus su 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ro bsgrags pas/ rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog du gyur to/ /de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa na tshod ldan zhes pa shing phag la bkra shis 118

sgo mang du slar phebs/ mkhas zhing btsun la bzang ba zhi dang dul ba'i dpal mnga' dpon slob 'od zer rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du bsdus tshan 'ga' zhig sogs gsan 'dug kyang / lo 'di dag gi rnam thar zhib par ma nges/ rje 'di'i 'dzin grwa la phar phyin skabs brgyad pa'i bar yongs rdzogs gnang ba'i/ phar phyin gyi rgyugs ring gangs can gyi mgon po rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs drung du phul bas/ rgyal ༄ba rin po che sku gzhogs nas dgyes pa'i gsung gis legs par bsngags shing sku gzan ja sug sogs dngos po'i gnang cha gang rgyas mdzad/ de dus rje 'di'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang rdo rje dge rgan la bsten nas khas len legs par dris shing / dpon slob gyi mdun nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung dang / sgo mang gi tshogs dang chos grwa'i zhal 'don rnams kyi lung yang gas/na/ phar phyin gyi zur khol rnams dang gser phreng rnams bshad sogs rang gzhan gyi yig cha mang po la gzigs nas zhib dpyod mdzad pas tshig don lhag ma med par thugs su chud do/ / thugs gnyer gyi skabs de dag tu nyin chos grwa nas rtsod pa 'ba' zhig 119

mdzad cing / mtshan khor yug tu res tshig bzhag skyor bas nam zad thal la 'gro/ res ltung bshags dang sbrags pa'i phyag mdzad de nam zad thal gyis gtong ba'i tshul de kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad ces thos/ ltung bshags sgos phyag mdzad dus tshig dal bus lha rnams kyi sku gzugs dang phyag mtshan rnams gsal bor 'char bcug nas phyag gnang —/4 phyag de ltar mdzad pa'i grags pa ni klu 'bum khang tshan dang der nye ba'i khang tshan gzhan rnams kyi grwa thog phyi cha/'i dus su ya nga brjod kyin 'dug /na bza' dang chas ga bzhan gyi grwa bsgrigs lta ci smos/ tha na na bza'i grwal 'tshem yang mi gnang / gsol ja sro ba tsam gyi g.yeng ba med par tshogs/ chos grwar phebs pa da nga / 'dzin gathar sbyangs kho nas dus 'da' bar byed cing zhabs rjem la yun ring phebs pa/sa zhabs la ser kha chen po byung ba nas /brag 'dzag pa mthong zhes bdag gi khu bo dka' bcu las thos so/ /chos grwar zhugs nas yu na ring po ma lon pa'i skabs shig dpa' ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang 'bras spungs su phebs pa mthong nas yid phrogs te/ yon tan ga'an ma byung yang rgyud pa'i phyag bde cig byed rgyu byung na de mab/ 'tshengs 120

snyam pa byung / de'i tshe sku zla zhig yod pa la de 'dra'i bsam pa byung bas da nas rgyud la phebs 'dod ces gros btab pa la kho na re da dung rgyud la phebs ma ran/ mtshan nyid legs par sbyangs te/ de rjes rgyud la phebs na bzang zhes bkod pa bzang po'i sgo nas bzlog pa de shin tu legs byung / zla bo de'i nged la de dus phan bzang po btags/ nges 'byung spu sud thar ba'i srog gcod/ zer ba de ka yin 'dug gsung ngo / /dpon slob de'i zhabs drung nas dbu ma'i sems bskyed dang po gsan/ de'i tshe nyi thang bas dbu ma'i zur khol/stag lung grags pa'i dbu ma rnams thugs 'dzin mdzad cing zhib dpyod gnang/ de dus 'tsho bzhi ba blo bzang dar rgyas kyi sku zla byas te gso/la chas sogs bsgrigs pa'i zhabs zhu phur thag byung/ de nas bzung de'i yun ring la zhabs zhu byas/ kho bos gsol ja sogs sta gon byas na bzhes pa ma gtogs/ rje rang la nyams snang yang med ces de dag las thos so / /skabs shig bsnyung gzhi drag pos thebs nas chos mthun gyi rim gro cher byas kyang ma sos pas/ grogs rnams yid chad 'dug/ /nga rang la shi na 'gyod pa gzhan mi 'dug /skye ba 121

'di la bsnyen rdzogs cig ma byas par shi na dal 'byor chud zos la song snyam du thugs shin tu de la 'phreng bas/ da res 'di las thar rgyu zhig byung na de ma thag bsnyen rdzogs byed dgos snyam du dam bcas/de dus zla bo rnams kyis na tsha 'di 'dra'i tshad la slebs kyang bsnyen rdzogs la 'di ltarasims 'phreng ba ngo mtshar che zhes/ rong bo'i grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sprul sku ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho de dus dbus su phebs yod pa la/ grogs rnams kyis de lugs kyi zhu ba phul bas/ sprul sku rin po ches chos gos legs pa gcig gnang /mtshan dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis zhes btags 'dug grogs po rnams kyis de'i tshe dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis zhes 'bod pa gsan pas thugs la spro ba skyes/ de'i tshe zla bo gcig gis kha dar legs pa cig bzung nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku phyogs la skyabs 'jug zhu gin dge 'phel du song nas/ nye gnas dang phrad de rgyu mtshan rnams bshad pas/ nye gnas kyi da lta sku mtshams gnang yod/ da dung thun mtshams su ma slebs mdun du 'gro mi rung zhes skrags bzhin du sku mdun du song ba na/ bka' bkyon ma mdzad par ༷ 122

ci la 'ong ba'i brda' mdzad pa la nye gnas kyis klu 'bum gyi grwa ba tshul mthun pa ngag dbang bkra shis zer ba zhig bsnyung gzhi drag pos thebs yod pa la/ sku phyogs la bum chu dang skyabs 'jug zhu gin grwa ba gcig yong 'dug zhes kha btags phul bas/ zhag ma gcig la skyid sdug ci byung yang bla ma dkon ma chog ma yin pa'i re sa gzhan med pas de ltar dang / chos dang mthun pa'i rim gro byas na/ 'di nas kyang sems la 'dzi na gsung / bum chu phyag mdud dang bcas pa gnang /nye gnas shin tu dga' zhing ha las nas/ khyod kyi grwa ba de la skyon mi 'dug nyin dus mdun du thun gnang skabs song phyin bka' bkyon las 'os med kyang / de ring gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gsung bzang po byung zer dga' tshor byed kyin 'dug /grogs de 'ong dus rje dran med lta bur song yod pa la de dus zla bo rnams kyi da ni srog dbugs 'gags par thag chod snyam nas gzims mal spos te bzhag /de'i tshe rje khong rang gi thugs dgongs la yang khong gcig pur yul gzhan zhig tu 'gro gyin (yod pa la mi gcig gis 'gram lcag cig byas te khyod gar 'gro rgyu yin zer ba 'dra ba cig byung bas/ slar yang thugs dran 123

med du gyur pa sangs pa na sngar gyi mal med par khang ba'i gru zhig na 'dug gsung grogs rnams kyi de dus bum chu zha'/ du blug phyag 'dud mgul du bcings pas/ thugs dran pa gsal byung na grogs des sngar gyi rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bsgrags pas/ gong gi thugs la dad pa dang dga' ba'i dbyar mtsho byur bur 'phyur ba ni rab dga' la 'gran par gyur/ de nas gsung ltar bsgrubs pa'i skabs su slang yang rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis grags rgyal ma la lung bstan cig zhus zhes gsung phebs pa ltar/ bstan srungs chen mo rdo rje grags rgyal ma la lung bstan zhus pas sgo mang chos grwa'i seng gdong ma'i zhal na mnan pa yod/ de thon la seng gdong ma'i zlog pa gyis gesung ba ltar der bltas pas/ seng gdong ma'i zhal na mtshan byang dbu zhwa'i drag lhan cung zad dang bcas pa mnan yod pa bton nas/ rje rang gis bsnyen pa mdzad pas ring po ma 'gyangs par bsnyun lhag ma med par grol/ phyis su rtser phebs nas nged kyis rje bzhad pa'i gsol dpon byas yod skabs zhig nged la cher bkyon nas ngas khyod bar do nas phyir la khrid 'ong ba yin gsung ba nges par 124

thugs mad 'dug gsung ngo / /de ni rje dang grwa thog dang khang tshan gcig pa slob rab yod pa lhag tu dbu ma'i lta ba la yang 'phrig cung zad chud pa 'dra snyam pa cig yod pa de'i/ sngon gyi bag chags ngan pa'i zug rngu ni lang / rje 'di'i mkhas grags kyi dpal la sdang ba'i phrag dog gi rlung dmar ni 'tshub/ gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor gyi dug chus ni yid myos/ nag phyogs yid srubs kyi dpung mang dang ni bsdebs pas rkyen las byung ba yin 'dug kyang / 'jam dpal zhi khro dang gnyis su med pa'i rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyi thugs rje dang / bstan srungs chen mo gzigs ldan 'bar ma co/ga/sa chos skyongs rnams kyi 'phrin las kyis glags ma rnyed do/ /kho rang 'a// ji 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra nyid du gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngar yin na bstan 'gror phan thog can gcis 'ong rgyu la/ yul gnyan po la bsam sbyor ngan pa'i 'bras bu myur du smin te/ lta ba sogs ci smos mkhas pa'i gral dang mthar thug gi don la rgyab kyis phyogs shing / 'di snang dang lto chog la gcig tu zhen nas tshe ril po don med du rnam g.yeng dang bag med kyi rnal 125

'byor la brtson pa cig byung snang / skabs shig se ra byang 'dren pa zhes pa rigs sngags 'chang gi rdo rje slob dpon ra/tshan nyid dang ldan pa de'i zhabs drung du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chen gsan nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor gsar du 'jug pa'i tshul gnang / slob dpon de'i drung nas mgon po'ibaka' bcu gsum yang gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu ba dbang phyug/ ces pa me glang la dge 'dun nyi shu'i tshogs lang bzhag pa na / blo gsal bgrod pa'i thems skas thugs 'dzin dang zhib dpyod mdzad pas rje rin po che 'i dgongs pa ltar thugs nges 'drongs/ gakhya/na yig cha mang por gzigs rtog mdzad pas de dus grwa thog de na dge 'dun nyi shu la nga las lhag mi 'dug gsung / rigs grwa'i tshogs 'a nga gnang dus blo gsal gling gi dge bshes gcig sku zla yin kyang de nyid spobs pa med par lung rigs kyis tshar bcad de/ mkhas grags kyis sa steng khyab po/ /dgung lo nyer gsum pa rnam gnon zhes pa lcags 'brug la/dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum bshes gnyen dam pa 'i gzugs su nye bar bstan pa/ rnam dag tshul khrims gser gyi gzhi la mdo rgyud 126

mang thos rnam dpyod kyi chu klong 'khyil zhing / bdag bas gzhan gces kyi rin chen khams las grub pa 'i/ rab brtan bskyed rim kyi rtsa ba lhun chags la/ rnal 'byor ba'i yi bang rim mngon par bkra zhing sku gsum lha dbang gi grong khyer rtse ru 'dzin pa'i/ yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zla bral gyi ri dbang / bkra shis sgo mang gi mkhas mang gling bzhi'i dpal du lham mer bzhugs pa'i dga' ston glu dbyangs kyis sa gsum khyab pa de yi tshe/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyi mdun du sngar gyi dbu ma'i 'phro gas/na te thal ldo ga rigs ma nga po dang / lhag par rnam bshad dbongs pa rab gsal stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed rtsa shes ṭika chen sogs rje yab sras kyi gsung rab dang / dbu ma rigs tshogs drug bud bha ba li ta/ tshig gas/la 'phags pa yab sras kyi gsung rab la rgyun du gzigs rtog mdzad cing / rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas nyid kyi dbu ma'i thal phreng si tshig bzhag gi skyor dpon mdzad de/ thugs 'dzin gnang / thal ldog ga'an mang po yang thugs 'dzin mdzad/ rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du dri gtugs yang yang mdzad pas bla ma'i sku 127

phyogs rab tu dgyes nas zhib tu khrid/ skabs shig da ni 'di las lhag go rgyu mi 'dug dpyad pa rdzogs snyam pa shar/ rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du de skad zhus pa las/ de ltar yin gsung byung ngo/ /thang cig dbyangs can ma la bsnyen pa mdzad pas skabs su rmi lam du rgya gar gyi yul du song nas na lend+ra la slebs pa'i/ lha sa'i ra mo che 'dra ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig 'dug de gang yin zhes mi gcig la dris pas/ mgon po klu sgrub bzhugs sa yin zer/ klu sgrub da dung bzhugs sam ces dris pas bzhugs zer/ sems la dga' ba dpag tu med pa skyes te nga la mjal kha dgos zhes bshad pas/ shog dang mjal kha yong zer/ gtsug lag khang de la g.yon ngos nas shar sgo la song ba'i sgo rim pa mang po 'dug /nga'i sems la sgo de dag gi phug na mgon po klu sgrub sku na shin tu bgres la dbu lo se tshub be yod pa nab bza' dkar po phu dung can rnying se ba nab pa gcig yod snyam pa 'char/ de'i sgo rim pa 'ga' zhig brtol nas nang la slebs pa'i dar gyi yol ba zhig 'dug pa'i 'di'i phug na klu sgrub bzhugs/ da res khyod la mjal kha mi yong zer/ rmi lam de rje bzhad pa'i zhabs /28

drung du zhus pas bzang gi klu sgrub kyi chos dngos su da lta yod pa dang 'phrad pa'i rtags yin/ zhal dngos su ma mjal pa ni/ lta ba mngon sum du skye ba 'di la mthong mi thob pa yin gsung / de la sems mi dga' ba byas/ rje'i zhal nas skye ba 'di la mngon sum du ci ltar mthong / khyod theg dman lam du 'gro na ma gtogs theg chen gyi mthong lam thob pa la/ bskal chen grangs med cig dgos las che gsung / de nas bdag 'gog thugs 'dzin mdzad skabs thugs la 'jigs snang 'dra cig yod pa la thugs skyo ba dang thugs la dpe med pa na ba byung / zhal las gzhan ni ma shes lta ba ni tshe snga ma'i sbyangs stobs yin mod bsam gi gsung ngo / /dgung lo nyer bzhi ba khyu mchog ces pa lcags sbrul la rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas lam rim chen mo'i gzab bshad lung dang bcas pa gsan/ dbu ma la gsar du slob dgos rgyu cher med na'ang bstan pa'i snying po 'khor ba'i nyes skyon sel ba'i bdud rtsi/ thar lam gyi srog dam pa gcig pu'o zhes skal ldan rnams la 'doms par bya ba'i phyir slar yang dbu ma'i 'dzin grwa la zhugs te snga phyir dbu ma tshar gnyis gsan sbyongs mdzad/129

dgung lo nyer lnga pa sna tshogs ces pa chu rta'i lo hor zla bcu ba'i yar ngo'i dga' ba gnyis pa chos drug la nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun mtshungs med 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyis mkhan po gnang / pra nye'i dge bshes ngag dbang gis las slob dang / gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang rdo rjes gsang ston byas/ kha skong gi dge bshes rnams dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs te/ bslab pa la nan gyis bslab cing / rtsa ltung dang lhag ma bcu gsum po gang gis ma gos pa cig cis kyang bya'o zhes yi dam brtan po byas/ bla ma dkon mchog la gso‘ ba btab tshogs bsags/ sgrib sbyongs la 'bad pas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug si/ dus thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi dgags bya lhag ma med par blo ngor khegs/ nas/ bdag med la go ba bzang po dga' 'jigs kyi nyams dang bcas te shar bas/ sems la dga' bde sngar nam yang myang ma myong ba dbul bo gter rnyed pa dang 'dra ba skyes/ de'i stobs kyis nga zhes bya ming skam po tsam du go mi dge ba la rang shugs kyis skrags 130

cing / rnyed bkur la sems kyi gting nas 'dod pa mi skyel/ dam pa'i chos la shes 'dod dang 'dzin 'dod sngar las che ba gcig byung gsung ngo / /bsnyen par rdzogs pa nas mya ngan las 'da' kha'i bar la sku chings bkrol ba dang glos phabs nas gzims pa gang yang ma myong gsung zhing / mtshan mo gzims dus kyang tsog pu 'ba' zhig la gzims pa'i sbyangs yon gnas pa mthong / mdor na bzhengs bzhugs phebs lugs spyan gyis gzigs lugs na bza' dang gsol ba bzhes lugs thams cad tshul mthun kho na dang / rgyun par lhung bzed du gro gso la zhing / myos 'gyur gyi rigs gsil ba lta ci/ rab tu byung ba gzhan gyis btungs ba gzigs na'ang mi dgyes zhing / phyi dres kha zas dang / tha na rung chu 'debs pa sogs bcas rkyang phra mo la ya nga mi 'gal bar mdzad pa mthun snang du grub la/ sku tshe 98dir de ltar mdzad par ma zad tshul khrims rnam dag gi rten skye ba du mar brgyud pa'i 'bras rtags5 / tshul khrims kyi dri bsung dpag med du 'phro bas / spya na sngar 'khod pa thams cad kyi dri 'dzin mcho ga tu rtas pa'i dga' ston la spyod pa ya nga / zhal mngon sum du mjal myong ba thams 131

cad kyis mthun grub po/ /zhal las snyigs dus kyi dge slong gcig gis bslab pa bsrungs tshul la ngas bsrung tshul 'di nga rang la thug ni yin/ bslab pa legs par bsrungs pas dbus na yang gzhan gyis nga la rtsis che che byed/ da lta phyogs phyogs na bslab pa bsrung tshul la bltas na sems skyo gi gsung / da lta sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams phra mo las kyang 'da' bar mi mdzad cing / spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin du gces par skyongs pa la brtson pa ni thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad pa'i tshul 'di gcig pus kyang / snyigs ma'i dus kyi mtha' 'khob kyi 'gro ba'i rtsa lag dang bka' drin zla med pa bsdu bzhi'i thabs mkhas mchog tu khums so/ /rgya mtsho ro dang lhan gcig tu/ /skad cig lhag la gnas srid kyi/ /khyod kyi thugs ni nyes ltung dang / /skad cig 'grogs pa'i go skabs bcom/ /phun tshogs dge legs 'dzin ma tshul khrims kyi/ /phun tshogs dpal ni rdzogs par longs spyod cing / /phun tshogs rnam dpyod lus mdzes bzhin gsal bas/ /phun tshogs 'khor gyi gdungs sel re ba'ang skong / /lhan skyes dri bsung sprin dkrigs ma la ya/ /dpag bsam 'dod 'jo skyedagur snyoms sems ldan/ /yid 132

'phrog mdangs gsal dbang po yongs dag cing / /bag phebs rgyun du khyod kyi dpe zlar 'os/ /tsha grang ngal dub mi mnga' zhing / /bkres skom gnyid rmug rgyang dor nas/ /nyin mtshan 'khor yug 'da' ba khyod/ /lus kyi mdza' ba mi dgongs sam/ /lus srog ltos med brtson 'grus kyis/ /sher phyin tshol ba'i snying stobs can/ /khyod ni sgra dbyangs sras po'am/ /seng bzang gang yin 'phyang mo nyug /dam pa'i rgyan bzang gtsug na mdzes/ /legs bshad 'jug ngogs rna ba yangs/ /thos pa'i ngoms med 'dun pa 'gyu/ /bdag nyid g.yang skyur ma rnams 'khur/ /e ma ngo mtshar yon tan gyi/ /gang bu khyod kyi yod tan cha/ /phra rab tsam gyi yon tan ni/ /bskal bar brjod nus yon tan gang / /skabs shig rje bzhad pa'i drung nas bslab btus gsan/dgung lo nyer drug pa nyi ma zhes pa chu lug la rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas/ lam rim dang lam khrid bde lam gser gyi yang zhun 'jam dpal zhal lung rnams gsan/ lam khrid sems bskyed lta khrid dang bcas pa gang rgyas su gsan pas go ba khyad par can thugs la /33 ༷

'khrungs/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas gca nga la phebs skabs tshogs gtam gnang / khyed dbu ma'i 'dzin grwa ba rnams kyis rgyal dbang gi dbu ma'i smad cha zungs/ rjes sor nga rang la rgyugs 'bul dgos gsung ba na/ rje 'di'i thugs la 'dzin na rje bzhad pa'i dbu rma / 'dzin dgos dgongs te dbu ma'i smad cha dang dbu ma'i stod cha sems skyed gsum pa'i bar du thugs 'dzin mdzad/ lo phyi ma tshogs gtam gnang ngas khyed tsho la dbu ma zungs/ zhes lab pa'i lan tsam/ yang mi 'ong ba ci yin/ zhes bka' bkyon gnang byung bas/ grwa myo/nga gis khyed bzung ba rnams kyis rgyugs phul/ de min na nga rang tshor tshig ba'as kyang e gnang tshod mi/ thig gin gsung byung bas/ dbon po blo bzang phun tshogs/ bya bral nam mkha'/ dpa' sre don 'grub/ rje 'di ba sogs dge bshes 'ga' zhig bla brang du song ba la/ sku phyogs nas khyed tsho ci la yo nga gsung / khong rnam sa kyis rgyusas ‘rabul bar yong zhus pas/ so sor dri ba gnang ste dbon po blo bzang khyod kyis ci bzung gsung / khong gis sku phyogs/ kyi 'dus pa'i smad cha bzung zhus pas/ zhal mas khyod la skye ba 'dir lta ba'i bag chags mi 13 4

'dug tshu' khrims rnam pa ra dag pa cig 'ong gsung/ don 'grub kyis lam rim chung ba bzung zhus pas/ de bzang gsung / rje 'di la khyod kyis ci bzung gsung ba la khong gis sku phyogs kyi dbu ma'i smad cha dang sku phyogs kyi sems bskyed gnyis pa dang bcas pa sku phyogs kyi dbu ma phal cher bzung zhus / shin tu dgyes te khyod kyis sku phyogs kyi sems bskyed bzung ba e yin/ sems bskyed zer ba ci yin gsung zhal rtsed mang po gnang ngo/ /de dus skabs 'gar gnyan dmar mi dmar rta dmar can dpa' chas su zhugs nas snang ba'i phung po spro zhing 'ong nas/ nged khyod kyi sku yon la blta ru 'ong ba yin/ khyod kyi thos bas ma gyis kho bo mgu zhes zer nas sla ra gshegs pa rmis/ skabs shig rje bakhyad pa'i zhabs drung du nga rang rgyud la bas chags cig bzhag /de nas ri khrod la 'gro zhes zhus pas/ da dung rgyud la 'gro myo/ ran ri khrod la song nas khyod kyis ci sgo ma rgyu yin zhes gnang ba ma byin/ slob gnyer 'phro ma skyu ra gsung byung / de dus slo mang grub thob kyi sku phyogs rje 'di la thugs rtsis che bar yod 'dug pa la/ rje 'dis grub thob la yul ba'i len mkhan yong rung pha yul la mi 'gro rgyud la gcig song 0 135 ༷

nas ri khrod du sgrub pa byed 'dod zhus pas/ de'i lan du grub thob kyi zhal nas da dung po ti phyi ma rnams la slob gnyer gyis rgyud la 'gro ma ran/ pha yul la yul pa'i len mkhan dang / khyod rang 'gro 'dod la ma ltos par skabs shig rang shugs kyis 'gro dgos pa cig 'ong /chos mthar phyin nas 'phrin las rgyas po 'ong / khyod kyis rjes sor rdo rje 'jigs byed la las rung gi bsnyen pa cig gyis/ bstan pa la phan thog yag po yong gsung ngo / /yang skabs shig rje 'di sku cung zad ma bde nas sgo mang grub thob la zhus pas/ sku phyogs la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang zhus na bzang gsu/nga ba na/ bdag grwa rkyang gcig gis de zhu mi nus zhus pas/ grub thob kyis khyod rang ang nyan gyis dang / sku phyogs la ngas zhu gsung nas khong rang bi/sa zhus nga/sa chos grwa nas chur phebs tshe gnang chog gsung / rje 'di 'i kha btags dang / mar me gcig bsnams nas sku mdun du phebs pa bee sku phyogs kyis gzigs nas khyod ci la 'ong gsung ba'i lan du/ rjes grub thob kyis zhus pa'i rjes gnang bi don du 'ong zhus pa na rje bla ma/ bzhad de khyod rong bo reb gong gi mi 'byung bo 'dra ba la 'byung 'dul gyi rjes 0 136

ོgnang dgos pa e yin gsung / de nas sa gnang la thugs gtad de dal bus gnang bas bsnyun dwangs/ lo snga phyi 'di dag tu 'dul mdzod gnyis zhib tu gsan sbyongs mdzad/ de dag gi thal phreng gi steng du chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta yang thugs 'dzin mdzad/ rje 'di'i grub thob kyi sku phyogs la paṇa chen gyis gsung ba'i rje bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshigs bcad ma'i lung zhus/ grub thob kyis zhal nas 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan mang po gsung ngo/ /de dus rje bzhad pa'i drung nas spyod 'jug gsan/ dgung lo nyer brgyad pa sa skyong zhes pa shing bya la gsung phur dka' bcu'i mtshan btags gnang skabs sku zla cig dang bsdebs te phebs/ grogs di'i rtsed mo yin yang kha lhas phye ba'i tshig 'di ltar da reb mtshan btags kyi stabs kyis yul mi rnams kyi rmi lam du'ang dar 'phyar dung bus rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa sogs ltas ya mtshan pa mang po 'ong gin yod las che zer ba don gnas su song 'dug snyam/ ka ba bsgyur dus rje'i thugs la da lam rten 'brel zhig brtags dgos/ sngar po ti lnga la slob gnyer dga' mo byas/ rjes sor rgyud la song nas slob gnyer yang dag cig 137

byed/ skye ba 'di la rje'i bstan pa la phan thogs ci 'dra zhig yong ba ka ba 'di la lta dgos snyam du dgongs nas/ de mthun gyi gsol gdab 'phrin bcol mdzad de ka ba 'di la ston cig ces dmod btsugs smon lam btab pas/ ka ba dbus ma thob pa'i gong 'og gang nas brtsis kyang dbus mar 'dug /phan thog 'bring las mi 'ong ba 'dra dgongs zhes gsung mod kyang de drang don yin te/bstan pa'i srog shing du gyur pa 'di las lhag su zhib/ yod pa blo nang du bkug pa tsam gyis shes nus pas de'i brdar 'dus/ go / lo der rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs dben sa lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum/ don dam blo sbyongs rnams gsan/ a ra pa tsa na sngar nas 'don pin yod kyang thang gcig mtshams byas bton pas sems la rje'e bstan pa 'di yun ring gnas par byed pa la de'i don shes/ dgos pa 'dug/ de shes pa la shes rab dgos pa 'dug pas shes rab myur du stsol zhes gsol ba btab pas rtags bzang po byung / de nas rje'i bstan pa ngas 'dzin thub snyam pa shar gsung / lo der 'jam dbyangs bzhad 138

pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas dgun chos kyi dam bca'i dbur phebs te dge bshes rnams las su lhag dgongs nas rigs lung gsan pa'i rje 'di'i rigs lung gis thugs khengs pas yun ring du rigs lang byed du bcug de skabs pha yul nas khu bo rnams kyis gcung dge slong pha yul du gdan 'dren par btang ba slebs kyang phebs ma 'dod khu bo rab 'byams pa'i skog tu gser srang gang bskur de/ khyod rang la yon tan cig yong gin 'dug na rang yul du yong 'dod med tshe ma yong rung chog ces mi gzhan la yi ge bskur 'dug go/ dgung lo nyer dgu ba mi zad pa zhis pa me khyi la shog lhung sta gon byas te rje bzhad pa'i drung du dgongs pa zhus pas dgyes nas de ka yin da ni rgyud la 'gro ran song la slob gnyer gsha' ma zhig gyis/ thog mar gsang sngags mkhar gyi chos thog la 'jug dgos pa sogs zhal ta bzang po gnang / grub chen la yang zhus pas rgyu ma/tshan snga ma ltar gsung ngo / /de'i tshe rje nyid kyi thugs la so so'i skye bo'i blo la nges pa med pas dam bca' zhig bya dgos dgongs te/ grwa ja zhig gi skabs su bdag rgyud grwar zhugs nas/ bskyed rdzogs ṭikka dang bcas pa rnams dang / 139

'grel ba'i sa khungs legs par bsgrigs nas don rags rim pa zhig ma go tshun chad du rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar bcad na/ dpal ye thes kyi mgon po dang dam can chos kyi rgyal po gnyis 'khor bcas kyis tshar chod ces dam bca' drag po mdzad do/ /de nas rim gnyis mor bu'i rgyan ldan/ rig sngags phud sgras sgrib gnyis srog 'phrog mkhas grub klu dbang bye ba'i 'jug ngogs/ skye dgu'i re skong gsang chen snying po'i rin chen tshogs kyis phyur bur gtams pa/'i dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang zhes snyan gras/sa tshangs yul las brgal/ rig 'dzin dam pa'i dga' tshal mchog der gsang sngags mkhar gyi ston chos la zhugs/ thub bstan gangs kyi ri sul gnas te mdo sngags mang du thob pa'i ral khur 'dzin cing / bslab gsum lus rtsal rdzogs la lung dang reg/sa pa'i mche sder rnam par g.yo ba/ lugase gnyis kyi mkhyen pa mkha' ltar yangs pas/ mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i mgon gyur/ yongs 'dzin dam pa dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i drung du/ bskyed rdzogs gsan zhing ṭika chung gi skyor dpon gyis zhes bka' gnang ba la / rje 'di'i khengs skyung nas mi nus zhus kyang ma sanang bas// skyor 17/0

dpon mdzad de lo gcig la le'u dgu ba'i mtshams sbyar gyi bar du song / lo rjes ma la ṭika chen rdzogs par thugs 'dzin mdzad/ rgyud nga/ dpon slob kyi drung du rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod yang yang mdzado pa la/ dpon slob yang mchog tu dgyes nas zhib khrid mdzad/ rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par tshar gnyis lhag dang bcas pa gsan nas rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i tshig don la nges pa gteng tshugs pas/ 'jigs pa med pa 'i —spo bas nga/ mchog tu gyur/ lo 'dir rgyud stod mi da rnams 'bras/ spungs su/ phebs tshe/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs drung du sgo ma/nga grwa bang nas 'gre'/ ba ba'i sbrags gzab bshad dang bla ma snga ma so so'i ba༅/da sro/'a yang dag dang lta ra sna nga gi khya‘da pa/ra/ 'grel ba'i sa khungaca5 bsgrigs 'u/garu / mchan sbrags klag tshul sobs mdo sngas sa mang thos/ dbang po yo ngas kyi dregs pa'i ri bo bsnyil zhing mkhas pa nga /04 che ba'i zha'/ gyi dgun khar 'byung min/ ngo mtshar rma/da du byung ba'i legs bshad kyi char rgyun thugs kyi ro ldan mar bab pas dad pa mchos tu 'phel/ le'u bco lnga ba man chad rgyud smad dngo/na slo/ba rin 1 4 1

po ches kyang rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du gsan pa'i 'phro lus 'dug pa/ 'di dus khong dang mnyam du gsan/ 'grel gtad sog༄ / phyag len rgyas par gnang dus thugs dga' spro cher byung ba ni phyis su rgyud kyi bshad srol spel ba sogs legs tshogs 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug go/ dgung lo so gcig pa kun 'dzin ces pa sa byi la chu mig lung du rim lnga'i dmar khrid bskyangs pa'i rlung gegs cung zad byung yang / bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du mdzad nas gsol ba drag tu btab bas/ nyin gcig nyams snang la nya gcig kho rang gi 'og sgo nas zhugs song snyam pa cig shar ba'i de ma thag gegs las grol/de'i tshe dpon slob kyis kyang mkhyen nas da res kyi khrid pa ngag dbang bkra shis 'di la ci 'dra zhig byung ngam zhes sku mdun du grwa ba song ba rnams la gsung snang / zhal nas de dus khrid kyi 'phro skyong rgyu zhig byung na rtogs pa cig skyes pa la tshegs mi 'dug snyam pa yod kyang / phyis su dkor sgrib dang snod min la sngags kyi gsang ba bshad pa sogs kyis ci yang mi 'char gin gsung ngo / /rgyud kyi dam bca' chen mo mdzad skabs/ mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes 142

gnyen rgyud grwar bzhugs pa thams cad kyis/ lung dang rigs pa'i rtsal ci yod kyis 'bad kyang rje 'di'i rnam dpyod kyi lhun po g.yo ba lta ga la yod/ khong rnams kyi rje'i mkhyen pa'i gzi byin ma bzad par rtab rtab por gyur pas/ rje 'di'i mkhas grags kyi lha yi rnga sgras phyogs kun khyab par gyur to/ /de dus zhar la gar thig dbyangs gsum legs par sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur cing rgyud pa'i 'grigs dang phyag len thams cad kyang nges par mdzad/ rgyud pa dga' ldan du phebs dus rje 'di dga' ldan la phebs pa'i thog ma yang yin de dus dga' ldan la dam bca' yang 'jog dgos pas khong rnams phar phebs pa na/ dga' ldan 'du khang chen mo'i steng na dung chen gtong pa dang grwa ba rnams rgyud par zhal phyogs nas chos grwar rgyugs cing ser sbrengs ltar phebs pa gzigs pas rten 'brel legs par — dgongs/ der dam bca' nyin zhag sbrel mar gnang pa na/ grwa tshang so so'i mkhas mang legs bshad kyi bang mdzod thams cad bzhengs te bsgro gleng mdzad pa'i tshe/ po ti lnga ku'i gang 'dra zhig gi thad nas btang yang lan thogs nga/ med par mdzad cing / rje 'di'i dam 143

bca' 'jigs med rdo rje pha lam la khong ba rnams kyi lung rigs kyi nyag phran ches stug par gyur pas/ bzhin dang khengs pa'i kunda chabs gcig zum zhing dad gus dang grags snyan gyi padmo mngon par rtsen pa lhan gcig tu byas pa ni/ deng dus rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rang lugs kyi gdugs dkar po'i grib bsil la yid can ma lus pa yongs su 'god pa'i snying stobs mchog gi dpung bas/ byams dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i phyogs yangs bor bla ma rnams 'khyer ba'i brtson 'grus drag po bu ram thing ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i ngang tshul la zhugs pa 'di 'dra ba'i legs tshogs kyi sngon mtshan kho nar 'dug go/ /der bskyed rdzogs chen mo'i gzab bshad gsan/ skabs shig rje 'di'i mnal 'a/ma du khri chen po zhig gi steng na parṇa zhwa gser gyi mdog can dri ma med pa gcig gyon nas zhal byang phyogs la gzigs pa rmis/ ma lus rgyal ba'i ma/khyen brtse 'phrin las dang / /gsang gsum mi zad yod tan ma lus pa/ /yongs su 'dzin khyod yon tan phung po gang / /shong ba'i sku de e ma mchog tu yangs/ /dgung lo so gnyis pa 'gal ba zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo rje 1 4

'di rgyud la phebs gin yod skabs glo bur du snyung nas las sna rnams la dgongs pa zhus nas gnas tshang du phebs/ 'bras spungs su zla bo rnams la skad bskur bas/ grwa ba gcig yong ba la dpe cha dang na bza' rnams khur du bcug nas phebs pa'i mchod rten gser mgo ma'i thad du slebs pa na snyung rgyu ci yang mi 'dug thugs la deng rgyud nas gding ba yang blang tshar/ slar ldog tshul med snyam nas dgon par phebs zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ de nas dge 'phel du phebs dpe mtshams cig gnang yod pa na/ pha bong kha nas rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs kyi yi be cig bskur ba der grwa ba gcig song ba'i khyer 'ong ba la sku phyogs kyis phyag dam 'dug pa bkrol nas gzigs pas/ nang na ngag dbang bkra shis lags/ da lo nga rang mdo khams su 'gro rtsis yin pas/ khyod rang yang 'gro dgos/ de bar yig cha la lta yag gyis ces pa'i phyag bris gnang 'dug /thugs 'tshab ste pha bong khar phebs nas nye gnas 'a dris pas/ kho bos ma shes sku phyogs rang si mtshams nang nas gnang ba yin zer/ nye gnas brgyud de sku phyogs la zhus pas gsung shog ltar gsung byon/ de nas rje radi'i rgyud pa 145

dpon slob rin po cher dgongs pa zhus pa la khyod 'di kur bsdad na rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad yong gsung nas gnang ba ma byin/ rgyud pa dpon slob kyi phyag dpe 'grel pa cig yod pa nye gnas brgyud de slar phul/ de rjes su dgongs pa lan 'ga' zhus kyang ma gnang / de nas yang dpon slob po ta lar bzhugs sar dgongs pa zhu bar phyin pas/zhabs phyi ba la ngag dbang bkra shis nga'i rtsa ru ma gtong mjal kha dang dgongs pa mi yong zhes gsung lan bskur byung / sku phyogs la rgyu mtshan zhus pas sku phyogs nas rgyud pa dpon slob la gsung shog bskur kyang gnang ba ma byin/ rjes sor nyin gcig rgyud pa chos rje sku phyogs la mjal bar phebs/ rnam gnyis gsung 'phros rgyas par gnang nas chos rje phyir phebs khar/ sku phyogs nas ngag dbang bkra shis 'di nga'i phyag g.yog la 'gro rgyu yin pas dgongs pa gnang dgos gsung bas/ rgyud pa chos rje 'di dbus su bsdad na rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad yong / de rjes rgyud pa bla ma dang byang rtse gser khri sogs byung na de dga' mod/ a mdo la song nas ci byed zhus pas/sku phyogs nas khyod kyi 'phro 'di la bla ma 'ong na de kus chog de mi 146

'ong na nga'i rtsar 'gro dgos gsung bas/ rgyud pa chos rje bla ma dbu mdzad pa 'di'i 'phro la bla ma dbu mdzad dang de nas bla ma sogs yong zhus pas/ rgyud kyi 'grigs lam la khyod las nga mkhas khyod kyi 'phro nas bla ma mi 'ong na nga la dgos gnang ba cis kyang ster dgos gsung bas/ rgyud pa chos rjes de yin na dgongs pa yong gsung nas phebs pa na/ rje 'dis sku skyel mdzad pa rgyud pa chos rjes gzigs nas khyod kyis zla phyogs de mi dgos 'di kur bsdad na 'phral phugs kun la bzang bas/ da thabs mi 'dug gsung ngo / /rje 'dis phyag phul nas thugs dam skyabs 'og tu 'dzin par zhu zhus/ dgongs pa nan che ba'i stabs kyis dpon slob thugs ma mnyes snyam kyang rjes sor a mdor phebs skabs skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ bsrung mdud gnang zhal ta bzang po byon 'dug phyis su yang rje 'di bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla ma mdzad tshul gsan nas shin tu dgyes nas/ de bzang de bzang / des sku phyogs kyi yig cha dang bstan pa yang spel thub de yin na a mdo la song ba yang bzang zhes shin tu dgyes dgyes mdzad ces thos/ de dag la bsam na/ mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes/ /147

ces pa'ang don gnas su 'dug chos rje rin po che 'di nyid dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rnam gnyis kyis rje 'di la thugs rtsis ches che ba de 'dra mdzad nas rtsod 'then mdzad tshul de ni jo bo yab sras kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi sku rtsed kyi mched zla kho nar 'dug pas/ 'di 'dra ba las gzu bor gnas pas dpag na ya mtshan ci zhig yod snyam du sems so/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i bag chags lhag par brtas pa'i rnam rtog si rnyos chu'i ngor mdzad bzang gi zla ba dri ma med pa sna tshogs su shar te gleng ba thos shing des mod kyi kho bo cag ni 'gal bar mi bsam ste/ byis pa'i rnam rtog gi grangs dang ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul gnyis kur tshad kyi nges pa mtha' gcig tu bzung dka' bar shin tu mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras cho 'phrul za 'og gi/ /ngo mtshar ri mo tshad kyi nges bzung la/ /blo gros rgan rnams 'jug pa'i dogs chung yang / /mdzub rtses zla ba mthong rlom byis rnams zhen/ /mang thos khyung sngon skyes kyis nyer drangs pa'i/ /rnam dpyod bcu gnyis bdag po khyod shar tshe/ /log smra 'byung bya mya ngan khung bur btsud/ /blo gsal stag ris bshad sgrub dar dir sgrogs/ / 148

zab mo zab mo'i blo yis rtogs/ /chos kun chos nyid mnyam nyid mthong / /kun rdzob kun rdzob ngor ltos gzigs/ /tha snyad tha snyad tsam du nges/ /snang ba'i chos kun dngos pos stong / /stong pa'i chos rnams stong bzhin snang / /snang stong zung 'brel dbu ma'i lam/ /lam bzang gsal byed khyod bsngags 'os/ /chos mngon rgya mtsho rnam dpyod kyis/ /hub gcig gis ni 'dren pa khyod/ /sngon med dzahū zhig zhes/ /blo ldan bha gi ta thas mchod/ /rgyal bas bstan dang ston pa zhes/ /gus bcas zhis sa dang bcas pa/ /tshig dang don gyi 'dul ba la/ khyod kyi thugs su ma chud gang / /bka' gdams gzhung lugs gaṅga'i rgyun/ brgyud pa gsum 'dres chos tshul mchog /bshes gnyen lha chen ral klong las/ /'dren mkhas skal ldan shing rta khyod/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob byed gsang chen lam/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam/ /rgya bod grub dbang bye ba'i gtsug bsten lam/ /mgon khyod brtson pas btsal te rnyed pa'i lam/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud yang rtse 'khor lo sdom/ /de nyid dgongs ba'i yang rtse bde chen dang / pha rgyud kun gyi yang rtse 'dus pa dang / /de nyid dgongs pa'i yang rtse sgyu lus 149

zung / /zung 'dug lam gyi srog dang gzhung shing du/ /gzigs nas dad brtson ngoms med thos pa yis/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang ma nyes byas gnad gnyis kyis/ /mdo rgyud ma lus gzigs pa'i lde mig byas/ /de nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i zhabs phyi la phebs skabs rwa bsgreng mdor/ rwa bsgreng dge slong zhes pa byang chub kyi sems la myong ba rnal ma thon pa de'i sku phyogs la dngul bum legs pa cig phul/ rje 'di sku 'khor rnams kyi grul mjug na bzhugs yod pa la kha btags dri ma med pa gcig phul nas/ sku phyogs kyi 'khor na dge bshes chen po gcig phebs kyin yod zer ba khyed yin pa 'dra/sku phyogs kyi zhabs phyir byang phyogs su phebs nas bstan la bya ba bzang po gyis gsung / rje tshang nas gzhan zhu ma nus zhal smon ltar byed zhus pa la sku phyogs 'dzum pa mdzad kyin 'dug gsung ngo / /de nas 'dam gzhung na rgyal po lha bzang urges yod pa'i der rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas gdan drangs pa'i bzhugs grwal du rje 'di dang ser ra'i da ge bshes chen po gcig dang rnam gnyis kyis bsgro gleng mdzad dus/ rje 'dis rigs pa'i gnam lcags kyis phyi rgol gyi 150

dam bca'i brag ri thal bar brlags te rmag med par mdzad/ kho rang kha skyengs shing ngo tsha ba'i rngul chu'i mu tig gis bzhin gyi mdzes ma brgyan cing shin tu gnod pa'i zhugs kyis gdungs nas skom pa'i myos te/ rgyal po'i mdun du smyos skyem sa 'grims pa bslangs pa na/ rjes khyod kyis smyos 'gyur 'thung ngam zhes bgam pas gnad du phog pa ltar 'dug go/ /rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas dang rgyal po rnam gnyis mchog tu dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i spyan gyi bung ba rje 'di'i gdong gi dga' tshal du rol bar mdzad do/ /nyin rjes ma la rgyal mo tshe ring bkra shis kyi urges la sku phyogs phebs dus rje 'di la khyod rang yang 'gro gsung ba ltar zhabs phyir phebs pas/ rgyal ba yab yum dang lhan cig bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyung gnas kyi cho ga rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung ba'i lung dang khrid/ bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang sogs gsan/ mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang gnang dus gtor dbang gi tshe rje 'di'i dbu thog tu gtor ma bzhag ste slob ma 'di'i sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin la sa thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan/ bu slob 'khor g.yob/ chos 151 ༷

rgyun grags snyan thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas par mdzod cig ces 'phrin las bcol ba gang rgyas rgyas mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ rje 'di'i thugs la da res zhabs phyir khrid pa'i don 'di yin 'dug thugs la btags snyam du dgongs nas dga' ba chen po skyes gsung /rgyal pos rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs la khyed sku na bgres byang nas dgon pa cig btab na rjes sor skyongs mkhan yang dgos pas/ dge bshes re gnyis zhabs phyi la khrid yod mod zhus pa la/ zhal nas bu pha 'a/ thugs na rgya la thug zer ba'i dpe lta ra nga rang la thug pa re gnyis yod gsung ste/ rje 'di'i gsol dpon gnang yod pa la gzigs byung bas rgyal pos yang dgongs song snyam pa byung gsu nga / de nas bzung re zhig gi bar du sku phyogs kyi gsol dpon gnang bas thugs legs par zin po byung / lam skabs su ya nga yig cha phal cher ma bsnyel bar gshar sbyangs mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang la phebs so/ /de nas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug kriḍi'i sgyu 'phrul bye ba'i ro' gar las son cing / ra/ñdzu sno 4ṣa ha sa badzra gyi rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag chos kyi rgyal por ye shes kyi ma/kha' 'gro lab kyi sgrol mas lung bstan cing / blo bzang grags pa'i bstan 152

pa'i gnyen gcig 'jam dpal zhi khro mi yi rnam rol/ rje btsun mtshungs med 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / de yi thugs sras bshad sgrub bstan pa'i gsal byed rje ngag dbang bkra shis dpal bzang po yab sras zung gi snang byed zla dang bral ba/ mtha' 'khob mun pa'i smag rum bsal phyir spyan drangs te/ mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i chos sde'i nyin byed gsar du bskrun pa'o/ /srid zhi'i dbyings na bka' drin zla yi dben pa'i gnam bskos sa'i tshangs pa/ stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po/ sgyu rtsal rab tu byed la dpa' zhing brtul phod pa/ 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bskyed rim brtan po'i snang ba thun mtshams su yang mi 'jig pa mnga' ba'i dpon dga' ldan ar ti ni ju nang dang / dad dang gtong ba'i mdzes shing phra la zhib pa'i blo rno ba/ mtha' 'khob tu bstan pa'i sgron me gsar du sbar ba la zla med pa'i mkhyen dpyod dang / thabs mkhas pa'i 'phrul la gnas pa'i rgya mo za gong jo'i zlar 'os pa/ sa'i lha mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma zhes snyan grags kyis 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon gang ba/ yab yum de gnyis 153

kyi pho brang / sprul ba'i glegs bam du/ sa rtse brgyad lung ba phyogs su gyes/ /zhes gsal bar lung bstan pa'i rtse gzhung yid dga' chos 'dzin du/ ring nas legs smon gyis bcings pa'i mchod yon phan tshun lhan rgyas su gsar du 'byor ba'i dga' ston gyi bzhugs grwa snga phyi'i tshogs lang 'a / dpon tshang nas dka' bcu bstan 'dzin dang /se ra'i bya gdong gnyi4rje 'di'i sku zla bya lnga bslangs byung ba ltar tshogs lang mdzad pa la/ rje 'di'i sku zla'i dka' rams gzhon pa rnams cung ma rangs nas/ slan chad gang byung gi zlar/ rje 'dis gnangs mi dgos par nga rang rnams kyis yong ba cig ces kyang byed ces gros btab zhes thos so/ /de nas rje bzhad pa'i zhal nas/ rgya sgar tog ti phyogs su song la sa ming bzang ba gcig tu sde ba blo bzang gis mdo thon/ rje 'di'i ming legs pas mdo skul mkhan gyis/ gtsang ba ngag dbang grags pa dang / mdzod dase/ sku skyes/dka' bcu bstan 'dzin sogs dang bcas pa'i bkra shis kyi gso spyong dang / sa brtags bslang dang shis brjod rgyas par gyis gsung ba ltar gnyan rje'i phyogs su phebs nas/ bkra shis kyi gso sbyongs sogs 154

mdzad/ dgung lo so gsum pa rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags stag la rtse gzhung nas grwa tshang gsar du btsugs pa'i dge bskos la rje 'di ba —bskos/ rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyis tshig bzhag gnang /de lo rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas bde mchog gi ṭika chen lam rim sogs gsan/ de nas yab sras grwa tshang dang bcas pa 'chad nyan mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang nas tog ti la phebs/ gnyan rje'i mdun rnal ma nas yab sras kyis sa brtags bslang lto 'phye brtag pa/ bkra shis kyi gso sbyong sogs sa 'dul rgyas par ma dzad/ dgon de'i bzhugs grwa'i tshogs 'a nga la rje 'di dang / mkhas mchog ske la zhes dpal ldan 'bras/ spungs su rigaca pa smra ba'i khyu ma chog tu gyur pa/ a khyung mkhas mchog rnam gnyis kyi tshogs lang ma/dzad pa'i drung rams pa sngar gyi dge bathes chen po yin kyang phyis su bsnyel bas lan nam gang ltar na'ang / rje 'di'i rigs pa zur tsam yang mi bzod par 'dug pa dang / khong ba phyogs 'di'i bla chen du so/nga gshis rjes gtsags gtsags ma byas kyang khong rang gis da ni kho bos ming las yon tan ma lus 'dug ces gsung zhing / rje la dad gus dang dag snang gi dbyar 155

mtsho mchog tu 'phel bar gyur to/ /de nas yab sras rnams sngar bzhin bsang la phebs pas rgyog mdor slebs pa na/ rje 'di'i thugs la bsang gi lung ba 'di la sngar gyi rang yul zhig tu sar thon pa lta bu'i snang ba 'char gyin 'dug pa ltar/ rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du yang zhus pa la/ sku phyogs bzhad mo mdzad de/ 'khor ba la thog ma med pas sa 'dir shwa ba gla ba rer skyes pa yin shas che gsung / bkra shis 'khyil du phebs tshe rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis mar me brtags pa byed rgyu yin pas/ bkra shis 'khyil klas drug gad pa lug mang gsum gyi skal gyi mar me re byas la khyer shog gsung ba na/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi mar me rje 'di bas gnang ba phyis kyi rten 'brel du 'dug rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis rje la khyod kyis kyang mar me brtags pa gyis gsung ba ltar brtags pa mdzad pas/ yab sras gnyis kus mar me brtags pa bkra shis 'khyil la mthun par babs 'dug de nas bkra shis 'khyil du dgon 'debs par thag bcad nas rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs kyis bkra shis 'khyil du sa brtag bslang lto 'phye brtags pa rnams gnang ba'i dus su rje 'di la las kyi rdo rje 156

kyis gsung ba ltar las kyi rdo rje mdzad nas/ rje bzhad pa'i drung nas lto 'phye brtags pa dang bum gter bri bsgrubs rnams gnang ba'i grogs dang / de skabs rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg mang po mdzad pa na yang / rje 'di la khyod kyi byang 'dren gyis rab 'byams smra ba chen po ngag dbang dpal ldan la mchod g.yog gyis gsung pa ltar/rjes byang 'dren mdzad nas yab sras rnams kyis bdun phrag gcig gi bar du snga dro zhi ba dang / phyi dro rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg mdzad cing phyag len yang mi 'dra ba mang po gnang ba thugs la nges par mdzad/ slar yang ya/ ba sras rnams sngar bzhin bkra shis 'khyil nas bteg ste rtse la phebs5 / der rje'i snyenabaca/ drung nas legs bshad snying po stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed rnams/ kyi gzab bshad lung dang bcas pa dang /'jam/ dbyangs chos slo ra gyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa dang /de duru/ bde chem chos rdo rje ba'ad pa'i zhal snga nas mjal bar phebs pa —la chos 8brel zhus / de nyid dang lhan du rje bzhad pa'i tshad 'gog rgyas nga/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos 'byung khams gsum rnarma rgyal rnams gsan/ dpon tshang gi rten rnams la rab gnas rgyas pa dbe 157

legs char 'bebs ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len bslabs/ de nas rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas/ la mo bde chen du gdan drangs pa'i zhabs phyi la phebs/ der bzhugs grwa la mdzad skabs tshogarngatha lang la rje 'di dang / la mo'i dge bshes chen po ngag dbang 'phrin las zhes pa gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba la 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa gzengs mtho zhing mkhas pa'i grags snyan gyis sa ste nga khyab pa de nyid dang / rje 'di rnam gnyis 'bel gtam mdzad dus rje 'dis phar phyin gyi sa'i yongs sbyongs/ dbu ma/'i bden gnyis 'dul ba'i sra brkyangs sogs po ti lnga ga'i dgag sgrub kyi 'o 'thung rus ba'i rtse brgya 'phyar ba tsam gyis/ phas rgo‘ra sngon gyi lha rgam 'jigs zhum zhum mdzad/ phas rgol gyis kyang mang thos rnam dpyod kyi mthu rtsal gang yod pa brnan pa'i snying stobs shugs ches cher bskyed nas rgol bar zhugs kyang / rje 'di'i ring nas goms pa'i rnam dpyod kyi mig stong mngon par bgrad cing / bsod nams tshogs kyis bskrun pa'i cang shes sa srung zhon nas/ phrag dog dang 'gran sems kyi thal ba dang /chos brgyad snang shas kyi 'khu 'khrugs med kyang / tshogs gnyis kyi 158 0

lag rjes ngom zhing dkar phyogs kyi dpung bskyed pa'i phyir don spyod rtsub 'gyur gyi btung bar rol te/ phas rgol gyi blo gros kyi 'jug pa'i lha min dbang po re re'i mdun du phra zhib lung rigs kyi rtse brgya 'bar ba gzas pa'i mchog sbyin brgya pa re res 'jo mas pa ra mthong la gsung gi nga ro sa kyang spa bkong bar gyur cing / tshur rgol skabs su yang cher brnag kyang skabs bzhi ba'i mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa 'i skabs la zhal nor 'dra ba mtshon tsam las gzhan glags ma rnyed cing /'dul shan gyi skabs shig 'dul ba rgya cher 'grel gyi lung gcig drangs pa la rje 'di'i lung rdzus ma yin zhes lan gnang / de'i tshe khong gis gzhan gyi rdzun rub kyi lung gi skabs la cung zhig brten 'dug pa'ang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje rgol ba'i dpang por bzhugs pa'i/ 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ros kurma ba zhig gi 'dul bar lung de 'dug kyang rgya cher 'grel gyi rgya trod kyi dpe gang na'ang de mi 'dug pas/ lung rdzus mar 'dug gsung bas khong yang ya mtshan zhing / la rma'i zhabs drung dkar po'i sku phyogs kyang mchog tu dgyes nas/ phyag thal mo sbyar te mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i 159

bshes gnyen chen po 'di 'dra ba phyogs 'dir yongs lugs kyis/ rje'i bstan pa yang phyogs 'dir dar bar 'dug zhes bsngags brjod chen po mdzad/ khong rnam gnyis kyis zla grags dang tsand+ra go mi lta bu'i rtsod pa mdzad pa la rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyang rab tu dgyes nas/ ja gsol la da dung rtsod gsung ba ltar yun ring brtsasnapas/phyogs 'a/sa rnam par rgyal ba'i grags snyan gyi ba dan lhagapar g.yos so/ /der zhabs drung dkar bo'i sku phyogs dang khri rgya nag pa'i sprul sku rin po che'i sku phyogs/ bde chen dpon slob sogs skyes chen dam pa mang po dang lhan cig lta khrid rgyas pa/ lho brag snyan brgyud kyi rjes gamang lung dang bcas pa rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas gsan to/ /gsu/nga rab tshigs mda'i lam yangs su/ /rtsam dpyod sgro gshog rab bskyod de/ /log rtos lag/ 'gro'i dngu/nga 'joms pa'i mang thos mkha' lding dbang po khyod/ /chos tshol tshur/ la ngoms med nor bzang zla/ /chos 'phags ji bzhin chos nyid 'chad la mkhas/ /chos rtsod smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal bzhin/ /chos kyi mtho ba'i mnga' bdag mi pham dngos/ /mkhas mkhas yongs/ kyi zhabs gtugs te/ /mkhas /60

mkhas rgya bod gzhung mang sbyangs/ /mkhas mkhas rigs smra'i khengs bcom pas/ /mkhas mkhas gtsug rgyan phyogs las rgyal/ /khyod thugs rab yangs kun gsal ngos/ /mdo rgyud rnam dpyod sprin dkrigs te/ /lung rigs gnam lcags mar phabs pas/ /phas rgol brag ri thal bar brlag /dbu tshad rigs pa'i rgyal rnga khyod nyid kyis/ /res min gcig char yang yang brdung bas na/ /'phags pa lha dang chos kyi grags pa yi/ /rtsod pa'i khri zung khyod la gtad par nges/ /de nas slar yang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gsan/ sog po rab 'byams pa grags pa'i mdun nas rje 'dis 'grel pa don gsal mdzub khrid cig zhus pas/ rje 'di'i thugs khengs nas/ drung rams pa de ni snyan grags chen po can zhig min 'dug kyang shin tu mkhas pa cig 'dug gsung ngo/ /lo de ku'i ston zla bdun pa 'phar ma'i dbang du byas na bdun pa dang de ma brtsis na hor zla brgyad pa'i chos/ la dgon lung gi bla ma lcang skya'i sku phyogs nas bang chen rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas gdan 'dren par yong / rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas nyid 161

la yang bla mar mjal bzhed kyi thugs dgongs che bar bzhugs pa'i steng la/ bla ma'i sku phyogs kyis gdan 'dren mngags pas/ der phebs par thag chod pa dang / snga sor rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas nyid kyis grwa ba gsar zhugs rnams la tshig bzhag re zhig gnang zhing / de rjes chos thog phyed lhag cig la sog po dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba grags pa slob chung byas te tshig bzhag gnang / rje 'di dge bskos mdzad nas lo phyed song ba'i skabs yin kyang / de dus rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis/ rje 'di la khyod kyis bla ma gyis la tshig bzhag thong gsung ba la/ rjes sku phyogs kyi phyag g.yog gzhan ci 'dra zhig yin rung byed/ bla ma ni kho bos mi yong zhes nan zhus pas/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis dgongs pa gtan nas mi yong bla ma cis kyang byed dgos gsung zhing / rje nyid kyi sgo mang gi chos grwar bzhes 'phro'i ras ber dang / zhwa mo rnams gnang nas 'di dgagyon la chos khri'i steng nas tshig bzhas thon gsung ba na/ rje 'dis sku phyogs kyi na bza' ngas gyon mi nus zhus pas lan du/ skyon med mgo thog tu bzhag te byin rlabs rang la thim pa'i mos /62

ba byas nas gyon na chog ces chos khrir bzhugs pa dang / na bza' gyon pa'i don la yang bka' nan gnang / de nas zla ba de ku'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la chos sde chen po dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'jigs med seng ge'i khri la zhabs kyi padmo nye bar bkod de 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mgon du gyur pas legs tshogs rgyas/ de'i tshe rje 'di chos gyur phebs pa na rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i bzhugs khri la bskor ba mdzad cing ba/yon ngos nas phyag lan gsu/ma 'tshal nas khri la bzhugs shing / zla ba 'di'i yar tshes bco lnga 'i gso sbyong la so thar gyi mdo gsung ngo / /rje 'di'i rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du bsdus grwa cig brtsams nas gnang na de tshig bzhag la gtong zhus pas/ bsdus tshan 'ga' zhig brtsams te da ni 'phro rtsom mi thub gsung nas/ sngar sde srid kyi zhus nas gnang pa'i bsdus grwa'i rtsa tshig dang sde bdun rgyan gnyis gnang nas 'di dag ltar tshig bzhag thong gsung ngo / /de nas bzung ste bsdus grwa thams cad thugs thog nas gnang ba la rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis gsan nas dgyes yo/da pa'i skabs shig /0 163 0

rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs sku khams bsang te nyi 'od la bzhugs pa'i mdun du rje 'di phebs pa na sku phyogs kyis gzigs nas/ bla ma zhig gis bsdus grwa khyab pa med ni rkyang gtong gin 'dug pa ngas 'gog rgyu yin gsung nas sku rtsed mdzad pa la/ rje 'dis 'gog na yang da ni dgags ran ngas bsdus gas sa steng khyab tshar yod zhus pas dgyes shing / khyod kyis bsdus grwa mi 'dra ba de tsam gang nas shes zhes gsungs pa la/ rje 'dis khong rwa bstod nas phyir phebs tshe sgo mang nas btsan po rong bo sogs phyogs gzhan nas 'ong ba'i grwa ba rnams dang rtsod grwa mdzad skabs shes zhus pas sku phyogs shin tu dgyes po ma/dzad do/ /dgung lo so bzhi pa bong bu zhes pa lcags yos la cho 'phrul chen mo'i dus ra/chod smon lam gsar du btsugs pa'i tshe rje bzhad pa'i drung nas 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa gsan/ smon lam gyi mjug bcu bzhi la rje 'dis gtor ma 'phangs/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis tshig bzhag mgyogs par btang na grwa ba gsar zhugs rnams la myur du phar phyin dang / po ti phyi ma yang 'dzugs dgos tshul bka' gnang ltar/ chos mtshams de nas bzung ste re zhig gi bar du 164

chos mtshams rnams su yang tshig bzhag chags med lta bu mdzad/ 'di lo hor zla gnyis pa'i yar ngo'i rdzogs pa gsum pa tshes bco lnga'i nyin 'alor mang po'i dbus nas rje 'di la sku phyogs nas gos ber dang paṇa zhwa gnang nas// rje rin po ches rgyal tshab rje la 'od gsal lha khang nas paṇa zhwa dang sku ber gnang pa'i dpe ltar yin pas/ 'di dag gyon la nga'i khri steng du sdod la bstan pa skyongs shig ces bka' gnang / stag lo nas lo 'ga' zhig gi bar la chos thog bi tshig bzhag lta ci/ chos mtshams la yang dpyid sos dbyar ston rnams su 'dzin grwa song ma rnams la tshig bzhag chags med lta bu gnang / lo 'dir rje ba'ad pa'i zhabs drung nas brgyad stong don bsdus nyi snang 'jus pa rang 'grel sogs gzhung chen lnga drug cig gi gzab bshad dang / rnam sras dang dmag zor ma gnyis kyi rjes gnang rnams gsan/dka' ram sa rnam pa rnams la po ti phyi ma'i tshig ba'ag rje bzhad pa'i gnang 'phro btang zhing mdor na po ti lnga'i tshigs bzhag gnang /rgan gzhon kun gyis rtsod grwa dmar po byung / ston chos phyi ma gnyes/ la srod chos yang gnang / dgun chos la grwa ba gsar zhugs kyi 'dzin grwa /65 —

dang po la bsdus tshan nyer lnga blo rtags dang bcas pa rdzogs/ phar phyin gsar du tshugs/ 'dzin grwa de nas bsdus tshan nyer lnga blo rtags dang bcas pa'i rgyugs 'bul mkhan 'ga' zhig byung 'di nas re zhig gi bar du rgyun ldan byung ngo / /'di lo nas bzung ste sku bsnyung ba'i me 'brug gi bar la lo re rer 'dzin grwa phyi ma re rer bsdus tshan blo rtags dang bcas pa nyer bdun tshugs/ dgun chos la phar phyin gsar 'dzugs kyi rgyun chad med du mdzad/ lnga mchod kyi nyer dgu'i gtor rgyag dang / lo rnying gi nyer dgu'i gtor rgyag sogs kyang de ltar mdzad/ /dgung lo so lnga ba 'ga' ba zhes pa chu 'brug lo'i smon lam skabs rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas 'khrungs rabs so bzhi ba dang / rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs/ gsan/ de'i bcu bzhi la gtor rgyag gnang ba sogs sbrul lo'i bar du lo re bzhin ma/dzad/dpyid rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas tshad ma rig sgo ngang rig thig sogs kyi gzab bshad gsan/ rje bzhad pa'i drung nas thal 'gyur che ba'i tshig bzhag gnang ba'i skyor dpon mdzad/ ston rje bzhad pa'i drung nas rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu gnyis kyi 166 0

dbang gsan/ skabs shig dpon ju nang la rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyis nga sgres po cig la yang yang mjal bas ci byed song la bla ma la mjal kha zhus gsung ba ltar/ dpon rin po chos rje 'di la khong mjal bar phebs rgyu yin zhes snyan gsan phul pas/ rje 'di'i gzims khang yang dman zhing bzhugs gdan dang gsol ba sogs bzhes 'os rwa/ 'byo ra nas nam phebs zhus kyang / dpon gyis ma gsan par 'kho ra nyung ngu dang bcas phebs nas zhabs kyi padmo gus pas spyi bor blangs pas mchod yon thugs yid gcig tu 'dres so / /dgung lo so drung/ pa rnam rgyal 'es pa chu sbrul lo'i smon lam la rje bzhad pa'i drung mas 'khrungs rabs kyi 'phro dang dad pa'i 'jug ngogs kyi 'phro rnam/sa gsan/ dpyid rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas sku bsnyung tshul mdzad ba la/ rje 'dis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad te mgon po'i gtor chen rgyud smad lugs ltar mdzad nas sha sa na bsgrubs pa'i nyin gcig sngags bton pas gtor ma'i yol ba'i nang nas g.yag nag po chen po gcig glo bur thon snang byung bas/ lus kyi spu zing shas byas te sems skrag dngangs chen po byung zhing sku bsnyungs 167

yang dwangs/ sku gegs log ltas bzang gsung ngo / /de dus dpon ju nang mgo log gi steng du dmag la phebs rgyu yin 'dug pas rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du de la sku rim ji 'dra dgos zhus nga/ na/ bla ma mgon po'i dbang gi gtor bsgrub byed du chug ces bka' phebs/de'i tshe rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis rje 'di la mgon po'i dbang gi gtor sgrub kyi khrid man ngarga dang bcas pa gnang / dpon tshang gis rje 'di rtse gzhung du spyan drangs nas gtor sgrubs 'dun phrag gcib mdzad pas ltas legs po byung / dngo/na tshang nas/ bsnyen bkur phun lkesum/ tshogs pa sanang / rje nas nub gcig phyag drug pa'i sku chen po ri gcig gi rtse la brkyangs bskums byas yod pa rgyan thams cad khra lam me yod pa cig rmis/ de la 'phrin las cig bcol bas/ma pas jon ma byung bar mi/ snang bar gyur song / rje la yang nus ba sa mnyes/ 'phrin las rgyas po yo ngas gsung 'dug pa 'di dus yi na nam snyam/ de nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ lnga mchod kyi gtor ma 'phen pa sogs sngar ltar mjad/ yang skabs thig bla ma khyang la mjal nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes zhus ma sa byin rlabs byed pa rmis/ phyir nyin /08

rgyal rmis yin las che snyam yang ltas dga' ba yin tshod du 'dug gsung ngo / /dgung lo so bdun pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing rta'i lo'i smon lam la phebs par mgon po'i mtshams gnang bas zhag gnyis song ba na rtags bzang po byung / zla ba gsum pa'i yar ngo la sku phyogs nas mgon po'i rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub gyis gsung bas/ de dus rje bzhad pa 'i zhabs drung nas rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub kyi ma/na ngag zhib rgyas gsan/ rje 'dis dbu mdzad nas bdun phras gcig tu bsgrubs pas sku phyogs thugs da gyes/ dbyar mjug rje ba'ad pa'i zhabs drung nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gas/na/ sku phyogs nas da lo mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang gnang rgyu yin pas/ de'i sku rim la mgon po'i gtor sgrubs gyis gsung / de'i tshe yang rje 'di'i gtso mdzad bdun phrag gcig tu bsgrubs pas ltas bzang po byung zhing sku phyogs mnyes/ ston rje bzhad pa'i drung nas khri rin po che blo gros rgya mtsho'i sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs sogs bla chen du ma dang / dpon dga' ldan ju nang sogs os long kyi rgyal rgyud du mas mtshon pa'i tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang lhan cig tu mi tra brgya rtsa gsan pa'i tho ni 'di ltar/ gshed 169

dmar lha bcu gsum ma/ 'jigs byed lha bcu dgu/ 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig la gshin rje pho brgyad kyi bskor ba/ dgra nag lha bcu gsum/ gdong drung lha nyer lnga/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor lha bcu dgu/ khro bcu/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lha so gnyis/ phyag rdor 'khor chen lha bco brgyad/ 'jam rdor lha zhe gsum/ kyai rdor thod pa can lha dgu/ sku bye rdor lha dgu/ gsung kye rdor lha dgu/ thugs kyai rdor lha dgu/ bdag med ma lha mo ba co lngas bskor ba/ saṃ pu ṭa nas bshad pa'i kyai rdor rma tshon cha can lha bcu bdun/ de nas bshad pa'i sku kyai rdor zhal ga/cig phyag ga/nyis/ lha bcu bdun/ de nas bshad pa'i kyai rdor zhal gsu ma phya poo/ drug bdag med lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ saṃ pu ṭa maca bshad pa'i nyu rdor zhal gcig phyag gnyis lha bcu bdu na / ku ru kulle lha ba cu gsu/ma/bde mchog lū i pa sku mdog sngon po can lha re gnyis/ bde ma chog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha re po/nyis/ bde ma/chog ser bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha re gnyis/ bde ma cho ga dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yab rkyang gtso 'khor nyer dgu/ phas mo gtso 0 70

'khor so bdun/ 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu bzhi gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ 'khor lo sdom pa gtso 'khor lnga/ 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po gtso 'khor bdun/ bde mchog dkar po gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ phag mo dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ mkha' spyod ma dmar mo gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ phag mo don 'grub ma phyag bzhi gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtso 'khor dgu/ phag mo dbu bcad ma gtso 'khor bco lnga/ phag mo dmar mo zhal bzhi gtso 'khor so bdun/ ma hā ma ya zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtso 'khor lnga/ ma hā ma ya zhal bzhi phyag bzhi gtso 'khor lnga / de nas bshad pa'i pha rgyud du gtogs pa thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu/ ma rgyud ma hā ma ya dkar po zha' gcig phyas gnyis yab yum lha lnga/ pha rgyud rta mgrin padma dkar dbang zhal gsum phyag brgyad lha/ bcu gsum/ ma rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi yab bka' lha nga brgyad/ gdan bzhi yum bka' lha bcu gsum/sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi lha nyer lnga/171

rdo rje sgrol ma sngon po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gtso 'khorabacu gcigasangs rgyas thod pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtso 'khor dgu pa/ mgon po phyag bzhi ba gtso 'khor lnga/ sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa gtso 'khor nyer gcig kun rig bsdus lha nga gsum/ dus 'khor lha stong bdun brgya/ 'khor lo'i bsgyur drug lha re gnyis/ kun rig rtsa bzhi dkyil 'khor/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ 'od dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ bde chen yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyag rdor rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba/ phyag rdor gza' brgyad rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba/ phyag rdor klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal/ rdor dbyings 'gro 'dul/ don grub 'od dpag med/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan 'al bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ tsind+ra go mi'i lugs kyi mtshan brjod 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ yang mtshan brjod kyi 'jam dpal 'al gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser po/ dam pa rigs 172

brgya/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ mi 'khrug pa/ yum chen mo/ sbyong rgyud rdo rje rnam 'joms/ 'gro bzang gos sngon can/ bya rgyud shākya thub pa rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po a ra pa tsa na dkar po/ rigs kyi gtsug tor/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma/ khro bo mi g.yo ba gtso 'khor bcu gcig gdugs dkar zhal gsum phyag brgyad gtso 'alor nyer bdun/ don zhags gtso 'khor lnga/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge'i sgra gtso 'khor lnga/ phyag rdor bdud rtsi'i thig nga// lo ma gyon ma/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo// phyag rdor mchod rten sngon po can/ phyag rdor 'khor chen zhal gcig/ phyas/ banyis/ phyag rdor lcags sbugs can/ phyag rdor zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ lha mo grwa lnga/ phyag rdor gtum po khyung sngo na can/ rta mgrin khya94 gcig phyag gnyis pa la khro bcus bsko ra ba/ lha mo 'od zer can/ (radzam lha gtso 'khor bco brgyad nga/ rnams kyi dbang gsan/ lo lnga phyi 'a di dag la chos grwa nas tshis bzhag gsung dus zhig min par/grwa slob gnyer ba phal cher la sku ma/dun nas thal ska da dang rigs lung gtong tshul lag pa rdeb tshul sogs slobs pa dang / chos grwa nas rje 173

nyid dbu la bzhugs nas 'dzin grwa gong 'og rnams la rtsod grwa byed du bcug nas drag shas phan tshun gyi som nyi sel bar mdzad pa dang /mdor na rje 'dis blo zhan pa rnams la rigs lung gtong rgyu bsgrigs nas gnang ba sogs/ bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs pa'i thusas smo na dang / gzhan don la skyo ngal mi mnga' ba'i lhag bsam gyi mthu las/mtha' 'khob mun gling gi byis pa'i skye bo skal ba dang ldan pa rnams thego chen chos kyi dpal la 'dod 'gur spyod pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i ngang tshul 'di nyid bskrun par mdzad pa'i bka' drin las rgyal ba sras bcas kyis kyang bsngags pa'i zhing du gyur pa ni gdon mi za zhing / tshul de la blo dang ldan pa sus kyang bsnyon du med do/ /lan cig rmi lam du nam mkhar/ nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus ‘2jigs tshogs la/ /lta las byung bar blo yis mthong gyur nas/ /klu sgrub zla ba'i zhabs kyi ring lugs la/ /rgyun du 'dres par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer ba rmis/ de rjes shig rje la mi phyed nga/'i dad pa dang ldan pa thub bstan dar rgyas kyi bzhugs gdan so gas 'bul 4ba phul te nan cher rje nyid la gsol 'debs kyi sho lo ka gcig gnang dgos 174 ༷

zhus pa/ sngon gyi sho lo ka de'i mjug gi phyag 'tshal zhes pa gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba gnang nas bka' rgya mdzad do/ /lo 'dir rje bzhad pa'i zhal las lo rnying gi nyi shu'i ngo la drug cu ba'i mkhar thab gyis gsung nas/ rje 'di gcig pu la drug cu ba'i man ngag zhal shes rnams gnang zhing / rgan pa 'ga' zhig la phyag len gzhan rnarmas gnang / de nas rje 'dis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad nas bsgrubs cing gtor ma 'phangs bas ltas bzang po byung ba la sku phyogs dgyes shing / da phyin chad lo re ltar ma chag pa gyis gsung ngo / /dgung lo so brgyad pa myos byed ces pa shing lug gi lo'i smon lam gyi gsung chos la sku phyogs zhag 'ga' pheb sa/ de nas rje 'di la khyod gyis gsung chos dang smon lam rgyas pa gyis gsung ba ltar rje 'dis sngar gnang ba'i gos ber dang paṇa zhwa bzhes te bla dpon rnams kyi thog drangs ba'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su 'khrungs rabs so bzhi ba dang rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs gnyis rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs kyis gsung 'phro nas gnang / phyi dro smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs bsngo smon rgyas par mdzad/ lo 'dir phar phyin 'dzin grwa gcig 175

la gser phreng gzhir bzhag byas skabs bdun pa'i tshig bzhag gnang ba 'ga' zhig gis zin bris byas te spyan sngar gzigs pa phul ba las/ rang gzhan gyi yig cha mang po la dgag pa byas 'dug pas/ de mi rung snyam pa'i mtshan mo mnal lam du mi gcig gi dga' dga' byed cing de shin tu bzang rje'i dgongs pa bla med yin zer ba rmis/'di'i lor dpyid chos gnyis pa'i steng du lam rim chen mo'i gzab bshad lung dang bcas pa gnang ba'i dbu btsugs pa na/ dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i lha rnams kyis rgyal tshab dam pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su babs pa'am yang na shākya'i rgyal po slar yang byang ༅/ra ba/dul bya'i dpal du phebs snyam zhing ngo ma tshar chen po'i lta sa kyis lha lam yangs su gang bar byas so/ /de'i tshe 'khor lo rim nga/ gsum gyi gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ dpal ldan mar me mdzad dang rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal rnam gnyis brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i thugs bcud/ zab dang rgya che byin rlabs gsum sbrel gyi bka' babs dang bcas pa'i legs bshad kyi char chen po dal bus / skal ldan gdul bya'i blo yi dpyid kyi 'dzin mar phabs /76

pas rtogs pa'i myu gu gsar ba'i tshogs phan tshun 'gran cing 'phel bar gyur to/ /lo snga phyi 'di dag la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan slob mang du mdzad/ rje bzhadapa'i zhal nas da lo rigs grwa dang gling bsre 'dzugs thabs kyis zhes gsungs phebs pa ltar/ rje 'dis dang blangs mdzad de/ hor zla drug pa'i nyi shu bdun la gling bsrer rdo gcal la 'tshogs tshad yang / nyi grib rdo gcal steng du slebs pa na/'tshogs gsung ba ltar snga mor tshogs te po ti lnga ku'i gsung bshad rgyas par gnang ba'i mgo rtsom pa na rten 'brel legs pa byung ngo / /lo 'di nas bzung ste/ me 'brug gi lo'i bar gyi lo gcig tsam ma gtogs lo re ltar gling bsres bshad pa mdzad/ drug pa'i nyer dgu la gtor ma 'phangs/ gnam gang la zho ston byag tshes gcig nas bzung ste bco lnga'i bar la nyin re bzhin zhog kha ja bzhi/ tsha gra'i ba bzhi dgongs ja gnyis dang bcas pa grol kha'i bar la chag med du btang / lo 'dir 'gyed gsum las ma 'dzom phyis su je rgyas je rgyas su byas pa na/ la dar gyi 'gyed/ man ji'i 'gyed/ ras 'gyed/ grwa ba gnyis re la gos kha re thems nges kyi gos 'gyed/ ja 'gyed/ go 4—— 177

lag sna tshogs kyi 'gyed/ zog 'gyed sogs 'gyed brgyad dgu las mi dman zhing nyin re bzhin du tshab tu btang / mdor na phyag rdzas gang yod rigs grwar btang nas/ gzhan gyis bltas na lo rjes ma'i rigs grwa lta ci/ chas ka mi 'dun snyam pa skye yang / de ma thag tu 'tsho ba de lo re ltar rigs grwa je rgyas su 'gro ba 'dra yang / chos rje bus/'bad rtsol gyis sam sngon bsags 'byor ba yi/ /blun po'i 'khor g.yog mang du 'dus pa rnams/ /bzang btung gis skyongs chos kyis ma yin pas/ /bshes gnyen la la ba lang rdzi bo 'dra/ /zhes smad pa ltar/ zhar byung du smos tsam ma gtogs/ longs spyod kyi lo rgyus la rje 'di dgyes po med pas/ 'dir de zhib par mi 'chad do/ /lo 'dir dgun chos la grwa ba gsar zhugs kyi 'dzin grwa dang po la phar phyin gyi tshig bzhag rdzogs nas phar phyin ston mo gsar du tshugs pa la 'gyed gnang / de'i tshe rje 'dis phar phyin gyi tshigs gcig kyang ma lus bar tshig bzhag la btang nas rdzogs zhes sku phyogs la zhus pas shin tu dgyes/ 'dzin grwa 'di nas skabs dang po'i rgyugs 'bul mkhan 'ga' byung 'dzin grwa 'dir dbu ma tshugs shing / lo 'di nas bzung 178

ste lo re bzhin du 'dzin grwa phyi ma phyi ma'i phar phyin ston mo byed pa rgyun chags su byung ngo / /dgung lo so dgu ba gdong ngan zhes pa me sprel gyi lo'i smon lam chen mo'i dus gsung chos la phebs nas 'khrungs rabs dang rtogs brjod bdun legs ma sasungs/ phyi dro smon lam gyi dbu la phebs te bsngo smon legs par gnang / de'i chos mtshams su 'dzin grwa gong ma rnams la dge 'dun nyi shu'i tshig bzhag thugs thog nas gnang ba 'ga' zhig gis zin bris byas pa la sngon med pa'i legs bshad rdo/ /de nas dpon tshang gi sku rim la mgon po'i gtor bsgrubs mdzad/ dpyid chos gnyis pa'i steng nas lam rim dang don dam blo sbyong dge tshul gyi bslab bya rnams gsung chos la gnang / lo 'dir dbe tshul gyis bslab bya bsdus pa zhig ljags rtsom mdzad/ lo 'dir sgo mang dpon slob cung gar ba blo bzang phun tshogs dang lhan cig tu rje bakhyad pa'i zhabs drung du khro bcu'i mngon rtogs rdo rje go khrab dang / rwa lugs kyi khro bcu'i skor rdzogs par gsan/ kṣe tra bā la'i las tshogs mang po dang sbrel khrid kyi skor mang po dang / de'i sros 'khor gyi man ngag dang / zhwa lu ba'i rtsa tshig gi bshad pa rnams/ /79
