༄gsan/ slo mang dpon slob de nyid kyis rje 'di la drug cu ba'i skor mang po zhus nas dogs gcod yang yang mdzad pa la rje 'dis rje gong mas snga sor khong la khrid pa rnams dpon slob la zhib par khrid pas/dpon slob dgyes nas ngas gtsang dbus gnyis kur drug cu ba'i rtsar zhib mor bcad kyang 'di 'dra go ma myong da ni dbus la song na drug cu ba la nga las mkhas med gsu/nga / 'di'i lor dgun chos la grwa ba gsar zhugs kyi 'dzin grwa gnyis pa la phar phyin rdzogs nas dbu ma tshugs/ 'dzin grwa 'di nas phar phyin gyi rgyugs ring 'bul mkhan 'ga' byung / gzhan 'dra'o/ /dgung lo bzhi bcu ba gser 'phyang zhes pa me bya'i lo la yang / rje ba'ad pa'i zhal nas rje 'di la gsung chos dang smon lam rnams la khyod rang phebs gsung ba ltar gsung chos la skyes rabs so bzhi ba dang mkhas grub rje'i rnam thar gzigs pa lnga ldan gnang / dpon khu mtshan rnams kyi sku rim la mgon po'i gtor sgrub mdzad/ dpyid chos gnyis pa nas lam rim gyi gsung chos kyi 'khrid gnang / dbyar rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas rim lnga gsal sgron gyi gzab bshad dang mgon po'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa dang / 180

shog dril bcu gsum sogs mkhas grub rjes bsgrigs pa'i be'u bum phal cher gyi bshad lung / bstan rtsis sogs gsan/ 'di'i lor rigs grwa la 'gyed sngar las rgyas pa gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes la sku phyogs nas 'du khang steng du spos gsung pa ltar der gdan spos/ dgun chos kyi phar phyin ston mo'i dam bca' ba rnams la dri ba zhib par gnang nas the tshom gyi dri ma sel ba yang lo re ltar mdzad/lo 'dir grwa ba gsar zhugs kyi 'dzin grwa gsum pa la phar phyin rdzogs pas phar phyin gyi rgyugs rang 'bul mkhan 'ga' byung 'dzin grwa 'di la yang dbu ma tshugs/ dka' rams bsgres pa rnams la po ti lnga ku'i tshig bzhag song yang grwa ba gsar ba rnams la po ti lnga ka la 'chad nyan gyi gting tshugs pa zhig la dgongs nas/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal nas tshig bzhag gang myur myur gyis gsung ba ltar gsar zhugs kyi 'dzin grwa dang po la dbu ma rdzogs nas mdzod gnang / stag lor khri mdzad pa nas bzung ste lo snga phyi 'di dag gi bar du chos grwa re re yang 'chag mi srid par ma zad 'tshogs la yang chags med lta bur phebs nas 'grigs lam kun spyod 'don dbyangs rta thams cad zhib tu slob 181

paramadzad cing / lo 'di'i drug cu ba'i mkhar thab 'phen skabs rje 'dis rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs la yang thugs dmigs gnang dgos 'es zhus pa na/ de yis yongs su bstan pa la kutsha gyis thugs khur byed dgos/ rje rin po che'i yang de ltar mdzad pa ni rtogs brjod bdun legs ma ltar yin gsung nas shin tu dgyes par mdzad/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa khyi'i lor smon lam la/ rje bzhad pa 'i zhal snga nas zhag gcig gnyis thig phebs/ gsung chos la skyes rabs dang lam rim gnang zhing / de nas rje bzhad pa'i zhal nas/ de ring gter 'thon par 'gro rgyu yin/ rje 'di la khyed kyis ba/sung choyokyi 'phro gnang nas gsung chos dang smon snyepam rgyas par gyis gsung ba ltar smon lam la phebs/ smon lam grol nas rje 'di rje bzhad pa'i zhabs phyi la gter khar phebs pa la/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal nas rje 'di la khyod kyis brkos gsungs pas/ gter brag 'khor gzhan gyis cher rko ma nus shing khong tsho zhe sun yod skabs su/ rje 'dis ches myur bar phug ring bo zhig brkos nas de ru gter btocha tshul la yang thun mong min pa'i lo rgyus yod pa zur tsam zhig thos kyang 182

'dir bri ma nus/ de nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs dpyid chos snga phyi la tshig bzhag dang gsung chos sngar ltar mdzad/ dbyar dus rje bzhad pa'i drung nas dpa' sre rab 'byams pa don grub dang ma gyi bla ma sogs dang mnyam du 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhad dang / paṇa chen gyi drug cu ba chen mo'i zhwa lu ba'i rtsa tshig sogs kyi man ngag gsan/ rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs nas grwa mang la sred rgyud lugs kyi gsang 'jigs gnyis kyi bskyed rim gyi khrid mdzad skabs/ nub mo rmi lam na rwa lo chen po yin zer/ btsun pa 'gying bag can gzugs mtho ba sha rtsa dkar ba lo sum cu'i dkyil la sleb tshod snyam pa cig la mjal byin rlabs byung ba rmis pa rje la yang zhus/ yang bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs/tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa'i de'isgrub thabs/ rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i de'i sgrub thabs chu gtor dang / de'i rnam bshad kyi lung gsan/ sred rgyud lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chen gsan/ dbyar chos kyi chos mtshams la dpon 183

slob sangs rgyas kyi yab gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la rje 'di gdan 'dren zhus/ rje 'di'i zhal nas nga mi 'gro gling bsre dang rigs grwa thon yong gsung ba na/ sbyin bdag gis rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du zhus pas/ sku phyogs kyi zhal nas bla ma song chog rigs grwa dang grwa tshang yang skyongs dgos zhes bka' phebs/ de nas rje 'di gling ngos la phebs gshin po la/ bsngo smon yang dag gnang / sbyin bdag gis 'bul ba dang / bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas/ slar yang bkra shis 'khyil du bdun pa'i chos la phebs/ de nas rbo tshang chos mdzad kyi gong ma gshegs nas der rje 'di gdan 'dren zhus pas/zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes la gling ngos la phebs/ de de'i dgongs rdzogs dang mgon po'i gtor bsgrubs bdun phrag gcig mdzad pa'i skabs tho rangs shig dang por rgya chen thob pa mang du btsal/ /rab du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams pa shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas ba'i ched du bsngos/ /tshul 'di bsam zhing 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /bka' drin che'o rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /zhes dbyangs snyan po 'then 181

gin yod pa cig rmis pa na/ mnal sad byung gsung ngo / /sbyin bdag gis 'bul ba gya rnam pas bkur ste byas/ zhal las rbo tshang gis da dung gtor bsgrubs shig thub na legs po zhig 'ong rgyur 'dug gsung kyang phyis su thog tu ma song / slar bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ rje bzhad pa'i mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs pa mang po'i las slob mdzad/chos mtshams la bsnyen rdzogs pa rnams la rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i mdzad pa'i dge slong gi bslab bya'i steng nas bslab bya rnams legs par khrid/ ston 'dir srod chos la 'dzin grwa gong ma rnams la skabs brgyad pa'i tshig bzhag gnang bas mtshon/ lo re bzhin du srod chos la chag med du 'dzin grwa gong ma rnams la skabs brgyad pa rgyas pa'am/ yang na po ti lnga ku'i dka' gnas rnams thugs thog nas zur bkol byas te gnang ba dang / bar ma rnams la don bdun cu/bsdus grwa rnams la spyi'i nyer mkho'i rigs bsdus kyi tshig bzhag gnang ba phal cher chag med ltar mdzad/ lo 'dir ming btags gsar du tshugs pa'i ming btags pa rnams la zhal bkod gnang sbyin gang drag mdzad/ lo mjug tu lcags mkhar 'phangs pa la/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal 185

snga nas dgyes te/ bstan pa spyi'i don yin pas bsod nams che gsung ngo / /dgung lo zhe gnyis bsgyur byed ces pas phag lo'i smon lam skabs rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas grwa mang dang lhan gcig tu 'khrungs rabs dang rje bzhad pa'i dge lugs chos 'byung bi mgo gnyis gsan/ sos ka rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas legs bshad snying po dang dbus mtha'i 'grel ba 'grel bshad sogs gsan/dbyar 'dir chos grwa'i gsung chos la lam rim chen mo'i mjug rdzogs nas yang mgo brtsams nas gnang / de nas rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs sku 'bum du phebs pa'i lam skabs nas/ rje 'di la gsung bskur de mgon po'i gtor bsgrubs kyis zhes gsung ba ltar/ rje 'dis gtso mdzad nas zhi ba'i gtor bsgrubs mdzad pa'i thun re re la bskang ba tshar gsum re/ bskang tshar re la bshags pa tshar gsum re bzlog pa tshar re/ nyin re la ma mtha' dbyangs chen re 'then pa mdzad de bdun phrag gcig tu bsgrubs/ de nas zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs pa la/ rje 'dis gtso mdzad nas chibs bsu la phebag lam bar du rje 'di'i ja thab 18/3

ston mo gang rgyas zhus pas/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas shin tu mnyes po mdzad pa la/ rje 'dis nga rang bsod nams che snyam du dgongs gsung / de rjes dgu ba nas bcu ba'i bar du rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed dpal gcig dang / chos rgyal gnyis kyi sbyin sreg gnang ba'i tshe rje 'dis byang 'dren mdzad gsol dpon gyis mchod g.yog byas/ de dus rje 'di gcig pu rwa chen pos/ gsod pa'i mtshon cha snying la gab/ /khar brgyud yi ger ma bkod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mngon spyod shin tu drag po'i man ngag rab tu gces shing phangs pa brgyud ldan dam pa'i zhal kho na la rag las pa/ bstan dgra'i srog bdud/ gshin rje'i snying khrag lta bu'i thugs kyi bcud byung ba rnams/ 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i grub dbang bsnyen pa'i rwa rtse cher sbom pa/ rgya bston rin po che'i rtog bdun rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud grol gyi steng nas/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum spyi dang / khyad par bsnyen grub las gshin sprel ba'i las sbyor ha la nag po'i shog dril gsum dang /rwa lugs kyi sbyin sreg rnams dang sbyar te/ man ngag lhag ma med par gnang / gzhan yang gsar rnying gi liṅga 'bri tshul gyi khyad par dang /187

bsgral las kyi dmigs rim dang liṅga sngags can dang sngags med kyi khyad par/ sngagasacan la yang mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa rnams zhib —par khrid/ mkhas grub bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bskyed rim chen mo 'khrul 'khor dang sbrags nas zhib khrid dang / paṇa chen rin po che'i mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i 'khrul 'khor mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i man ngag rno khyad dang bcas pa 'di sngar nas bris 'dug kyang 'di dus su —lhag khyad 'ga' zhig snang bar sems/ mdor na drag las gcig pu yang zla ba gcig gi bar du khrid pa'i tshul 'di nyid kyis kyang / snyigs dus kyi bstan 'gro'i srog shing zla med pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bcu drug zhabs kyis gar stabs bskyod pas/ nag phyogs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms pa'i mnga' bdag gcig pur/ bla ma'i rnam rol 'jigs mdzad snyems pa'i rdo rjes bkas dbang bskur bar gor ma chag go /'di lor 'du khang steng gi tshon rtsi de zhal mthil shing rnams grub/ lo mjug gi lcags mkhar lo gzhan la phyi sgrub la brten nas mdzad kyin yod kyang / lo 'di la rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas kyis sre rgyud lugs kyi 188

chos rgyal nang sgrub dang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma gnyis sbrags pa'i tshul ltar khrid/ de lugs kyi man ngag zhal shes rnams rje 'di la gnang / phyag len dkyus ma rnams rgan pa 'ga' zhig la yang gnang nas/ 'di ltar sgrubs gsung ba bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i mtshams nang nas sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i 'tshub shin tu che yang ltas khyad par can byung ba ltar/ pha rol gyi phyogs rnams ring bo ma 'gyang bar mi mthun pa'i dpung gis thal bar brlag song / rje 'di'i gtor ma 'phen skabs/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal nas/ a tsas bla ma'i nus pa la ltos dang yul khams gcig brlag song gsung zhing 'di dus na sngon mkhas grub chen po tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas/ lta log bon po'i mgo la tshad mda' brgyab/ /brgya phyed mkha' spyod gnas su badzra mu/ /nga rgyal shes 'dod blo ni ma mchis kyang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched du nyams su blangs/ /da dung mngon spyod 'di nyid bgyid snying 'dod/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par chos brgyad snang shas dri mas dben ning bstan pa kho na thugs la bcags te mngon spyod rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ltar mdzad pas/ thugs kyi nyams rtogs dang dga' ba'i sim pa 189

rnams mchog tu rgyas so/ /dgung lo zhe gsum pa kun ldan zhes pa lcags byi la/ rje 'dis rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs la smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs dgos zhes nan cher zhus kyang / rje bzhad pa'i zhal nas nga rang mtshams la sdod rgyu yin/ khyod kyis smon lam dang gsung chos rgyas pa gyis zhes bka' gnang bas/ rje 'dis snga dro skyes rabs dang 'bum ṭika gsungs/ phyi dro smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs bsngo smon rgyas par gnang / zla ba dang po'i nang nas rje bzhad pa'i sku bsgung tshul bstan pa la/ rje 'dis sku phyogs la 'bul ba chen po phul/ sgrol dkar gyi ras ris dngul gyis bris pa cig kyang phul ba la/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i phyogs la 'di ltar byas pa gtso cher rang la lta ba yin/ dngul rin po che 'bring yin pas khyod rang la tshe 'bring cig 'ong dngul mdangs bzang por 'dug pag sdod ring la bstan par phan thog bzang yong gsung / de dus sku rim chen po bsgrubs gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ shā sa na sgrubs gsung ba ltar rje 'dis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de gtor chen rgyud lugs ltar brtsegs nas dpon slob bdun cus nyi ma bcu la shā sa na bye ba lhag 190

bsgrubs/ mjug tu btor ma rgyud pa bla ma mkhas mchog ges 'phangs/ rje 'dis mtshan lam la khyi ser skya zhig gi thod pa ga ler dras te bsad zhwa rmis/ sku gesas lob ltas su 'dus pas sku bsnyung dwangs/ dpyid chos gnyis pa nas shā/ma rim gyi gsung chos gnang /a 'gar sku skyes rje 'di'i 'bas drung du dbu ma nyan pa ra yo/nga / de'i tsunus nas 'dzin grwa song ma 'ga' dang bcas pa la dbu ma'i bshad pa rgyas par gnang ba'i dus su/ lha yi me tog gi char gyis 'dzin ma khyab par babs shing / dbyar skyes rnga gsang gi rol rma cher bsgralas nga tsu sas/ rten 'brel lebs pa la rje 'di dgyes nas snyan dngags kyi 'a ma nas chul de la bsngags pa mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad cig kyang —gnang yod/ lo 'dir gro tshang dpon po yang yod pas de'i zhus nas/ sgro la ca/ nyer loci4 gi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig gamang / dbyar thog rje bzhad pa'i 'bas drung nas 'jam/ dbyangs rtsi sto sbrags sgrubs kyi rilas mang ngo dang / rnam sra sa ma/dung dmar can gyi rjes gnang sosas chos skor yongs rdzogs sasan/ lo 'angir dkakha bcu'i rtsa/tshan btags saca/na du btsugs/ dbyar chos kyi steng du /91

mtshan btags pa rnams kyis dam bca' bzhag drug pa'i nyi shu gsum nas grwa ba gling bsre dang / bdun brgyad gnyis la bla ma gling bsre byas/ lo 'dir rigs grwa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas/ rigs grwa'i tshogs la gdan 'dren zhus te/ blo rig gi tshogs lang rigs spamakhas pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / dge bshes chen po don 'grub seng ge gnyis la bzhag yod pa snga bsnur byas nas nyin 'dir lang rgyu byas/ de nas rje 'di rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas gdan 'dren du phebs pa la sku phyogs kyis zhal nas de ring si tshogs lang ci yin gsung / rje 'dis rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa yin zhus pas/ rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas shin tu dgyes nas/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /don byed nus par gnas pa ni/ /mi bslu zhes gsungs yod ang gsungs nas 'phros kyi tshis yang yang gsung gin 'dug zhes thos/ de nas tshogs la phebs pa'i dus/ rje 'dis dung dkar po gcig la kha dar ring po btags/ chibs dkar po gcig gos dar rta nor ja ras sogs phyag rdzas kyi dngos po phul du phyin pa'i mchod sprin kun bzang dang 'gran pa spros shing / tshogs 192

lang yang thin tu legs pa dang / nyin der a bar ri khrod pas tshogs la 'o dang shing tog mang po drangs ba sogs rten 'brel le4sa par 'grigs pas rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs mchog tu dgyes/ rje 'di'i thugs la sku phyogs kyis 'di ltar dgyes po mdzad pa ni bdag thugs la btags / sku phyogs dgyes pa'i mthus rigs grwa yang yun ring du gnas snyam nas/ mchog tu spro bas thugs ngoms par gyur to / /phyogs mtha' khyab pa'i snying rje'i rtsa ba can/ /dmigs med sems kyi rin chen gzhung shing drung / /phyin drug yal ga bsdu bzhi'i 'bras dud pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin dpag bsam ljon pa khyod la 'dud/ /chos sku ro gcig spangs rtogs mnyam nyid dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro 'a/ thugs rje mnyam snyom pa/ /cher snyigs mtha' 'khob phyogangs 'dir shākya'i bstan/ /spel la rgyal ba kun las khyod nyid lhag /lhag bas ma ches dkar zla zhun dkyil 'khor nya/ /rmongs pa'i gdung sel zegs ma 'bum phrag 'phro/ /bstan dang 'gro bde'i kunda gcig char bzhad/ /zla med smra ba mchog khyod kun phan dngos/ /shugs drag bsgrub pa 'i snying rus ma bskyed nyid/ /ngan sngags rdzas sbyor rten 'brel ma 1 93

bsgrigs kyang / snying rje'i gsang sngags rim gnyis ting 'dzin mthus/ /sdig can dpung mang 'joms pa'i dgra thabs mkhas/ /gtsug tor rtse na bshes gnyen zur phud 'dzin/ /snying gi padmor lhan skyes dbyangs can 'dzug /ljags yangs dkyil nas mtsho byung rgyud mang 'khrol/ /zab don dbyangs can skal bzang rna ba'i dpyid/ /de nas dbyar smad rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas dpon po chung ba dang mnyam du mgon po'i bsrung bzlos bsang gsum dang gtan 'don gyi man ngag chi ga rgyud ma gsan/ de rjes rje nyid kyis khrid chen brgyad sogs gsan/ smon lam gyis ming btags pa mtshan nyid kyi grwa ba bzhi rgyud pa ba gcig dang lnga yod pa'i/ mtshan nyid kyi dam bca' ba bzhi la rjes khyod rang bcas sku phyogs la skyabs 'jus zhus/ nga'i rmi lam la tshogs nas rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi bstod pa 'don kyin yod pa chad 'gro ba cig rmis/ khyod rang tsho'i dam bca' la bar chad cig yod pa e yin gsung ba/ rjes su rje bzhad pa'i zhal snga nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i ltas su 'dug so/ lo mjug rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed 194

kyi zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg sanang ba'i phyag g.yog mdzad/ rje 'dis sku phyogs la lo 'dir drug cu ba 'phen pa bzhag nas sbyin sreg byas na zhus pas/ de mi yong lcags mkhar phyin chad ma chag pa byed dgos gsungs nas/ lo dus ltar lcags ca/khar 'phangs so / /dgung lo zhe bzhi ba 'phar ba zhes pa lcags glang la rje 'dis rje ba'ad pa'i zhal snga nas smon lam du phebs dgos zhus pa la rje'i zhal nas/ da mi phebs khyod rang rnams kyis smon lam gang rgya4kyis phyin chad byams chos re yang thod gsungs pa ltar/ rje 'dis smon lam la snga dro skyes rabs dang brgyad stong 'grel chen gagu/ngas/ phyi dro smon lam rgyas par banang / bcu drug la smon lam grol nas rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung du phebs bskung 'dri zhus pas/ bsnyung gzhi la skyon med khyod rang mtshams su sdod la sku rim gyis gsung yang / rje 'di'i sku phyogs kyi sku nyam pa 4 ngan pa gzigs nas ma/tshams ma gnang bar sku phyogs kyi zhabs brtan la mang ja mang po btang sku rim nan cher bsgrubs shing / nyi shu gcig nas bzung nam sang gi bar du rje 'dis gtso mdzad nas grwa ba mang pos/ mabon po'i gtor chen rgyud lugs ltar brtsesas nas shā sa 195

na bye ba bsgrubs pa'i mtshams nang nas nyin re bzhin drug cu ba dang bzlog pa drag cu mdzad/ de dus ltas ngan rgyu rang ma byung yang rjes thugs 'phen btang tshar ba'i dus yin 'dug pas de la nga las lhag pa sus kyang thabs ci yod gsung zhing / nyer dgu la gtor ma 'phangs gnam gang la grol/ de nas tshes gsum la rje 'dis phyag rdzas gang yod zhabs brtan du phul nas/ nga rang gis dbus nas khyed kyi rjes ded yong ba yon tan la re ba byas pa yin pas da dung thugs la btags nas yun ring bzhugs dgos zhes zhus pa na/ de bden cung zad re na ba la skyon med re zhig bsdad chog gsung / de nas tshes lnga'i snga dro la dpon po rab 'byams pas zhal bkod cig gnang dgos zhus pa la lan ma gnang / de'i tshe rje 'di'i nga rang tsho la 'al bkod cig cis kyang gnang dpos zhus/ pas/ zhal 'dzum pa cig mdzad nas khyod rang gi tshe gang bo la 'chad nyan gyis gsungs so/ /de 'phral 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gzugs sku'i snang ba chos dbyings su nye bar bsdus pa'i sku gdung gi mdun du/ bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du dngos bsharma sa yid sprul gyi mchod sprin dpag 196

tu med pa spros nas/ nyin re zhing spyan 'dren khrus gsol sku bstod smon lam bstan 'bar ma rnams dang / tshogs su yang 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs bzang spyod rnams gsungs pa'i srol btsugs/ rje 'di'i zhal nas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa na yang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gtso bo ni 'khor lo gnyis kyi bya ba yin zhes de la brtson par mdzad pa ltar/ bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gtso bo bshad sgrub yin gsung nas/ dpyid chos de nyid nas tshig bzhag dang rtsod grwa sogs chos dmar bor mdzad do/ /zla ba gsum pa la dpon ju nang gi sras mo kun dga' rab brtan gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la rje 'di spyan drangs nas rab brtan no yon gyi ur rges la phebs/bdun phrag gcig bzhugs nas kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas sdig sgrib sbyangs zhing dge rtsa rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos nas mi zad pa'i gter du bsgyur/ de nas dpon tshang nas gdan 'dren zhus/ rtse gzhung la phebs dpon tshang gis sku rim zhus pa la mgon 197

po'i gtor chen gyi sgo nas shā sa na bsgrubs mjug tu gtor ma 'phangs/ dpon ju nang dang dpon mo rnam rgyalaganyis la mgon po bar chad kun gsal gyi rjes gnang dang / grub rgyal ma'i lusas kyi tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang bskur/ dpon tshang nas bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba phun sum tshogs pa phul/ rje nas zla ba de'i tshes bcu dgu'i tho rangs khar rje bla ma khri thog na bzhugs nas bdag la khyod kyis chos bzhi shod dang thin tu mkhas par yong / deng sang dbyangs gsal la khyod las mkhas mi 'dug gsungs/ dbyangs gsal ni stong nyid yin mam snyams pa shar byung / ngas chos po ti bzhi yin nam zhus pas/ po ti bzhi yin cho/da khyod re zhig sdod la rang re tsho la ltos pa'i gdul bya tsho'i don gyib / ngas kyang mig mchi ma dang bcas legs so/ /tshe rabs thams cad du nga'i dge ba'i bathes gnyen mdzad par zhu zhes sasol ba 'debs kyin 'dug pa rmis de nas zla ba de'i nyi shu'i nang du bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ lo 'dir lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung rdzogs nas spyod 'jug si bshad pa gnang / 'chad nyan rigs grwa sogs snga ra 'a sa kyang lhag nga ra rgyas su btang / dpon tshang gi sku rim /98

la mgon po'i zhi ba'i gtor sgrub mdzad ston 'dir rje 'di yun ring bsnyung nas bsnyung gzhi'i mjug ma dwangs pas/ rje bla ma la gsol ba btab pas thang cig rmi lam na rje bla ma de nyid phebs nas/ da phyin chad bya ba gang 'dra zhig la thugs kyang mgon po la gsol ba thob dang grogs byas yong gsungs pas de ltar byed gsung ngo/ /snga mchod la zhal zas rgya mtsho ma dang bcas pa mchod pa rgyas par bshams grwa ba 'ga' zhig la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi las rung gi bsnyen pa gyis gsung nas las rung gi bsnyen pa byas pa'i mjug tu sku mdun nas kha skong gi sbyin sreg mnyam tu mdzad de phyag len bslabs/ dgung lo zhe lnga ba dga' byed ces pa chu stag gi lo'i smon lam la zhal zas rgya mtsho saugs mchod pa rgyas par gnang / sasung chos la skyes rabs dang rgyud bla ma sasungs/ nub gcig gi rmi lam du rje 'jam dbyangs bla ma rang nyid phebs bka' shog 'di chos skyongs kyis bskur ba yin zer gnang byung / ngas blangs nas 'di'i nang na ci yod zhus pas/ da phyin chad khyod la sus kyang gnod pa mi byed zer ba yin gsungs/ ngas legs so sus brtsis yong shas chung yang 'dzin 'dug zhus pas/ bzhad 199

nyams kyis bsdigs stangs mdzad nas mi rtsi phyin chu srin gyi sder mo 'di btab yong gsung nas phyag gdengs byung ba rmis/ de phyin chad sems ngan 'chang ba bdag la mi mtsham pa yongs nas/ rang shugs kyis dbang du 'du ba byung ngo / /skabs shig rje gong ma'i gcung rab 'byams pa zhi zhing dul la zhen chags chung ba rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi lha du ma'i bsnyen pa tshad du song ba zhig yin 'dug pas/ de nyid kyi drung nas rje 'dis rje gong ma nas brgyud pa'i mgon po bka' bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang / rnam sras bka' bco lnga'i rjes gnang / lha mo'i rjes gnang / snar thang brgya rtsa'i lung rjes/ gnang / rwa bod/ be bum sogs gcig rgyud mang po dang / sher phyin sna tshogs/ nyi khri/ brgyad stong pa rnams gsan/ lo 'dir dpon tshang gi bka' 'gyur la rab gnas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad/ dpyad chos gnyis pa nas spyod 'jug gi bshad pa dang tshig bzhag sogs gang rgyas gnang / grwa mang gi 'dzin gshar sbyangs rtsod grwa rnams shin tu 'phel bo byung / chos mtshams 'ga' zhig la tsa yu ri khrod pa tshogs gnyis rab 'byams pas zhus nas grwa mang dang bcas pa la lam rim 200

dmar khrid gsung / smon sems cho gas 'dzin pa sogs kyi phyag len rgyas par bslabs/ phyogs so so nas chos la nyan par 'ong ba'i bla chen rnams dang grwa rgan mang po la dpyil 'khor gyi thig sogs khrid/phyogs pa rnams dang grwa mang la sre rgyud lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed rim khrid dang / gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khrid/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ 'pho khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi lung gnang / chos mtshams 'ga' zhig la dka' rams dang grwa rgan bsnyen pa song ba 'ga' zhig la sku mdun nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug len tshul gyi phyag len bslabs zhing /chos mtshams phal cher la rje nyid kyis/ bdag 'jug len par mdzad do/ /de 'phral btsugs shing nang du dbyangs rwa la rje phebs te smad rgyud lugs kyi mgon chos gnyis kyi dbyangs chen rdzogs pa slobs par mdzad/ 'di nas bzung ste dbyangs rwa yang rgyun chags su byung /'di lo drug pa'i nyer brgyad la gtor chen brtsegs nas byin 'bebs byas/ nyer dgu'i nyin ril bor tshogs kyi 'grigs lam dbyangs sogs phal cher smad rgyud ltar byas/ dgong mo gtor ma 'phangs/201

gnam gang la yang zho ston ma sa/togs gzhan phal cher smad rgyud lugs ltar mdzad pa'i srol gsar du btsugs pa'i gtang rag byas pa'i mtshan mo rje 'dis mnal lam du snying shun pa can cig byung /shun pa snying gi rtse ngos nas phral na bsam yang / snying snod do4/ nas kha bas phral nas bshus ba'i nang na/ ze'u 'brus rnam pa 'a kha dog dmar nag can gyi zas bzang po zhig gis gang 'dug nga rang gis zos pas shin tu ro zhim pa myong ma myong ba zhig 'dug ba gzhan gcig gnyis la yang cung zad re ster rtsis byed pa mi/ga 'di nas bzung ste lo re bzhin du rigs grwa'i mgor gtor chen rgyun ldan du btsags rigs grwa sngar las rgyas su btang / rigs grwa'i chos thos 'di la chos grwa nas zla med ston pa ma/ dben sa lugs kyi bla ma'i mol 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum dang / rje rin po ches mkhas grub rje la gnang pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gcig brgyud ma/ rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs rnams gnang / ston ka rje 'di gzims med par yu na ring log zhing thugs la skyo shas drag pos nyin ma/tshan med par khyab pas mi gzhan gyi spyod tshul la skyon pa'i spyod tshul ltar thugs byung nas / nyin 202

mtshan kun tu ltung bshags dang spyi bshags bzang spyod sogs smon lam mang po gsung nas phyag rkyang gnang bag ga mang thugs 'jigs nas zhabs brtan gyi rim gro mang bo bsgrubs/ grwa tshang spyi bsdus kyis zhabs brtan 'bul skabs rgyud pa bla ma hor dang / rab 'byams pa bstan pa gnyis kyis gser zho 'ga' zhig zhabs brtan gyi snan pa gyis ces sger du phul/ rgyud pa bla ma dba' sre bas byur dkar gyi phreng ba legs pa gcig sogs tshan grangs bcas grwa mang dang lhan du phul/rab 'byams pa phun tshogs lha bris pa dang 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rnams kyis mtshon pa'i bka' rams 'ga' zhig dang grwa tshang 'di'i thog ma'i grwa rgan rnams kyi gtso byas pa'i grwa mang gis thugs khur mdzad nas/ rang rang se gces nor ci yod g.yo med par phul te thams cad kyis snying thag pa nas mgrin gcig tu gsol ba phur tshugs su/ khyad kyis spyir rje'i bstan pa dang / khyad par du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i bstan pa thugs la 'dzin dgos/ lhag tu nga rang rnams kyi re ltos 'cha' sa khyed gcig pa yin pas/ thugs rjes gzigs nas zhabs pad yun ring du brtan par bzhugs dgos 203

zhes zhu yig phul ba na/ rje'i zhal nas sku phyogs la brtan bzhugs zhus pa ltar/ nga rang dbang ma thob pa la brtan bzhugs phul ba ni ngo tsha gtad pa yin 'dug 'on kyang rang gi chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma la mchod na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i phan yon thob par gsungs yod pas/ khyod rang tsho la bsod nams yod/ thos bsam las lhag pa'i zhabs brtan med pas khyed rnams kyis slob gnyer la 'bad na/ sku phyogs kyis nged la chems gnang dus rjes 'jam dbyangs chos rje la tshems gnang pa'i dpe gsung zhing 'jam dbyangs chos rje 'bras spungs bskyangs pa ltar khyod kyis grwa tshang 'di skyongs dgos gsung pa dang / da dung gsung gzhan cig kyang yod pas de dag la bsam na re zhig mi 'chi ba 'dra gsung / de dus rgyud pa bla ma dpa' sre bas rje'i sku phyogs kyi zhabs brtan la 'bul ba bzang po phul sku mdun du bsnyun 'dri mdzad pa la/ rje'i zhal nas thugs la skyo shas drag po byung tshul dang / mnal lam du cung har rgyal po hung tha'i jis brag mgon po'i thad kyi thang na dmag sgar btab nas 'dug sung tha'i ji dgyes nas bdag rkyen byas yod snyam nas 204

thugs gnas bas/ dgyes tshor yang mi byed cing mi dga' ba yang med par rang gar bzhugs 'dug pa cig rmis gsungs pa la/ lan du dba' sre bas thugs kyi skyo shas lam gyi rtogs pa 'khrungs ltas yin mod/ hung tha'i ji'i dga' nyams mi byed pa ni nyid kyis grags rgyal la ma log ris su bris nas/ 'bras spungs chos skyongs ma bris pas de'i ltas yin 'dra zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas ma bsgoms pas skyo shas de 'dra skyes pa ni 'chi rtags yin par tshad ma'i gzhung nas bshad/gcig shos de ka yin las che gsung ngo / /de yang rje 'dis byams khang dang gdung khang rnams kyi ngo zhal byed bcug pas/ gdung khang g.yon gyi sgo steng du rje gong mas shog bu la grags rgyal ma'i sku cig phyag ris mdzad nas sbyaraglod pa/ zhal ra'i 'og tu song ngam ma nges nas de'i dod la rje 'dis grags rgyal ma'i log ris drir bcug pas chos skyongs kyis phrag dog yin 'dra dgongs nas/ de nas lha bris la byams khang gi g.yas kyi sgo steng du 'bras spungs chos skyongs khog zhugs kyi rnam pa can bris gsung ba ltar bzhengs/ brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul ba'i gser rab 'byams pa bzod pa la gnang nas do dam 205

gyis la rje bzhad pa'i sku gdung gi tog gi nyi ma bzhengs gsungs pa ltar/ des kyang bal bo la mgyogs por bzo bor bzo bcug nas grub/ chas ka gzhan rnams kyis tshe dpag med kyi sku stong bzhengs dgos gsung nas de ma thag tu bzhengs su bcug de'i nyin phyi ma nas rje rang gi dbu mdzad nas grwa ba sum cu lhag cig gis mgon po'i rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub zhag dgu'i bar du bsgrubs/ nyin sngon ma zhig la gnod sbyin 'chams dbyangs 'then skabs shig zer tho la snang yang / zhal bzhugs ring la gtor sgrub/ gtor chen sogs gang btsugs skabs sha ra ma chags med du 'then gsung nan cher mdzad pas/ sha ra ma 'then skabs gzigs snang byung ba yin snyam rje 'dis nyams snang la dom chen po zhig gis mchu rje'i mdun cog la gtugs nas sna su ru ru byed cing mjug ma tshom mdor thug pa/ spu mdog legs la zhi zhing dul ba cig yun ring du gzigs pas/ de nas bzung ste nyin re bzhin gnod sbyin 'chams dbyangs then gsungs pa ltar gtor sgrub kyi dus chag med dang / lo 'di nas bzung zhal bzhugs kyi bar la rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub yang chag med gnang / de 206

dus grwa mang gis da lo'i gsang chos rnams kyi mjug rdzogs nas mgo ma btsugs pas/ rnam rtog byung zhus pa na ston chos kyi chos grwa phebs nas chos thun gcig la spyod 'jug bslab btus bzhi brgya ba legs bshad snying po bzhi'i maso nas/ cung shad re gsu/ngas zhing / de dus rje 'dis rje bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab pa sa mnal lam du rje bla ma de nyid phebs nas nga'i khri'i thog tu bzhugs pa la ja zhus byas pas/bzhes 'phro gnang nas gsung mi 'byon par/ nga la shog ma gsung yang thugs la zhabs phyi la 'ong ba'i thugs bzhed 'dus pas/ phar dga' chen bar du zhabs phyi la song / mtshams gcig nas nga'i sems la gcig lus yod snang ba shar nas nga phyir 'o sa yong bas/de'i bar la rje phebs nas rjes mi zin snyams nas bsdad pa na sems la nga ma song ba la bka' bkyon e yong snyam pa 'dug kyang / de nas bzung gnyid yang byung / sems bde ru song / de ni rjes su dus 'khrug sogs byung nas/ dgon pa la sogs pa'i bya ba 'khog po 'di thog la 'ong bas shi na bzang ba'i brda' yin snyam gsung ngo / /de nas 'chad nyan sngar ltar mdzad/ dgun chos kyi chos ra tshams la 207

gtso'i sku skyes kyi bstan 'gyur rab gnas la gdan drangs/ gtso'i dgon pa'i grwa ba rnams kyis chibs bsu dang ser stengs byas/ bstan 'gyur la dge legs char 'bebs kyi sgo nas rab gnas rgyas pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad/ gtso'i rab brtan gyi bu zhig rab byung byas nas ming dge lesas rgya mtsho zhes btags nas nged la grwa rgyun la 'bul dgos gsung bas 'bul bar chad cing 'bul ba gya rnam pa phul/ nang khag so sos gdan drangs nas 'bul ba phul/dgon gyi grwa mang dang mjal ba mang po la so so'i 'dod chos dang /khyim pa mang po la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa gnang nas nges legs dang byang chen ci rigs pa'i sa bon nye bar bskrun par mdzad do/ /phyir la tsa yu lung ba nas zhag bzhugs mdzad pa'i phebs khar chibs 'grogs nas phyag phreng 'thor ba'i rdog po gnyis mi dad pa can gnyis kyi rnyed nas sbas pa/ 'khor rnams kyis ma shes par btsal pa na rjes mkhyen nas de rnyed mkhan la phan gin chug 'gro gsung nas phebs/ de phyis su rje'i zhal nas tsa yu lung la gnod pa'i gdon zhed po gcig 'dug pas 'tshub red/ lan cig ngas mnal lam du gdon de rgya mtsho'i pha 208

rol du 'phen snyam nas/ shangs kyi sgo nas rlung spros te 'phangs pas/de tsam du 'phen ma nus/ lung ba gzhan zhig na sked pa chag nas 'dug pa rmis gsung / phreng rdog rnyed mkhan gnyis po sngar rigs rgyud dkon pa gnyis yin kyang phyis su rigs rgyud byung snang ngo / /dgung lo zhe drug pa mdzes byed ces pa chu yos lo'i smon lam gyi dus skyes rabs dang rgyud bla ma gnyis gsungs/ dpyid chos gnyis pa nas legs bshad snying po gsung chos la gnang / rje bzhad pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan byams sku mthong ba don ldan gnyis dge legs char 'bebs ltar rab gnas rgyas pa mdzad/dngos gzhi la rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg mdzad dus chas 'jug gnang ba na dpal mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha zhig dngos su byon snyam pa ma gtogs mi phal ba'i rnam pa ni mi 'char bar 'dug rab gnas kyis mjug tu brtan bzhugs byed pa na/ i su bra tiṣṭha badzra ye sā hā/zhes pa'i skabs su rten so so'i drung du song ste me tog 'thor rgyu phyag len yin min gzhan la dris pas su yang ma nges 'dug yin na'ang da res de ltar byas song snyam nas byas pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam la rje nyid 209

kyis de ga yin gsung gyin 'dug gsung ngo/ /'di dus rje'i sku phyogs nas rab 'byams pa nam mkha' phun tshogs dang rab 'byams pa rin chen bstan 'dzin rnam gnyis las rje bzhad pa'i gsung rgyud gang yod bzhes shing / ga'an yang slob bu 'ga' zhig phyogs su btang nas rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i gsang 'bum skor sogs nyan du bcug nas nyid kyis gsan par mdzad do/ /dpyid chos gnyis pa nas legs bshad snying po gsungs/chos mtshams rnams su grwa mang la dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang / a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / 'jar/ babyangs nag po khyung khra/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / 'jam dbyangs nag po'i mngon rtogs/ sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i mngon rtogs/ rje'i mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub rdo rje'i tshigs spras/ dbyangs can ma'i ril sgrub/ tshe khrid kyi gdams pa/ 'brong rtse'i zhi khro sbrags sgrub/ dben 210

sa'i zhi khro sbrags sgrub gnyis/ chos skyong rgya mtsho'i zhi khro sbrags sgrub/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dbyangs can ma'i mngom rtogs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'jam dkar po sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa sgrol ljang gi sgrub thabs/ khyur khra'i sgrub thabs/ chu gtor gyi cho ga gnyis/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs/ rje'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ klu dbang rgyal po'i bum gter/ gsang pa'i rnam thar/ zla med ston pa ma rnams kyi lung gnang / dbu ma 'jug pa dang bzang spyod ltung bshags rnams dang / drag po sum dril gtad 'don/—'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ nga/ngon rtogs rgyan/ sher snying / gsang pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i khrid/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ bde ba can gyi 'pho khrid/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i smyung gnas cho sa kha sarpā ni'i sgrub thabs/ sanas bcu'i bstod pa/ rta mgrin gyi mngon rtogs rnams kyi lung gnang / skabs thig dpal 'khor chos sde'i dpon slob bkra shis rgya mtsho phebs te rje las dam chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skabs bzhes pas thugs rangs par gyur/yang thang chad bka' 'gyur bas chos srid kyi mchod sprin spros nas 211

legs bshad kyi skal ba yang blangs so/ /lo 'dir lnga dus su rje bzhad —pa'i zhal snga nas kyis bka' gnang ltar byams khang gi g.yas phyogs kyi gtsang khang du chos skyong rnams bzhengs par dgongs nas/ bzo bo mkhas shing dam tshig dang ldan pa a mgron ri khrod pas bzhengs pa'i mgo brtsams pa na/ rdo rje 'jigasabyed kyi nang rten la rje 'di la rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs nas gnang ba'i 'khor lo khyad 'phags dang ring srel gyi rigs mang po gzhug par mdzad/ rje rang nyid kyi spyan lam du man ngag ltar bri bsgrubs mdzad pa'i srog shing gzungs 'jug rnams tshad ldan dang / 'jim pa la yang rgyu dang man ngag nas 'byung ba'i rdzas dang khyad par du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i shangs khrag mang du bsres nas rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang / mgon po'i nang rten tu'ang rje gong ma la gnang ba'i srog 'khor gyi mtshon pa'i rten khyad 'phags mang bo dang / chos rgyal phyi sgrub la yang rten khyad 'phags mang bo dang / gnyis kur 'jim pa sogs sngar dang 'dra la/ gsum kur gzungs mang po gos dar ras shog bu sogs sna tshogs rje rang nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad pa dang /212

dka' rams nyi shu lhag gis zhag dgu'i rang la bri ba dang par la btab cing / skabs der ras 'gyed cig byung ba'i grwa ba phal cher gyi sku skal phul ba la bris pas/ 'jim pa sogs mtshon tsam las mi 'dug pa'i tshod du yod/ des na de lta bu'i rgyu phun tshogs las grub pa'i drag sku che ba gsum bzhengs pa grub nas bzo bo yon gyis mgu bar byas/ 'debs ris la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang khro bo bcu/ lha mo dang gnod sbyin bzhi/ phyogs skyongs bcu/ dpal mgon bdun cu/ chos rgyal nang sgrub dang gshin rje pho brgyad mo bcu gnyis/rnam sras sogs bzhengs pa/ lo phyi ma'i ston ka tshun chad la legs par grub/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes la dpon tshang gis rje 'di gdan drangs nas dpon mo rnam rgyal gyis gshed dmar gyi dbang zhus pa'i dus su/urges nas bdun phrag gcig la rje 'dis gshed dmar gyi bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg mdzad nas/ dpon mo dang chos rje sogs dpon g.yog lnga la gshed dmar gyi dbang chen gdang / de nas de'i grwa tshang gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi bla ma rnams dang / grwa mang gis zhus ngor rdo rje 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal gyi dbang chen gnang / de 213

ska ba(2 su bo shos thus mi bzang 'gas dkrugs gzhi la brten nas rgya dmag yo nga ba thos nas rje 'dis dmag bzlog la mason po'i gtor chen bdun phrag sacis la bsgrubs nas gtor ma 'phangs pas/ zung cu nas rgya dmag sog po'i ru snyer sleb tu nye ba phyir lob/ nas dpon tshang la el chi btang nas nga rang tsho mthun dgos tshul la ba byung ba ltar mthun po byung / rje la dpon tshang nas lebs 'bul phul nas bkra this 'khyil du phebs dbyar chos la 'chad nyan mdzad/ dka' rams 'ga' la bka' phebs nas bsang stod kyi phar kha tshur kha rnams su bkra this kyi gso thungs dang sa bslang ba shis brjod sogs byas mas de dag tu dgon pa'i mchod gzhi'i zhing 'debs dgos gsung ba ltar gso sbyongs sosas kyang byas/ rigs grwari dus dpon don 'grub dbang rgya' bsnyung nas rje gdan 'dren zhus pas rtser phebs/ mgon po'i zhi ba'i gtor sgrub mdzad pa'i zhor la dpon sras la bla mgon dbyer med/ mgon po bar chad kun sel/ grib sel sogs kyi rjes gnang mang po gnang / dpon tshang la mgon po'i bris sku zhig myur du las gsung ba ltar bzhengs nas gzigs pa phul bas/ 214

'khor rnams la smad dkris med pa la ma dgyes kyang rab gnas gnang / mgon po la rta nag g.yag nag lug nag sogs phyi rten mang po phul/ dpon sras la bum chu bsrung 'khor/ grub rgyalalugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang / khyung khra'i rjes gnang rnams gnang bas dpon sras kyi bsnyung gzhi phal cher dwangs rje la khong rang gis chibs gnyis kyi sa/tso byas legs 'bul gya nom pa phul/ chibs khyad 'phags cig dpon rgan gyis rje la dngul srang sum cu/ lug nyis brgya phul nas zhus pa phyir la gnang ba'i rta de chibs nas rjes sor mtsho kha'i dmag las thar ba yin 'dug de dus rjes dpon sras dgon par phebs nas sku rim byas na bzang gsung nas/ phebs khar dpon rgan la khyed kyis spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / mtsho sngon gyi la rgya gang la yang thugs bsam gnang dgog de'i nang nas tshur kha'i dpon khag 'di rnams la thugs bsam gnang dgos gsung ngo / /de nas dpon sras dang lhan cig bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas dpon sras la sku mtshams byed du bcug tshogs nas mgon po'i gtor chen gcig btsugs/ ston chos la 'chad nyan mdzad de'i chos 215

mtshams la mtsho kha'i dmag dpon tshang steng du sleb nye ba rig nas dpon sras rtser phebs/ skabs der nyin gcig snga dro chos grwar 'tshogs rje yang phebs nas sgrol ma mang po gsu nga pa'i mjug tu rje 'dis tshogs gtam gnang nas/ yul phyogs 'dir ci 'dra zhig byung yang nga rang tsho'i dgon pa 'dir skyon mi 'ong / sku phyogs kyi gsung la bod kyi gtam dper mchod rten mgo mjug log kyang bang rim dbus ma dbus su 'ong ba las 'os med zer ba ltar/ 'dzam gling 'jig la thug kyang nga'i dgon pa 'di re zhig sa cung zad cig la brten te bsdad yod gsung yod pas khyed rang tshos brda' phyogs ma byed gsung / phyis su thos pa na nyin der dpon tshang gi dmag pham nas mi bzang po 'ga' zhig gi dpon yab sras gnyis kyi chibs kha nas khrid/'ga' zhig gis phyi nas dmag bkag pas dpon yab sras sku nye zho med par dmag nang nas thon 'dug pas de'i sku rim du dmigs par go de nas ring bo ma 'gyang par dgon par slebs byung /rje'i mdun du phebs pa la gsol ja zhus pa'i gsol can yang mi 'dug pas rje nyid kyi bzhes can gnang / dpon mo rnams kyang de 216

nyin dgon par slebs/ dpon gyi rje la khong rang gis dmag la 'thab tshul sogs zhib rgyas zhus nas/ da mi khong dgon pa nas mi 'gro mtsho sngon po'i aha dos rnams la ngas gnod pa byas pa med kyang nged la 'di 'dra byas/ nga'i shangs su rug la ma bzod pa yin/ de'i khong tsho'i chum pa yod gsung pa la/ rje 'dis do nub rab gsal nas gzims sang nas phebs na bzang gsung / de nas rje'i zhal bkod ltar grwa ba 'gal zhig gi ge sar rdo rtags nas so byas/ 'ga' zhig gi ltag sgo nas chibs bsrung phyi nyin nyi ma shar ba na dpon yab sras rje'i drung du mjal/ rje 'dis chibs gnyis sogs phul zhal bkod rgyas par gnang nas phebs skabs/ rje'i sku sked la rtsa 'gyus byung nas phebs dka' ba byung ba phyis su rgya nas dpon sras bsnyung lci ru song ba'i ltas su snang / de'i tshe gzims khang sgor nan cher byas phebs nas dpon yab sras la kha dar gnang nas myur du nga rang tsho 'phrad yong / kha dar gyi lan de dus 'bul dgos gsung nas tshur phul ba'i kha dar ma bzhes pa na/ dpon gyi zhal nas da lan kha dar ma bzhes na nged kyi sems mi bde bar 'dug rjes su tshur phebs dus kha 217

ོdar dang / skyes khyad 'phags bcas 'bul zhus nas kha dar phul te phyag mdzad nas phebs pa la/ rje 'dis 'du khang steng nas spyan ras kyis btsas te skyel ma mdzad do/ /shāka seng bstan pa lnga phrag drug pa'i dus/ /dus gsum rnam 'dren kun gyi mkhyen brtse las las can byang shar dpal mgon khyod bskrun tshe/ /tshe rabs sbyangs pa'i lus/ can bag chags sad/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gi gnyen po yis//chos mngon bstan pa slar yang byang shar gyi/ /nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'dzin dgongs nas/ /ngur smrig gsar ba'i zlos gar ci yang mdzad/ /ris med 'gro ba'i gnyen khyod mtha' 'khob kyi/ /gzu lum spyod pa lhur len mig mdzad na/ /mtha' yas mar gyur dmus long kho bo cag /mig bu su la 'cha' zhes phrag dog risas/ /lung rtogs bstan pa 'i nyi ma khyod nyid kyis/ /thub bstan bcu gnyis gling kun cig car gsal/ /zab dang rgya che'i dbyar gyi rnga gsang gis/ /skal ldan mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i rtsed 'jor rol/ /'jam dpal dbyangs nyid khyod thugs mkhar zhugs nas/ /'chad dang rtsod pa'i rtse dga' ci yang mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma sa/tsug gi rgyan bzhin du// 218

bzhugs nas blang dor gsal ba'i 'dren byed mdzad/ /bstan pa gcig la stonapa gnyis min zhes/ /thun mongs gtam du gleng ba nges par rdzun/ /bden na shākya'i bstan 'dir mgon po 'dis/ /sde snod gsum gyi chos 'khor kun bskor nas/ /rigs gsum gdul bya btul la bsnyon nam ci/ /sgrib med ye shes gzigs thogs mi mnga' 'ing / /phyogs med thugs rje gzhan dbang gyur pa khyod/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba la/ /zhum med snying gi go cha nges par sra/ /de nas rje 'di'i thugs kyi rab brtan lhun po/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i bang rim mngon par bkra ba/ gdul bya gling bzhi'i dbus na g.yo ba med par lham mer bzhugs te/ rnam par dag pa'i lugs gnyis kyi snang byed gsar ba'i rna cha rtag tu 'chang zhing / 'phrin las sprul ba'i gsang ba du mas 'phrul gyis nag po'i phyogs kyi dpung rnams mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas gzhom pa'i sgyu 'phrul bye ba'i rol sar la zhugs par khums so/ /de dus mtsho sngon po'i dmar nang nas yid srubs kyi sder gtogs pa'i 'phrin las no yon zer ba zhig gis/ rang ris kyi dmag dpon phran 'ga' bskul nas/ bkra shis 219

'khyil gyi chos sde 'joms pa'i bsam sbyor gyis chas te 'ong ba las/rje 'di'i thugs rje dang bstan bsrungs rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las kyis/ kho rang mgo myos phyogs bslan par gyur par nges med du 'khyams zhing /mthar dmag nang rang sar son nas yid rmugs zhing gtol med par gyur/ kho bo'i grogs 'ga' dgon pa'i phyogs su slebs kyang / de yi sngon nas bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po er rnyi ni thos jis/ kho rang gi gcung che tshan tho'u ji dmag brgya dang bcas pa dgon pa bsrung par mngags pa ltar slebs yod pa dang / kho rang rnams mgon med par gyur pa sogs gang thad nas gnod pa'i glags ma rnyed do/ /'phrin las no lon zer ba de phyis su rgya dar rtse mdor yun ring btson du bzung ba thos/ de nas rje 'di dpon slob dang rgyud pa bla ma dang rgan pa 'ga' zhig rtse gzhung na dmag chen yod pa'i sar phebs/ bstan 'dzin wang la thug pas bla ma rnams la bkur sti dang dgon sde la sus kyang gnod mi rung zhes bka' shog gnang / er rnyi ni tho'u ji la thug pas bla ma rnams la tshur mjal bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa dang / nang lugs kyi zhal gsung zhib rgyas zhus nas spro bar byas so/ /220

kho rang gis sngar nas bla brang gi rta'i su rug cig 'thor ma bcug par bdag rkyen gnang yod pa dang / dpal mang gi grwa ba rnams kyi nye bas mtshon nas dgon pa'i yin zer tshad la bdag rkyen gnang yod pas/de thams cad rje 'di ba 'khor bcas la phul/ dpon ju nang gi mnga' 'og gi mi mang bos mjal nas rang rang gi gces nor ci yod gyi bsnyen bkur dang skyabs 'jug zhus pa la/ rje 'dis khyod rang rnams la skyon med nga rang rnams myur du phrad yong zhes brtse ba'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung zhing dad pa'i myu gu 'phel bar mdzad do/ /4 slar yang bkra shis 'khyil du chibs kha bsgyur nas phebs pa'i lam bar du mi rgod mang pos rje 'di dpon slob kyi zhabs phyir 'brang ba'i dud tshang rnams la gnod pa byed par brtsams pa na/ rje 'dis khyed rnams reb gong phyogs kyi mi yin 'dug kho bo bla brang gi khri ba bso'i bla ma yin tshul gsungs pas bde bar btang / de 'phral gdan sa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas bzhugs skabs rma chen gyi rta gro zhu ra zhig chibs te phebs/ 'phrin las sgrub par khas blangs nas da ni nga sku 'bum la 'gro rgyu yin gsung ba rmis/ de nas 221

sngar ltar 'chad nyan dang gtor bsgrubs lnga mchod sogs gnang /chos mtshams 'dir grwa mang la lam rim dmar khrid gnang ba skyes bu chen po'i chos skor mgor slebs/ dgun chos tshugs pa la snga sor gyi sros gang yod chag med mdzad/ dgung lo zhe bdun pa khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug gi lo'i smon lam la yang zhal zas rgya mtsho sogs sngar ltar dang gsung chos la skyes rabs dang dbus mtha' rnam 'byed gnyis gnang / dpyid chos la 'chad nyan dmar chos byas/ chos mtshams rnams su grwa mang la stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed dang / rje bzhad pa'i 'dul ba'i gzhi smad gnyis kyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang / zhal nas 'tshub che dus 'chad nyan la 'bad na sku rim gzhan las 'chad nyan lhag 'dug gsung ba ltar/ 'di'i skabs su rgya dmag dang tsha go sogs mi bsrun pa'i rigs mang po 'dus nas btsan po dgon lung rnams bshig nas/ zung cu'i rgya dpon gcig dang tsha go rnga ba rnams rang yul du phyir log nas yong za lang du slebs dus/ dmag dpon rnams kyis bgros te 'gro ba'i zhor la bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon bcom na rten gser dngul las grub pa mang po yod rgyu 'dug pas/222

nga rang rnams 'tshengs zhes bcom par chas pa na/ dmag nang gi rnga ba rnams 'jigs nas nga rang rnams kyis snga sor dgon par brda' zhig ethub snyams nas yong pa'i tshe/ nyin rjes ma nas kho rang rnams ma go rmongs nas lam nor ste log 'a ma du 'phyan nas ka cu la sle bas song de nas bkra 'is 'khyil tu thas nye ring dris na nyin 'ga' 'gro — dbos tshul thos pa dang / bsang chu'i khar thon nas bltas nga sa chu cher 'khrugs 'dus pa la 'jisas nas re thag chad nga/ra gyur tshul phyis su rnga ba'i dam/ga mi rnams kyis bshad kyin 'dug nge dus sha brang sngags rams ba sa rje 'di la rgya dmag yong nges su 'dug khyed rnam sa ngasor pa nas phebs na dga' zhes yi ge phul bas/ dpyid chos chen cho/'i dus bzang gi nyin dala' rar/sa rgan pa rnam/sa tshogs nas bros na dasa' 'is bgros te rje 'di tshosas na bzhugs pa gdan 'dren zhus pa sa nga'i dus bzang ngo/ la chos spyod 'don dasos — 'es ma phebs/ phyi ra nyin chos grwa nas tshogs gtaca/ sanang nas / do nub nas tham sa cad rdo bcal la tshogasanas sgrol ma tshar nyer gcis re 'don de pas ma nga 'don mi dgos/ sher snying tshar dgu re btom223

nas de'i gsum re'i mtshams nas bzlog pa re gyis gsung nas rje rang tshogs dbu la phebs nas de ltar byas/ de yang sngon rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi dpung gi tshogs gnyis kyi/ ral gri mthu can pa'i dpung 'phags ma chos sbyin ma btul nas yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa la/ rgyale rigs bzang po'i tshogs kyis phrag dog gi dbang gis ri brag 'bebs par mngags pa na/ 'phags ma'i gsung gis 'chad nyan 'ba' zhig byas na 'bebs nus par gdams pa ltar/ de tshe ngal bsos rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi thugs de dag gis 'chad nyan gyis bskul te/ rngas rtsen gyis srog chags grog bur la yang gnod pa med par ri brag phebs nas byin pa dang mtshungs par/ dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi 'anyin las gtso bor rje 'di'i 'chad nyan gyis bskul bar gdon mi za'o/ /dpyid chos gnyis pa nas bslab btus kyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang / dbyar chos kyi dam bca'i skabs gling bsres kyi ming btags pa rnams dge rgan dang ma 'grig pa la/ dge bskos dang grwa mang ming btags pa'i phyogs su chud nas/ dge rgan bskrad dgos zhus pa na rjesra da ni gling bsres dang rigs grwa la yang 224

thugs byung bas da lo nga rang la ngo chen 'bul dgos/ phyin chad rigs grwa'i gzhung las pa dang dbyar dgun gyi mtshan btags pa'i dge rgan so sor bsko dgos pa'i 'grigs gnang / do zhag 'grig thabs ma byas na rigs grwa yang lus nyen 'dug sngar ngas sku phyogs la rigs grwa nga rang gi 'dzin thub rag la ma chad pa byed/ de rjes su sku phyogs rang gis thugs smon gnang dgos zhus pas sku phyogs kyi khyod sems 'tsher mi dgos/ gling bsres dang rigs grwa sogs dang dgon pa yang ngas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la bcol yod pas legs po 'ong zhes gsung yod gsung rdo / /de nas gling bsres sogs sngar ltar mdzad/ de'i chos mtshams la dpon po rgya nas phyir phebs pa la rje 'di dpon slob kyis bsu ba mdzad/ mchod yon zhal 'dzoms pas spro dga' rgyas/ 'di'i lor bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi mtshan mo grub thob mjal/ skyabs 'jug dang rtsa sngags kyi lung zhus/ dge lugs ji 'dra 'ong zhus par/ bsod nams dar 'dug pa'i 'phel rgyas chen po yong gsung ba rmis/ ston chos la yang 'chad nyan rgyas par mdzad/ skabs 'dir dus 'khrugs kyi rkyen gyis dgon par mang 225

ja sogs dkon pas grwa mang dang sbyin bdag sogs kyis bskul nas rong phyogs su bsod snyo mas la phebs dgos zhus pa la/ rjes brtags pa gnang bas mnal lam du rong phyogs la song na 'gro don dasa' mo yong zer ba rmis/ de nas gtso'i 'bo ra/ kha kyā mdzo dge sosas 'a phebs pas thams cad kyi dad pa'i spu long g.yos te bdog pa ci yod kyis mchod nas/ rang rang gi skal bar mtshan sa pa'i dam chos kyi bgo skal blangs/ khyad nga/ra du na tshod yo' ba mang po bde ldan zhing du bgrod pa 'pho bas mtshams sbyar bar mdzad cing khyim pa phal cher bsnyen gnas la bkod nas thar ba'i sa bon bskrun pa ra mdzad/mdor na mthong na bde ba'i rtsi mthong ba bzhin du rje 'di'i sku'i dkyil 'bor mthong ma thag tu thams cad kyi nyes pa'i tsha gdung zhi nas rnam dkar gyi ku mud ches cher bzhad par gyur to/ /de nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas sku rnyed kyi 'bul ba rta nor gos dar so khrab ja ras sosas phal cher dang ras gur thab cha dang bcas pa'i spyi 'jog byas/ spyi gnyer gnyis bzhag nas mang ja sogs spyi so nas gtong ba'i srol phye/ sngar gyi mchod rdzas rnams kyang spyi gnyer la sprad/226

spyi 'jog che phra mang ja'i snyan dar rnam sa spyi bar 'bab dgos par bkas bcad gnang / lo 'dir rten 'brel stod pa'i ṭikka tshig don lam gyi rim par bsgrigs pa sa bcad zur ba dang bcas pa brtsams pa'i mjug tu mgon chos gnyis la 'phrin las bcol tshul bris nas gzhan ma bris pas/ de ma thag tu bla brang gi mdzo mo rnam sa jag pas khyer ba dmag zor mas phras dos tu dgongs nas dam ga zor ma yang bris pas/ de ma thag rab mdas spebs nas mdzo mo slar phrog mi gcig kyang bkum 'dug ‘ jug rdzogs pa'i nub rmi lam du/ ri thang thams cad rtswa sngon pos khyab/ nyi ma yang gsal bo shar 'dugs cha de lta bu'i lung ba gcig gi mthil du slebs pas zam pa chung ngu zhig 'dug la chu mi 'dug 'dum cung zad 'dus pa la 'di ci yin zhes dres pas sngon sangs rgyas byon dus lung ba 'di la chu chen po byung zer/ de nas phar ri ngo'i gyen la song ba'i g.yas/ g.yon gnyis mtha' dmar po 'jigs rung zhig 'dug de gnyis kyi bar gdong gyen la so nga mas steng du slebs pas de na thang bde mo zhig 'dug pa sangs rgyas kyis chos 'alo/ ra bskor sa yin zer/ nge nas shis brjod 227

bzang po byed kyin 'dug pa rmis/ sems la nga'i lta ba'ang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'i rtags yin snyam pa byung gsung / dgunachos la 'chad nyan mdzad pa sogs sngar dang 'dra'o/ /dgung lo zhe brgyad pa sna tshogs dbyig ces pa shing sbrul gyi lo'i smon lam skabs zhal zas rgya mtsho ma bgyis/ gsung chos la skyes rabs dang dbu mtha'i 'phro dang /bde ba can gyi smon lam gyi zhing mchog sgo 'byed rnams gnang / chos mtshams la dpon don 'grub dbang rgyal gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs spyan drangs/ dpon mo sgrol ma'i ur rges la phebs dgongs rdzogs gnang / phebs lam du rdza dmar khis chags su bzhugs skabs rdza dmar ba shor btsun gzugs su phebs/ snod chung ba mthar thug cig gi nang du ston mo drangs pa tshogs pa thams kyis bzhes te tshim 'gro ba la sogs pa rmis/ zla ba gnyis tshes bzhi lnga la mgon khang rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs ltar mdzad pa'i dga' ston du grwa mang la bogs dang 'gyed sogs gnang / rab gnas dus grwa ba dge legs rgya mtsho chos grwar 'jug pa'i snyan gsan phul bas rje mchog tu dgyes nas/ mgon chos gnyis kyi thugs rje la grwa rgyun 'phel po yong 228

de'i ming bzang bas rten 'brel legs gsung / de nas yun mi ring bar grwa rgyun mang po byung / rab gnas grub nas bskang gso gtong mkhan yang bzhag/ dpyid sos kyi gsung chos la bslab btus kyi 'phro gnang / zla gsum pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bzhi'i nyin rjes spos sna mdzad nas mgon khang rnying ba nas/ rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs kyis gnang bas bris sku mgon khang gsar ba la spyan drangs/ rje rang nyid dbu la bzhugs nas dpon slob bcus nyi ma gnyis la dus gtor rgyas pa byas de nas bzung ste mgon khang nas bskang gso gtong mkhan la grwa pa bzhi re bzhugs nas zla re'i nang du bskang pa stong tshar re dang /dus gtor gyi nyin grwa ba bcus bskang tshar brgyad re/ nyin gnyis la mgon chos kyi dbyangs yongs rdzogs 'then pa'i srol btsugs/mgon khang du 'jigs byed kyi dbur bla re nyis brtsegs dang /gnas yol 'khor ma/ gtor sgam ka pā li/ dngul khag sbub gsum/ tsen gcig rnga bo che gnyis rnga chung gnyis/ ṭā dril bzhi/bsgral chas cha tshangs dang bcas pa bzhag go/ /de dus rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa'i gter mdzod 229

sba sa pa'i rnal 'byor ba sgom pa rin chen rgya mtshos zhus ngor ljags rtsom gyi rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭikka sa bcad dang bcas pa dang rig sa tshogs sogs mang po gnang / skabs der rje'i sku cung zhig ma bde ba la grwa mang gis spyi bsdus kyi mang ja mang po btang / tshogs nas shā sa na bye chen bsgrubs pas/ rje'i zhal nas de la rtags dga' mo byung rang gzhan la legs po 'ong sin gsung / yang zhal nas dbyar dus lam rim chen mo'i skyes bu chung du'i skabs kyi tshig go dka' ba rnams la mchan bu btab pas/ mjug tu shog bu bco lnga sdor lus pa'i mtshams su sun nas 'phro 'debs ma thub/ sems la nge bris pas mtshub yin nam/ sngar bris pa rnams kyang legs mi lebs ci 'dra yin nam snyam nas sems ma/ bde bas nub gcig rmi lam/ na khyong kyi mchan bris pa de legs 'dug zer su yin ma shes/nad de yang sman pa tshos dug red zer kyang / nga'i sems la dug yin min ci shes snyar nas/ de'i bcos thabs che cher ma byas pas nub gcig rje bla ra/ de nyid kyis khang mig chung ngu 'ig na phyag dpe gzigs kyin bzhugs 'dug nga la dgyes nas tshur sazigs byung yang /230

ngas sems la do zhag chos grwar yag po 'gro rgyu ma byung bas bka' bkyon yong bsam nas sku mdun la ma song / phyi nas bltas pas rwa pod bsnams nas dug bcos la zhib tu gzigs rtogs mdzad kyin bzhugs pa rmis/ phyir nyin dug yin rgyur 'dug snyam nas dug sbyongs byas pas/ nad myur du sangs song / lo 'dir rgyud pa dpon slob ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis rigs grwa btang ba la rje 'dis mang ja 'ga' zhig btang / de dus rje 'di'i mnal lam du rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje phebs nas rigs grwa khyod kyi skal pa yin pas/ khyod kyis ma bzung ba de ma legs gsung ba rmis/ chos mtshams la dpon rgya nag la phebs pa'i sku rim du rje 'di gdan drangs pa na/ rje 'dis dpon dpon mo sogs la gshin rje gshed dmar gyi rjes gnang sogs gnang / slar phebs nas chos mtshams su grwa mang la mgon chos gnyis kyi rjes gnang gnang / skabs der khong gī gcen mkhar rtse bro mtshal ba'i sku rim la mgon po'i zhi ba'i gtor sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe mnal lam du mi gcig gis rjes la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gi bska la ba yin zer nas lug gu shin tu mdzes pa gcig dang /231

gnas brtan bcu drug gi skal pa yin zer nas lug gu gcig dang gnyis byin pa rmis pas/ rje'i zhal nas rgan po la skyon mi 'dug rigs rgyud kyang yong gin gsung ba ltar rjes nas rigs rgyud kyang byung ngo/ /dgung lo zhe dgu ba zil gnon me rta'i lor smon lam chen mo'i gsung chos la skyes rabs dang chos nyid rnam 'byed gnang /dpyid chos grwa'i gsung chos la blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi bshad pa gnang / 'di dus phyag mdzod gung ris bla brang nang la bzho mdzo ma 'ga' zhig yod na nang nas thab zin gin mang ja re yang dkar po byed thub zhes zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ tshul khrims ldan pa smon pas 'grub/ zhes pa ltar mdzo mo 'dod phyin yod gsung ba bzhin du lo de nas mdzo mo mang po byung / de phyin chad dpyid sos dbyar ston rnams mang ja re gnyis bla brang nas 'o ma slug te dkar po byas/ lo sngon ma zhig gi dus nas rjes gnyan po dka' bcu khu mtshan dang rab 'byams pa grags pa rnams la/ gter lung gi sku phyogs rin po che'i bzhugs sgar btab sa der dgon pa gcig 'dzugs thabs gyis zhes bka' gnang yod pas/ lo 'dir lung ba de'i ser skya kun gyis rje'i 232

bka' spyi bor blangs nas 'du khang dang grwa gshags mang po grub nas grwa ba mang ba bzhugs pa rnams kyis bgros te/ 'di lo zla ba dgu ba'i yar tshes la rje 'di spyan drangs nas gter lung du phebs pa na char chen po babs shing gzhan yang rten 'brel gang legs byung bas rje shin tu dgyes/ der thang sa ri khrod pa dang gnyan po dka' bcu rab 'byams pa grags pa sogs kyi gtso byas pa'i dge 'dun la zhag bco lnga'i bar du nyin re bzhin du chos thun gnyis re la lam rim chen mo lam rim bsdus don spyod 'jug rnams kyi bshad lung dang rten 'brel bstod pa/ skabs gsum pa/ sa gsum/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub sogs kyi lung gnang / grwa ba mang pos bsnyen rdzogs zhus pa la mkhan slob sbrags mi'i sgo nas bsnyen rdzogs gnang / thang sa ri khrod pa'i khong bsnyen rdzogs kyi grwar bzhugs rgyu yin zhus pa na/ rjes khyed tshul khrims rnam dag la bslab skyor ci byed gsung bas/ ri khrod pas ngas smon lam gyis khyad par la bsams nas bla ma mang po'i mdun nas bslab skyor yang yang byas pa yin zhus pa la/ rjes 'o na de chog sdom pa ma thob pa la gsar du thob rgyu med kyang thob zin gong 'phel du 233

'gro rgyu yod gsung / ri khrod pa de tshe blos btang gi chos pa rnam das/ cig yin 'dug pas rje thugs dgyes po mdzad/ rnam gnyis gsung rab kyi zhal 'phros mang bo gnang / de dus rje tshogs la yang nyin re bzhin phebs/ bstod chem rnams dang bzang spyod sogs dang dmag zor ma'i gtor bsngos rnams tshogs 'don la btsugs/ dmag zor ma'i zhal thang la snyan dar phul te/ 'phrin bcol mdzad nas khyed rang rnams kyi chos skyongs dmag zor ma yin gsung tshosas la bkra shis kha dar gyi 'gyed dang spyi 'jog sanang / de dus tshosas rje gdan 'dren zhus nas brtan bzhugs 'bul ba na/ lam rim bsdus don gyi/ de nas 'di phyis legs tshogs ci snyed pa'i/ nas/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i ma nyes par byed/ zhes pa'i skabs su 'bu' ba phul bas rje shin tu dgyes nas khyod rang rnams tshe rabs thams cad du theg chen bshes gnyen gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug gsung / dase 'dun gyis zhus ngor rje'i sku ber zhig rten la gnang rjes su bdag rkyen bzang po byed gsu/nga ba ltar 'al bzhugs kyi bar du bdag rkyen gnang / phyis su bca' yig gcis kyang 2 34

gnang / slar bkra this 'khyil du chibs kha bsgyur nas phebs skabs la ma lung rnams kyis gdan 'dren zhus/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang po bsgrubs so so'i 'dod chos gnang / lung ba 'dir dgon pa gcig 'debs dgos de'i bla ma dang dgon pa sogs sku phyogs nas 'a/la bkod gnang dgos zhus pa la/ rje'i zhal nas rab 'byams pa grags pa 'di khyed tsho'i bla ma la byin pa yin/ dgon 'debs sa pha ri'i thad 'di bzang / thams cad kyis khur lang byas nas dgon pa zhig 'debs thabs byas na/ rten 'grigs lam sogs kyi bdag rkyen nged kyis gnang chog gsung bas thams cad kyi rje'i bka' spyi bor blangs nas phyir lo nas grub/ de nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/maso ba sku skyes kyis zhus ngor rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chen gnang / lnga mchod kyi chos mtshams la kun rig la ljags bsnyen mdzad/ de dus rje'i zhal nas sngar yo ga 'a/ mkhas pa gsum du grags kyang da lta kho bo dang yo ga la bzhi'o zhes gsung ngo / /dgung lo lnga bcu ba spre'u zhes pa me lug lo'i smon lam gyi gsung chos la skye rabs dang chos nyid rnam 'byed sanyis kyi 'phro dang / bshes spring 235

slob spring rnams kyi bshad pa gnang / sku gdung la dril ldang phul dus skyeb bcu gsum lung bstan pa rmis/ dpon po mer rgan des chen gyis zhus nas grwa mang dang bcas pa la rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang chen bskur dus dbang bshad rgyas par gnang pas/ gsan mkhan phal cher gyi thugs la sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges su mdzad pas bka' drin zla med do/ /chos mtshams rnams su phyogs nas phebs pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig dang grwa mang la rje'i gsung 'bum thor bu sngags rim chen mo gnyis kyi dka' gnas rnams la bshad pa chu 'beb ma gnang / 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub rdo rje tshig sbram dang / 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim chen mo blo gros chos skyong bas kha bskang ba'i bar dang / darban a tsarya'i rtsa gshin sbyor ba'i man ngag gi 'grel ba dang / sbyong rgyud 'dul 'dzin gyi kun rig gi cho ga ṭika chen dang bcas pa'i bshad lung gnang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum gyi skor nas/ rje nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig ba'i sgrub thabs/'jigs byed kyi bsnyen yig bskyed rim/ gsang 'dus kyi bsnyen yig 236

dang bskyed rim/ sgrol ljang gi mngon rtogs/ sgrol dkar gyi mngon rtogs/ sna tshogs yum gyi mngon rtogs/ 'pho khrid mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung / chu gtor cho ga rnam bshad dang bcas/ klu dbang rgyal po'i bum gter/ 'dzam ser gyi chu sbyin gnyis/ gnon gnas kyi sgrub thabs/ 'dzam nag gi chu sbyin/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba'i ma ṇi ril sgrub/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ khro bcu'i mngon rtogs rdo rje'i go khrab/ khyung khra'i mngon rtogs/ rje bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ blo sbyong mu thi la'i 'khri shing / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla rgyud gsol 'debs/ gsol 'debs bdud rtsi bum bzang / bde can 'pho khrid/ lam khrid/ bstan rtsis/ sa chog rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ grwa tshang la sger du 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi rnam bshad zhi khro'i gsang mdzod dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim khrid yig gnyis kyi man ngag gi ljags bshad gnang / 'di dag phal cher gyi dka' gnas dang man ngag 237

gsal bor ljags bshad mdzad/ yid dang kun gzhi'i rtsa 'grel/rnam bzhag rim pa'i rnam bshad/ mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rim la gdan rdzogs rnams gnang / dpyid chos gnyis pa sogs la chos grwa nas lam sgron/ lam khrid bde lam/ lam khrid gser zhun rnams kyi gzab bshad gnang / dbyar dus nya tshang sku skyes kyi ma ṇi ril sgrub la gdan 'dren zhus nas der phebs/ bya rgyud lugs kyi spyan ras sazigs phyag bzhi ba'i sgo nas phyag bco lnga'i bar du bsgrubag rje dpon slob kyi nyin re bzhin bya rgyud kyi gso sbyong slang nas dkar sasum la brten cing thun gsum gsum mdzad de gsol tshigs thon nas mjal ba mang po la mjal kha dang / rang rang gi 'dod chos gnang / khyim pa rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod nas nges par legs pa'i sa bon bskrun/ nyan tshang sku skyes sogs la thugs rje chen po'i ma ṇi ril sgrub dang / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bla ma mchod pa/ rje bzhad pa'i gsang rnam/ rnam thar gsol 'debs/ sher snying / sgrol ma/ ltung bshags rnams kyi lung gnang / der zhi ba'i sbyin sreg cig mdzad/ 'brang rgyas kyi ri khrod du spyan drangs nas sku skyesogs nyung 238

bsdus la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor bcu gsum gyi dbang dang /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang sogs gnang / 'di ba'i ma ṇi ril sgrub phyi ma'i dus su / nyang tshang gi bla ma dag la bka' phebs nas khyed kyi dgon pa 'di'i sa dpyad shin tu legs 'dugasangs rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la smon lam 'dzugs dgos gsung ba ltar/ hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes drug la smon lam btsugs/ de'i tshe tshogs la rje dpon slob dang phyogs de'i ri khrod pa mang po dang bcas tshogs pa la rjes kha dar gyi 'gyed gnang / snga dro khrom chen po la rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs gsungs/ phyi dro byams sku'i mdun nas spyan 'dren khrus gsol sku bstod smon lam mang po bstan 'bar ma sogs bsngo smon rgyas bar mdzad/ lo re bzhin du dus mchod 'di ma chad pa byas na nged kyis bdag rkyen byed gsung /lo rjes ma'i mang ja dang 'gyed thebs yang gnang / yul phyogs de'i bstod smad kyi mjal ba mang bos dad 'bul tshan che ba phul/ mjal ba rnams la phyag dbang gnang ste bsngo smon gyi 'jug pa yang dag mdzad/ de nas skyi tsha sku skyes kyi gdan drangs nas phebs/ rje'i 23 9

—gser sku khyad 'phags dang bcas srid zhu phun tshogs zhus pa la/'dzam bha la nag po'i rjes gnang gnang / skyitsha ri khrod pas mchod rten ngo la gdan drangs/ ri khrod pa rnams la lam khrid dang / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang gnang / slar chibs kha bsgyur ba'i lam bar du nyin pa tsho gsum gyis ja thab dang bsnyen bkur phul du phyin pa bgyis/ rang rang gi 'dod chos dang 'pho khrid khyim pa rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod nas mchog thun gyi phun tshogs sgo brgya legs par phye nas gdan sa chen pobakra shis 'khyil du phebs/ rigs grwa dang 'chad nyan rnams sngar mu ltar mdzad do/ /mang thos rgya mtsho'i dpal la 4༄dbang bsgyur zhing / /tshul bzhin rnam dpyod gdengs mas rab tu brjid/ /thabs shes goms pa'i rin chen tog mdzes pa/ /mkhas grub klu dbang bye ba'i gtsug rgyan khyod/ /phra 'dzings rigs pa'i lcugs ma 'bum phrag dang / /lhan cig legs gsung sgra brgya'i skye ba can/ /lhun grub 'phrin las nor bu'i gru char bces/ /skal ldan gtsug skyes drug pa'i do rwa ngoms/ /ches mkhas dregs pa'i khengs rloms sngon gyi lhas/ /lan 'bum dpyad kyang myang min mdo rgyud kyi/ / 240

mchi med bdud rtsi'i zas de khyod nyid las/ /thob pa'i legs bris tshogs rnams skal pa bzang / /dam tshig dri med zhing sa gshin pa la/legs sbyangs sku gsum sa bon grung bo btab/ /rim gnyis char gyis rim par bskyed bsrings pa'i/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i snye ma g.yur du za/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes khyod nyag gcig ni/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i lam bzang mthar thug pa/ /yang dag lta dang zung 'brel sngags kyi lam/ /yang dag 'doms la rmad byung zhing gi mgon/ /stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' ma 'dris mdza' bshes khyod/ /deng dus byang shar gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /mnyam med rgyal ba'i mdzad pa'i rnam rol na/ /seṅge nga ros phrag dog mi mdzad dam/ /'di dus su rje 'dis phyogs 'dir rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa yun ring du gnas na ci ma rung snyam du dgongs pa dang / rje nyid spyi mthun gyi smra ba'i nyi ma gcig pur song ba sogs kyi gshis las/ de'i tshe smra ngan legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros kyi mig ldongs la/ phyogs lhung gi g.yang du gnas bcas nas/ 'dir snang btsog tshul ngoms med du spyod pa/ ngur smrig gi zol la brten cing 241

lus med kyi gnyen du gyur ba du mas/ 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi sa 'og tu sbed pa'i tshul la zhugs pa yang ma bzod nas/ rje'i zhal las yang dag dang ltar snang 'byed pa'i lung rigs kyi dgag sgrub nyin byed gsal ba'i gzi 'od rang gis 'phros pa na/ legs bshad kyi lan ldon pa'i ljags rtse thung la g.yo zog gis 'chal gtam smra ba'i dbang bo ni glog ltar g.yo ba dag gis/ mu cor la rje 'dis bla chen kun la phrag dog bis sdang zhes ltas ngan u ka yi cho nge btab pa sel ba sogs dgos pa mang du gzigs te/ chos mkhas grub don 'grub rin chen gyi sku'i skyebar yang grags thing /'kho ra lo gsum gi sgo nas bstan pa'i bsal byed dam par gyur pa/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mkhas grub chen po khya dge dpon slob blo gros rgya mtsho gdan drangs te/ rje'i gsung gis bskul nas grwa tshang dang bcas pa la sasang bde 'jigs gsum dang kun rig bzhi'i dbang chen/ na ro chos drug gi khrid yig yid ches gsum ldan dang / dbang don de nyid rab gsal dang / bde chen gsal ba rnal 'byor dag rim/ bla ma lnga bcu ba'i rnam bsad/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/242

) sngags kyi rtsa lhung bcu bzhi dang sbom po brgyad pa gnyis kyi rtsa tshigabyang sems kyi rtsa lhung gi rtsa tshig sdom pa nyi shu ba/ sngags dang byang sems kyi phyir bcog bde mchog gi phyi rol lhag mchod/ rgyud bla ma/blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel ba/ rdo rje'i tshigs rkang bzhi ba rnams gsan/ dpon slob rin po che'i rje'i sku phyogs la tshur dngul srang bcu phrag sogs phul nas/ legs bshad snying po/ spyod 'jug rje gsung 'bum thor bu/ rje bzhad pa'i gsang rnam rtsa ba/ rnam thar gsol 'debs rnams gsan zhing / dka'u gnas rnams la dogs gcod kyi dri gtugs mdzad/ dpon slob kyis rje 'di la yang dag mtha' dpyis phyin pa shes pa sngags la rag las pa'i don ci ltar yin zhes zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas rnam rtog gi rtsa ba rlung la thug de 'gags pa la sngags bla med kyi rdor bzlas kyi rnal 'byor sogs kyi man ngag la rag las pa yin zhes sku phyogs kyis gsungs zhes zhib par gsung zhing / gzhan yang gsung rab kyi brgal brtags mang du mdzad pas dpon slob kyi thugs phrogs nas bsngags brjod cher mdzad cing / dpon slob phyir la phebs khar rje la zhabs pad yun 243

ring brtan dgos 4 zhus zhing / de dus rje dang dpon slob rnam gnyis mgon khang du phebs nas dpon slob kyis bstan srungs rnams la rje'i zhabs brtan gyi 'phrin las bcol ba nan tan du mdzad do/ /de nas rje'i sku phyogs la ko'u dges zhus nas grwa mang dang bcas pa la/ rdor sems kyi khrid/ dmag zor ma/ mgon dkar/ phyag rdor gtum khyung rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / rgyud sde spyi rnams dang / paṇa chen gyi gsung ba'i gsang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs/ gzhi gsum cho gagrub mtha' chen mo'i stod cha rnams gsungs/ lnga mchod gyi dus gdugs dkar gyi 'khor lo rgyud ltar bri sgrubs legs par byas pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la bzhag te/ rjes spos sna mdzad rnga rol gyi mchod cing dgon pa'i phyogs ba zhir rgyal chen bzhi la gtor ma phul/ de nas 'du khang gi steng du btsugs pas/ de phyin chad rims sogs zhi zhing chos dang bkra shis yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas so/ /'di'i lo nas bzung lo ltar lnga mchod kyi dus 'du khang steng du rgyal mtshan gnyis brje ba gnang / 'di'i lor mkhar thab la bzhugs dus rje'i mnal lam du mi smug po chen po gcig gis grogs byas nas pha bong chen po 244

gcig gi thog tu chung ba gcig 'byar 'dug pa mnyam du rbab la 'gril btang ba rmis/ dgung lo nga gcig pa phur ba zhes pa sa sprel gyi cho 'phrul smon lam la mdo sde rgyan dang de'i 'grel ba dbyig gnyen gyi mdzad pa/ rje'i gsang ba'i rnam thar rin po che'i snye ma/ rtogs ldan pa'i rnam thar zur 'debs/ mkhas grub rje'i rnam thar gzigs pa lnga ldan rnams gsung / dpon tshang nas byams sku khru tshad las lhag yod pa cig bzhengs nas phul ba la gzungs gzhug phul rab gnas mdzad nas/ smon lam 'di phyin chad la byams sku 'di nyid byams pa gdan 'dren du gdan 'dren zhu rgyur gyis gsung / chos mtshams rnams su grub mtha' chen mo'i mjug dang / lam rim chung ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs za ma tog dang bdud las rnam rgyal gnyis/ za ma tog gi nag 'gros/ sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho/ 'pho khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed/ bcu gsum ma gsum gyi dkyil chog mkhas grub kyi mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg mgon chos lha mo rnam sras rnams kyi sgrub thabs rgyan 'jug mdzod rtsa/ rgyud bla ma rnams kyi ljags lung gnang / rgyud pa dpon slob dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis 245

zhus nas 'grel ba bzhi sbrags gzab bshad 'grel gtad dang bcas pa dang / ye shes rdo rje'i kun btus dang / de'i 'grel ba rjes mdzad pa/ lha mo bzhi zhus 'grel ba dang bcas pa/ sngags rimu gyi nang gis bskyed rim khol phyung gi steng nas bskyed rim spyi'i gzab bshad rnams gnang / rje 'dis rgyud pa bla ma la khyed kyis lo re bzhin du rgyud pa'i 'grigs ltar 'grel ba ṭikka rnams rdzogs par gnang dgos gsung ba ltar/ rgyud pa bla mas kyang bka' dang blangs mdzad pas/ 'di nas bzung rgyud kyi bshad srol legs par tshugs pas bstan pa'i snying po ring du gnas pa yang rje 'di kho nas bka' drin du khums so/ /de nas rje bzhad pa'i dpon po rab 'byams pa blo gros gshegs pa la mchog khrus dang / gdung sbyin sreg du mdzad/ dpon po rab 'byams pa 'di gshegs pa'i mtshan mo rje'i mnal lam la byang chub chen po'i me tog gur tsam zhig 'bul 'dug pa rmis/ thugs dam grol ba'i mtshan mo yang mi mang po zhig gis rnga rol sogs mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs thogs nas bsu ba cig byed rtsis 'dug pa la ci yin dris pas rab 'byams pa blo gros sgyu lus su ldang ba la bsu ba byed zer ba cig 246

byung bas/ rje'i zhal nas rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas tshar 'dug gsung / zla ba bzhi ba'i yar tshes brgyad la rnam sras la dus gtor gtong dgos gsung ba ltar dus gtor btang / de nas zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar tshes brgyad la dus gtor gtong ba'i srol btsugs/ chos thog rnams su gsung chos la blo sbyong snyan rgyud chen mo/ blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ po to ba'i chig lab ring mo/ be'u bum sngon po'i 'grel ba/ nang gi khong skran 'don pa'i skyug sman rnams gnang /chos mtshams la gtso'i sgar bas gdan 'dren zhus nas ma ṇi ril bsgrubs gnang / 'di dus su 'bras spungs chos skyongs dngos su phebs nas 'phrin las sgrubs pa gzigs zhes sku 'khor nang ma la gsung / skya ser gyi khrom chen po la 'dod chos dang / bsnyen gnas sogs gnang nas mchog gi lam la bkod nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ dbyar chos steng la lā mo zhabs drung dkar po sku phyogs zhi bar gshegs khar khong gi dgongs rdzogs la rje 'di gdan 'dren gyis zhes zhal ta gnang pa ltar gdan drangs nas phebs/ than chen gyi dus yin kyang urges su 'bab khar me tog gi char 'babs pas 247

thamasacad ya mtshan skyes/ nyin re la zhog ka 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang / lhung bshags sogs chos spyod mang po dang / kun /blo rdo ///sgro) ///dzag da rta byas bdag mdun bum gsum ma da pa dang bcas pa rgyas par gosungs/ de nas sku gdung gi mdun nas mchog zhus dang /mchod pa mnal bcas rgyas pa dang smon lam rnams dang bstan 'bar ma gsungs/ slar yang gzims gur du phebs nas sku bstod rta mdur gnyis re 'jigs byed dpa' cig bskang gso dang bcas pa gsung bas/ der gnas kyi skyebo thams cad mchog tu dad pa'i dbyar mtsho cher rgyas pa las rnamadakar dad mos bstod dbyangs mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'di skad du/ rje dpon slob 'di dag gi sku'i byin gsung gi gdangs zhal 'don gyi 'gros kun spyod kyi 4 thams cad ni zla dang bral ba'o zhes sgrogs par gyur/ de dus sprul sku 'jam dbyangs sku phyogs kyi dpon chung blo bzang don 'grub dang / rjes sor dpon po sogs mi chen 'ga' bsnyen rdzogs gnang / sku gdung mdun du sprul sku myur 'byon zhu bar bskul ba'i tshe/ rjes marlal dang gos yug kha dog sna lnga phul te/ snyan gsan phul ba na yang me tog gi char ya 248

mtshan pa babs/ der bdun phrag gcig bzhugs pa la/ bkur sti gces nor gyi 'bul ba sogs bla chen kun gyi rtser son pa mdzad/'od zer chos gong zer ba dbus nas rje bzhad pa'i zhabs drung nas dbang gi 'khrul 'khor gyi lung khrid thob pa zhig 'dug pa'i gam du grwa ba 'ga' zhig btang nas nyan du bcug slar phebs pa'i lam bar nas thams cad kyi dad pas zhabs tog phul/ bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas rigs grwa'i 'chad nyan sogs sngar dang 'dra/ ston chos kyi dus dpon po mer rgan des chen gyis zhus nas dpon po sogs nyung bsdus zhig la rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chen gnang / dgung lo nga gnyis pa zhi ba zhes pa sa bya'i lor cho 'phrul smon lam la skyeswa rabs dang mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba'i 'phro gsungs/'di dus rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad pa 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan sogs dka' rams rgan gzhon phal cher gyi bgros te/ rje la gdugs dang rgya gling sogs mkhan chas yongs rdzogs bzhes dgos tshul nan cher zhus pa na/ rje'i zhal nas rje gong ma'i dgongs pa ltar byung na sku phyogs zhing gzhan du phebs lo nas babs 'brel yod kyang / nga rang 249

la 'dod pa ma byung / 'on kyang rje gong ma'i phyag srol dang khyed rang rnams kyi bsod nams kyi ched du gal sridakhyed 'dod na smon lam gyi dus lta bu re la bzung chog gin gsung ba ltar byas/ de rjes rgyud pa dpon slob dang bla ma dbu mdzad pa gnyis nas slar yang 'grel ba bzhi sbrags gsung dgos zhus pas/ phyogs so so nas phebs pa dang gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi gzab bshad sngar sa khung bsgrigs lugs gtso bor byas nas dka' gnas kyi tshig don rnams kyi bshad pa gnang ba las kyang ches rgyas par chos mtshams 'ga' zhig la gnang pas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstan pa srid zhi'i bla na 'bar zhing rmad du byung ba/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i gshegs shul nyams pa med par kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni ches gzhal du med do/ /rgyud rgyal mdo rgyud za ma tog gcig pur/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyas btab legs bkrol te/ /ches gsang rin chen mi zad mdzod phye nas/ /skal ldan re skong khyod min deng dus su/ / —250

de nas chos grwa nas 'grel ba don gsal dang / thub bstan phyi dor gnyis kyi gzab bshad gnang / co ne'i bla ma se ra'i dge bshes chen po a mo ri khrod pas zhus nas/ yang khong dang grwa ba nyung bsdus zhig la 'grel ba bzhi sbrags nyung shas shig la rdzogs par gnang / ri khrod pa khong gis rje la mdo sngags kyi dri ba mang du zhus pas rje'i legs bshad kyis khong pa'i thugs ngoms par gyur cing / rang yul du phebs nas 'grel ba'i bshad rgyun yang legs par spel 'dug lo 'dir byams sku'i g.yas g.yon du mar me mdzad dang rje rin po che'i sman sku che ba gnyis dang / nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi lder sku gsar bzhengs mdzad/ rten bzhengs pa'i mgo brtsams pa na char chen po babs pas rten 'brel legs/ byams khang gi log ris la cho 'phrul chen po'i bkod pa dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis bzhengs/gser gdung khang gi log ris la rje rin po che'i gsang ba'i rnam thar brgya dang gsum ma dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkod pa bzhengs/zhal ris lha khang du ma garnya bzang mo'i rtogs brjod ltar sangs rgyas 'khor bcas phebs pa'i bkod pa dang gnas brtan bcu drug 251

bzhengs/ rten bzhengs pa rnams ma 'gyang bar grub pa thams cad la zhal gser rdzogs par gsol/ de dus rjes co de dpon po la rta rgod ma 'ga' gnang nas/ rje gong ma'i sku gdung mdun du bdun tshar che ba cig dgos gsung pa ltar bdun tshar zhig blug nas phul ba thugs bzhed ltar ma byung bas/ rgya yul nas blug te mchod phor 'gag ma re re'i nang du chu zom re'i lhag tsam 'gro nges kyi bdun tshar gcig blug nas byams khang du phul/ ston dpon mo rnam rgyal phebs nas sku rim zhus pas zhag lnga la mgon po'i rgyas pa'i gtor sgrubs mdzad nas grol pa'i gtang rag gi dus su/ dpon mo phebs pa phyag mdud kyi rgyu'i kha btags khyer shog gsung ba na/ kha btags rnam bcu dbang ldan can zhig khyer 'ong ba rjes gzigs nas dgyes nyid kyis phyag gis 'dom la gzhal bas 'dom gang las ches lhag byung bas thugs cher dgyes nas de dpon mo la phyag mdud mdzad nas gnang / khyed rnams kyis dgon pa gsar sgrub kyi gong ba la sgrog gu ma btags na mjug ma grub zer ba ltar/ sku phyogs rin po che dang khyed rnams kyi dgon pa btab kyang gser gyi rgya phibs shig ma grub pa da lta bzhengs 252

dgos/ de ma grub kyi bar du khyod rnam gnyis kyi sku khag nga'i thag ces gsung kyang / dpon mos re zhig zhal bzhes ma gnang bar sngon dus ma 'khrugs pa na chas ka yod/ deng sang bya ba chen po 'di khas len dka' gin 'dug zhus pa la/ rje'i zhal nas khyed kyi zhal len gnang na 'grub yong / chas ka la rag las pa min/ bsod namasadang sngon gyi smon lam yod med la rag las/ mtsho sngon po la stobs 'byor khyed las lhag pa mang po byung yang / de dag gcig gis kyang sngar dgon pa 'di 'dra dang gser tog mang po bzhengs pa med/ khyed rnams kyis sku 'bum gyi gser tog yang bzhengs/ da dung gser tog gcig bzhengs pa'i bsod nams yod/ ngas mgon po la 'phrin las bcol/ nged cag gis kyang grogs byed gsungs pas dpon mos phyag 'tshal nas de yin na ethub lta zhus/ de nas rje nyid kyi dpon po dka' bcu zangs bsod la rnga bar mdo tsha go phyogs su btang / bla brang nas rgya phibs kyi khang ba 'bug pa sogs las ka rnams kyi mgo brtsams/ lo 'dir phar phyin 'dzin grwa'i zur khol bzhi rtsom dgos zhus pa ltar/ dge 'dun nyi shu rgyas bsdus gnyis brtsams/ dbus kyi 253

dge bshes rnams kyi rje bzhad pa'i sku phyogs la dri ba zhus pa'i khrod nas dbu ma'i skor la/ dris lan cung zad rgyas shing gsal ba zhig kyang brtsams/ de dus dam pa mnyes shing dul la lung rjes gnang sogs man ngag du ma'i gter mdzod drung rams pa phun tshogs kyis nan zhus ngor lam rim bsdus don gyi ṭikka zhig rtsom 'phro gnang /yang phebs lam cig nas zhabs ring ba rnams la rjes nged kyi bla ma'i zhabs phyi mdzad dus tha na rta'i sgrog bkrol ba yang bla ma'i bkur sti'i bsam pas zin par byas pa yin/ khyed cag gis kyang bsam pa de ltar 'dzin dgos/ nged kyi khyed rang rnams tshogs rdzogs ched du zhabs phyi la khrid pa yin gsung ngo / /dgun chos kyi dus dpon rgan bsnyung nas rje gdan 'dren zhus/ der phebs pa na dpon po'i snyung shin tu lci bas bzhengs pa phar zhog gsol ba yang mi gcig gis dbu btegs zhal tu khem bus cung zad re 'dren gyis 'dug lung bstan pa kun gyis tshes bco lnga'i nyin thun la sgug pa ma gtogs mi sos par thag bcad yod pa'i tshe/ rje 'dis bsod nams kha btags rta gos dar dang bcas pa bsnams phyag g.yog pa rnams la kha 254
