btags re zungs gsung nas dpon po'i mdun du phebs nas 'bul ba rnams phul te/ rje'i zhal nas sngon sde ba sne'u zur bas sbyin bdag byas 'jam dbyangasachos rje'i bla ma byas 'bras spungs btabs/ ko'u shi han gyi bu rgyud rnams kyis sngar btab yod pa'i dgon pa rnams kyi zhabs tog byas pa ma gtogs/ sku phyogs rin po che dang khyed rnams kyis bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon pa gsar du btab pa 'di 'dra ba de dag sus kyang btab pa med/ des na khyed kyis rje rin po che'i bstan pa dang nyid kyi dgon pa thugs la bzhag nas yun ring du bzhugs dgos gsungs pa la/ de'i lan du dpon pos nged kyis rje'i bstan pa dang nga rang gi dgon pa la bsam nas re zhig sdod e thub blta/bla ma khyed kyis thugs dam skyabs 'og tu 'dzin dgos zhes zhus pa la/ rjes de yong gsung nas chos gos dbu la bzhag de nas bla mgon dbyer med kyi rjes gnang / tshe dpag med lha lnga'i rjes gnang phul/ mtshan la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin du btags/ bum chu gnang bas zhag gcig gnyis zhig song nas mang du sbyongs pas sku — bde ru song zhing / bco lnga'i nyin 'dzur ba na lung bstan pa dag kyang 255

yid ma ches par bla ma khri rgan tshang gis sku rim dang bum chu gnang nas dpon po'i bsnyun sos rgyu yin las che zhes gleng / de nas bsnyun lhag ma med par grol ba'i dga' ston du 'bul chen phul/ rje 'di byin rlabs kyi gter chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skyes bur spyi mthun gyis grub pas phan bde'i lo tog legs par smin par gyur to//de nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs dgung lo nga gsum pa thun mong zhes pa lcags khyi'i lor cho 'phrul smon lam la mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rnam thar ke ta ka phreng gsungs/ chos grwa'i gsung chos la legs bshad snying po dang thub bstan phyi dor gnyis ma'i gzab bshad kyi 'phro dang / bla ma lnga bcu ba'i rnam bshad dang /tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad/ byang chub gzhung lam rnams gnang chos mtshams rnams su lam rim chen mo dang snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa gnang / gtso'i 'brong lce'i sde ba'i ma ṇi ril bsgrub la gdan 'dren zhus nas der ma ṇi ril bsgrubs mdzad de thams cad kyi dkar po'i sa bon rtas par mdzad cing bsnyen bkur phun tshogs zhus/ de na bzhugs skabs su rgyud pa bla ma dbu 256

mdzad pa 'dzam dbyangs dpal ldan gyis/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mdzod kyi par co ne la gtad yod pa grub nas der 'byor ba gdan 'dren zhus te phebs pa'i lam skabs nas/ bka' phebs nas bar la bsu ba dang ser sbrengs kyis gsung ba ltar bsus/ dgon du phebs nas co ne par brkos pa ye 'gor gyin 'dug gsung nas phar phyin gyi skabs phyi ma rnams dang / dbu ma dang rnam 'grel le'u dang po gnyis/ sde bdun rgyan rnams kyi par stag lung la gtad nas brkos/rgyud pa bla ma la rje'i gsung gis bskul nas lo 'dir 'jigs byed kyi rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang bde mchog tshugs pa la rdor dril rtse dgu ma sum cu lhag dang dung dkar gcig gtsug tor stod gos smad gos dang bcas pa 'ga' zhig dang 'gyed gnang /ston dpon tshang nas gab ron chab tshan la phebs na sku la phan zhus pas/ de phyogs la phebs bzhed cher ma byung zhu ba po'i stabs kyis phebs pas/ lam bar du ser ba drag po 'bab pa sogs 'tshub byung ba na zhal nas rang re sku phyogs rin po che'i rjes 'jug phyogs 'dir 'ong ba la/ the bo'i chang tshan gyi gzhi bdag gis phrag dog byed kyin 257

'dug gsung / lam bar du dpon tshang dang brgya tshan so sos bkur bste cher byas nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ zla ba bzhi ba'i nyer lnga la gser tog dngos gzhi bzhengs pa'i dbu btsugs pa na/ bal bo rnams la rta sogs gnang sbyin mdzad/ gser srang drug cu sogs kyi zhal 'debs dang bla brang dang dpon tshang gnyis ka nas bzo bo rnams la phog sogs res mor gnang chos mtshams shig la gsang 'dus la ljag bsnyan mdzad/ lo 'di'i mkhar thab kyi dus rab 'byams pa mkhyen rab dang bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs la liṅga'i gnad yig 'god tshul sogs 'khrid par mdzad do/ /dgung lo nga bzhi ba 'ga' byed ces pa lcags phag gi lor cho 'phrul smon lam la skyes rabs dang mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rnam thar tshigs bcad ma rnams gsungs/ lo 'dir grwa rgan phal cher gyis deng sang gi skabs 'dir rje'i zhabs brtan zhig bsgrubs pa drag ces bgros nas zhus pa na/ rje'i zhal nas de lta yin na tshogs nas ya ma rā dza dung phyur dang mgon khang nas mgon chos kyi bskang ba 'bum phrag sgrubs zhes bka' phebs pa ltar bsgrubs pas ltas legs 258

gsung / mdor na dgon par tshogs nam yod kyi skabs su bla brang nas mang ja mang po btang nas lab sgron gyi lung bstan ltar tshogs nas bka' 'gyur sgrog pa dang / tshe gzungs dang dmigs brtse ma dang / shī sa na dang / khro bcu rnams bye ba sogs dang / mgon chos kyi bskang ba khri tshar mang po sogs lo phal cher la bsgrags/ lo mang por lo phyed kyi mang ja bla brang nas btang ba sogs zhib par bris na mang dogs so/ /'di dus grwa tshang gi las sna rnams dang dge 'dun thams cad kyis 'bul ba phul te/ snying thag pa nas mgrin gcig tu rje nyid kyi sku bstod cig rtsom dgos zhes nan cher zhus pa la/ rje'i zhal nas ngas skye ba 'di la nga rang gi bstod pa mi rtsom pa'i dam bca' byas yod/ gal srid bla brgyud kyi khrod du 'don rgyu zhig dgos na paṇa chen sku phyogs la zhus/ dbus na yang de 'dra'i srol yod gsung / des na bdag bstod sogs chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba ring du dor zhing yon tan thams cad shin tu sbed par mdzad pa ni/ de dus su rje 'di gcig pus rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /rje nyid kyis tshogs gtams la mkhas grub rje'i rtogs brjod las/ mkhan 259

slob mched grogasachos dang dam tshig ni/ mda' ltar 'phangs nas 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog cing / /dad rdzas phyir rtsod yul 'khor 'joms pa'i dpung / /ci tsam tshogs kyang dmyal ba'i 'du khang yin/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di drangs nas grwa ba tshul mthun gcig byung na yang nged de la dga' ba yin/ gang yin tshad byed pa'i grwa ba mang po tshogs pa la nged ci ltar dga'/ dmyal ba'i bud shing mang du song ba la sems yod su zhig gis dga' bar byed ces yang gsung ngo / /'di dus rje'i byin rlabs kyi sa dge 'dun thams cad dad gus dang phan tshun dag snang che ba 'dzin gshar sbyangs dang thugs gnyer la cher 'dun zhing chas ka sogs la snang shas chung ba zhig yod/ zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes la nye sras sogs rten gsar bzhengs rnams dge legs char 'bebs ltar rab gnas rgyas pa gnang nas/ dge 'dun rnams dga' ston gyis tshim par mdzad/ chos grwa'i gsung chos la rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan gnang / chos mtshams rnams su drangs nges rnam 'byed dang / rtags rigs kyi mtha' dpyod gnang / rgyud pa'i gsang 'dus kyi rdul tshon kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod btsugs pa la 'gyed 260

gnang / rgyud pa dpon slob sde ba'i sku phyogs la 'grel ba bzhi sbrags zhag nyung shas shig la rdzogs par gnang ngo / /rigs grwa'i mar bsod pa jag pas bcom pa'i tshe/ rje'i zhal nas da lo mar bsod pa bcom pa la bka' gdams gong ma rnams ltar na rang rang tsho'i bzod pa bsgom mam rwa lo sogs ltar mngon spyod byed zhes bka' gros gnang ba na/ rgan pa thams cad mgrin gcig tu mngon spyod byed dgos zhus/ rje'i de e yin nam da dung khyed rang rnam pas thugs bsam thong gsung kyang / kun gyis da lo 'di la mngon spyod ma byas na phyi nas dka' zhes yang yang zhus pas/ rje'i thugs dgongs la 'di'i don la drag las byed pa'i thugs bzhed cher med kyang / phyis su bstan pa'i sku rim la drag las 'ga' zhig 'khrid dgongs yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis mnga' ris chos bstan pa nas brgyud pa'i snyeṭa pā la'i las sbyor rab 'byams pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs la khrid/rab 'byams pa sgom pa rin chen rgya mtsho dang dka' bcu blo bzang dar rgyas sogs kyis bsgrubs pas jag pa phal cher gyis gus 'dud zhus/ ma 'dud pa rnams la mngon rtogs thon nas mjug mi dmigs 261

pas rgyas thebs so/ /rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams sogs la kṣe ṭa pā la spre'u khrid kyi skor cha tshang gnang / de rjes rab 'byams pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs gsum la mgon po'i liṅka bri tshul shog dril dang bcas pa gnang / rab 'byams pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs nyung bsdus shig la mgon po'i gter bshad bsnyen sgrub las gsum sogs kyi man ngag yang gnang / rje 'di nyid dbu la bzhugs te/ 'gying ro sprul sku sogs dpon slob dgus bdun phrag gcig la mgon po'i be'u bum ltar drag po'i gtor chen bsgrubs pa'i ltas khyad 'phags byung bas/ thugs dgyes nas grol khar yang zhal shes kyi gdams pa mang bo zhig gnang / 'di skabs gtso bor dgon par gnod pa'i rgyal 'gong dang khyi gdon zhig yod pa la dmigs pa yin snang / lo 'dir rigs grwa zhag nyi shu la bzung ngo/ /dgung lo nga lnga ba yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu byi la cho 'phrul smon lam gyi gsung chos la skyes rabs/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba dang / rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs rnams dang / chos grwa'i gsung chos la rnam bshad snying po rgyan dang rtsa 'jug gnyis dang / chos mtshams la dbu ma'i mtha' 262

dpyod gnang / 'di dus rjes tshogs gtams la sku phyogs kyi yig cha rnams mi 'thad ces zer ba'i kha bdud kyis phye ba rnams kyis/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas gang la brten pa'i gzhung rnams dang bstun nas de'i dgongs par ma song ba cig yod na bgegs rigs yong / de lta ma yin par rjes phar bkag pa'i phyogs snga ma'i 'dod tshul re slar brjod pas ci yang mi yong / de yang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i phar phyin gyi yig cha bod kyi gzhung la brten pa min rgya gzhung rnams dang gtso bor 'phags seng gi gzhung la brten pa yin/dbu ma'i yig cha rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i ṭika chen gnyis dang lhag mthong gnyis sogs la brten pa yin/ mdzod kyi yig cha mdzod rang 'grel dang 'grel bshad gnyis gnad sgron sogs la brten pa yin/ 'dul ba'i yig cha sum brgya ba rtsa 'grel dang bam lnga nyid kyi rnam bshad 'dul ba'i 'grel ba so thar 'grel chen rnams dang / rgya cher 'grel gyi bye smra'i thun mong min pa rnams ma gtogs phal cher tshad ldan nas de dag la brten pa yin pas/ de ltar ma shes par bod kyi gzhung re da mi mthun pas mi 'thad par smra ba ni rang nyid kyi blun rtags yin 263

gsung ngo / /nyi ma bye ba las gsal mkhyen rab kyis/ /rgya bod gzhung la phra zhing 'dzings pa ru/ legs par dpyad tshe 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu yis/ /phyogs snga mdzad kyang dgag nus khyod min su/ /ngan rtog mi gtsang zos pa'i khā ta'i mchus/ /blo chung 'dzin ma dri mas sbags pa dang / /ngan skad rna bar 'dzir ba'i ag sgra dag /dpyid kyi rgyal mo yid 'byung gzhir gyur kyang / /snyan pa'i mgrin rnga dus kyi dbang gis sgrogs/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gdong lnga ba khyod kyis/ /mtha' dag lung rtogs ral ba cher gsig cing / /mthu nus rigs tshul mche sder mi bzad pas/ /yab bstan la sdang spobs pa srog bcas bcom/ /kun gzigs zhing gi mgon po 'dir gshegs nas/ /theg mchog chos kyi sgo gcig 'doms pa 'di/ /'phags mchog rnams kyis garigs nas 'dus gyur te/ /sna tshogs mchod sprin 'od zer 'gyed pa snyam/ /phal dang dman mos gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la'ang rang rang skal bar 'tshams pa'i chos tshul dang / /brtse ba'i thabs mkhas 'phrulda gyis btul byas nas/ /rab zhi'i lam bkod mchog la gzhol bar mdzad/ / 264

de dus dpon mo rnam rgyal gyi dngul lnga bcu ma sogs phul nas zhus pa la/ gshed dmar gyi dbang gnang / lo 'dir bsam gzugs brtsams/ bstan don la dmigs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi rgyas kyi 'khrul 'khor 'ga' zhig la khrid/ rabs 'byams pa sgom pa rin chen rgya mtsho gser kha mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag zhal shes 'ga' zhig gnang / zla ba gcig gi bar du bsgrub pa la rtags bzang po byung bas mnyes/ la mo'i rab 'byams pa blo gros la rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang chen gnang / 'bo ra'i ma ṇi ril bsgrub la gdan 'dren zhus nas ril bsgrub mdzad skabs pho mo rgan pa mang bos bla ma khri rgan tshang nged la thugs rjes gzigs/ zhes 'o dod drag pos yang yang 'bod pa gsan nas 'di rnams kyis nged rang la re ltos bcas/ nged rang rnams kyis spyan ras gzigs la re ltos bcas pa yin 'dug 'di rnams nged la 'di tsam dad pa yang sngon gyi 'brel ba'i stobs yin 'dug ston gung ri rab 'byams pa dang gcen mkhar rtse gnyis dbus gtsang la rdzong rta byas/ pan chen rin 265

po cher 'bul ba zhu shog dang bcas pa/ 'bras spungs tshogs chen la mang ja dang spyi 'jog la snam sbyar leg sa pa gcig sgo mang la mang ja dang dngul zho re'i 'gyed/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang / rje yab sras gsum gyi sku gdung gi mchod rten 'bras spungs 'jigs byed dga' ldan chos rgyal rnams la mdzod btags che legs kyi snyan dar bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin bcol gyi shog tshar dang bcas nas bskur/ zla ba dgu ba'i nyer lnga la rgya phibs kyi bzo grub nas der gdugs dkar gyi 'khor lo dang / gzungs gzhug rgyud ltar dri sgrubs mdzad nas phul/'degs pa'i tshe rje nyid kyis bya 'og nas phyag gis btegs te dpon po sogs la yang de ltar mdzad bcug nas khyed rnams kyis kyang nged kyi smon lam 'debs pa ltar thob gsung zhing / nyid kyis skyeb nas tshe rabs thams cad du rje'i bstan pa yar la 'degs par shog ces smon lam gnang / 'di'i lor smon lam gyi mchod rdzas la/ gdugs gnyis/ gser rnga bzhi/ zom rdza gcig rnams bzhag go/ dgung lo nga drug pa bag med ces pa chu glang gi lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam la skyes rabs dang gser phreng gnyis gsungs/ chos grwa'i gsung chos la stong 266

thun dang lam rim chung ba gnang / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rnam thar thang ka lngar shong ba'i dkar chag brtsams shing rnam thar bzhengs rje bzhad pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar thang ka lngar shong ba'i dkar chag brtsams shing rnam thar bzhengs rje bzhad pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi mchan bu rje rang nyid kyis zin bris mdzad pa grwa ba 'ga' zhig la gnang / rigs grwa'i chos mtshams la stong thun gyi mjug rdzogs par gnang / dpon tshang dang spyi gnyer la dngul lnga bcu ma gcig dang bka' gnang nas rgya phibs grub ston byed dgos gsung ba ltar/ ston zla 'bring po'i tshes la dge legs char 'bebs ltar rab gnas rgyas pa dang / dngos gzhi la rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang mjug tu zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad/ rjes rab gnas kyi gsung bshad zab la rgyas pa gnang / de dus su dpon dga' ldan ju nang gis rje la 'du khang nang gi rje gong ma'i bzhugs khri la bzhugs dgos nged kyi khri ston sogs byed rgyu yin zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas nga'i sku phyogs kyi gsung dang dgongs pa ltar/ sngon nas chos khri stong bar ma bzhag par chos srid kyis bskyangs pa yin nged de 267

'dra'i 'dod pa dang dgos pa yang med gsung nas zhal bzhes ma mdzad/ de nas rje ston mo'i dbur bzhugs/ dpon ching wang dga' ldan mardi ni ju nang dang / mer rgan des chen/ chos grags ja sag rab brtan no yon/ chos tsha theb ji sogs dpon chen mang po dang / dpon tshang gi khri ba blo bzang mkhas mchog dang / mer rgan chos rje rnam gnyis dang / sre rgyud dpon slob a gsal ba dang / bod kyi mi chen phal cher sogs khrom chen po ches mang bas 'du khang du mi shong ba tshogs pa'i dbus su/ dpon slob sde bas grwa la 'phros gnang /rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog rab 'byams pa gnas brtan dang /rigs pa'i dbang phyug rab 'byams pa chos skyongs rgya mtsho gnyis kyi tshogs lang byas/ de'i tshe rje'i sku phyogs nas rgya phibs grub pa'i dga' ston du dpon dpon mo rnams la bsod nams kha btags dang chibs re phul/ las sne rnams dang dka' rams rgan rnams la yang kha btags re'u 'bul du bcug dpon tshang nas dge 'dun la 'gyed 'ga' dang / dpon po dka' bcu dang las dpon rnams la bdag rkyen dang cho lo gnang / bal bo'i bzo bo rnams bla brang dang 268

dpon tshang gnyis ka nas ston mo dang yon gyis tshim par byas/ der tshogs thams cad ston chen gyis tshims par byas/ de dus rab brtan no yon la rjes 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen gnang / rje'i zhal nas dpon po 'di byang 'phags yin pas byang sems dang lhan gcig tu dga' rtsed sogs byas na phan yon che zhes gsung nas bla dpon rnams bzhugs sgar btegs nas khyung rtser nyin gsum gyi bar du dga' ston byas/ dpon po sogs la mgon po bar chad kun sel dang / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang gnang / dpon po rnams kyis dga' rtsed sna tshogs kyi mchod sprin spros/ de dus rje gong ma'i sku tsha la dpon tshang nas dgongs phog byung ba la/ rjes thabs mkhas mdzad nas/ nged kyi dpon po la bdag rkyen gnang zhing sku phyogs kyi sku tsha la bdag rkyen med pa nged la bdag rkyen med pa dang mtshungs zhes nan ta3 du zhus pas/ cho lo dang bdag rkyen bzang po gnang zhing dgongs khrol mdzad/ mdor na 'di tsam du ma zad rje 'dis rje gong ma'i sku nye rnams la rang gi sku nye lasakyang lhag pas thugs 'dogs mdzad/ sku nye 'di rnams gtong phod che la g.yo zog gtan nas med 269

pa sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gshis las/ gzhan dbang du song skabs re tsam ma gtogs rje 'di la rje gong ma dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i rtsi bkur snying nas byed pa gcig rgyun du yod/ lhag mchod la dka' rams rnams la zhal ras lha khang nas ston chen dang / tshogs chen la yang ston mo rgyas par byas/ 'di dus rjes ston mo'i zas mi zad pa'i gter du bsgyur ba ni sngon 'phags pa 'char nas khyim bdag gi 'khur ba nyung du sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas ba'i 'tsho bar bsgyur ba dang / 'jam dpal gyis zas lhung bzed gang gis dge slong 'tsho bas bkren pa lnga brgya sogs kyi 'tsho ba mdzad pa dang / dri med grags pas dri sna tshogs sbyar ba'i zas lhung bzed gang gis byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos chen po bdun khri'i zhal zas mdzad pa ltar 'phral phugs kyi 'bras bu dang bcas pas/ der tshogs thams cad ni thams cad du ngoms pa'i tshul de ltar mdzad do//yang rjes dpon mo rnam rgyal la sngon rgya za gong jos jo bo gdan drangs pa ltar/ khyed kyis kyang dbus nas jo bo zhig gdan 'dren byed dgos zhes bka' phebs so/ /rnam dkar legs smon bye bas nyer 270

bskrun pa'i/ /chos ston ting 'dzin bgo skal 'dir spyod rnams/ /phun tshogs sgo 'phar brgya yi 'jug ngogs su/ /rnam mang gzigs mor lta la brel ba bzhin/ /chos dbyangs mkha' mtha' mnyam pa'i ma rnams kyi/ /spyod tshul ma 'dres gsal ba'i ye shes de/ /thugs rje'i mdza' mor 'khyud pa'i rtsed dga' las/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i bkod pa dpag yas bkra/ /khyod mkhyen gzigs ngor ji snyed shes bya'i tshon/ /pir gyis bris min dbang bo'i gzhu ris dang / /ji lta'i chos nyid gcig char mjal tshul 'dis/ /kun mkhyen rgyal dang tha dad dbye ma nus/ /mtha' yas chos sgo mtha' dag theg gcig tshul/ /mtha' bral dbus gnas mtha' med rigs tshul gyis/ /mtha' dag 'gro la mtha' gcig 'doms pa'i tshul/ /mtha' dbus mnyam nyid mtha' thog med tshul ston/ /ston mchog gang gi rmad byung mdzad pa des/ /yid kyi dpal mo tshim pa'i ngo mtshar gtams/ /'og min zhing du grags pa'i sim pa ni/ /ris med skye rgu'i skal bar lhan cig thob/ /e ma mchog gi dpal la rdzogs spyod pa'i/ /zla med smra dbang khyod kyi mgrin mtsho ru/ /dbyangs can rgyud mang 'khrol ba'i ngang tshul gyis/ /dpa' bo 271

dge dbang skyengs te mkha' spyod bros/ /dgung lo nga bdun pa kun dga' zhes pa shing stag gi lo'i cho 'phrul gyi dus mchod la skyes rabs dang gser phreng / 'jigs byed chos 'byung gi rje'i rnam thar gyi thad rnams gsungs/ chos grwa'i gsung chos la bsam gzugs chen mo dang skabs brgyadra pa'i mtha' dpyod gnyis rgyas pa gnang / chos mtshams rnams su rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsung 'bum nang nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rnam bzhag bsam gzugs kyi zin bris/ lam rim gyi ṭikka'i mgo lam rim gyi dris lan/ tshad 'gog brgya ba/ 'jug sgo gsum gyi khrid yigalta khrid kyi zin bris/ 'phrin yig rnam bzhag 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi rnam bshad rgyas pa/ rab gnas glags pa'i don grub/ rab gnas rgyas pa'i 'don bsgrigs gnyis/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang tshogs bdag 'khor lo/ gzugs gzhug gi skor le'u tshan bzhi/ bstan rtsis tshigs bcad ma/ gsang 'dus kyi ma ṇi ril sgrub/ de'i 'don bsgrigs/ klu dbang rgyal bo'i mngon rtogs dang /bum gter gyi rizin bris/ ba ri brgya rtsa'i lhan thabs/ rnam sras 272

bka' bco lnga'i lhan thabs/ rje'i gsang ba'i rnam thar rgyas pa'i dkar chag 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i bskyed rim/'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs tshigs bcad ma/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub tho/ 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa gnyis/ gsung 'bum thor bu/ rab gnas bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi zin bris phran bu rnams gnang / sos ka zhig gi dus grwa ba mang po'i zhabs bsnyung bas/ rjes bya lag gi nye 'khor gyi shing btus bas 'tshub yin 'dra gsung nas/ bya lag la rta khams pa gcig ba mo gcig rwa sogs brtsan/ gsol mchod cig brtsams nas gsol mchod mang du btang ba'i dus zhig 'du khang rdo gcal nas bya lag sku bong che ba sku thog so las mtho ba gcig gzigs/ de phyin chad grwa ba mang bo'i zhabs bsnyung ba'i phro chad/ de nas sre rgyud dpon slob a gsal gyis rje la bzho mdzo ma brgyad sogs 'bul chen phul nas mi tra brgya rtsa zhus pa na/ rje'i zhal nas deng sang chos nyan mkhan yod na bshad mkhan gyis sa khyab 'dug nged la'ang mi tra brgya rtsa gcig bskur 'dod yod kyang / da ni gnang ba dang ma gnang ba gnyis kyi bstan pa la gang phan mi shes par 'dug 273

gsung / slar yang nan chen zhus pas de yin na khyed gcig pu la gnang / gzhan la mi 'ong gsung bas/ de'i lan du dpon slob kyi khong gi mang mang la phan cig e thog bsam pa yin/ gal te de mi 'ong na nged grwa mang dang bcas pa la 'jigs byed kun rig sogs kyi dbang gnang dgos zhus pa na/ phyogs kyi mi tra brgya rtsa nyan gin 'ong ba rnams dang grwa mang la lhan cig tu kun rig gi dbang gnang nas/re zhig dbang gzhan gnang rgyu min zhes gsung bas/ mjal ba phal cher phyir song ba na/ sre rgyud dpon slob dang / grwa mang la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen sre rgyud lugs dang dbang bshad phyag len thams cad shin tu rgyas par gnang zhing / grwa mang la dbang bskur gyi tha ma'i gsung yang phebs/ de lo rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i thugs dam gyi rten 'bum steng jo bo la dbu rgyun rin po che'i phreng ba dang bcas pa phul nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gnang / tshogs chen la gser rnga sum cu/ zo khra lnga bcu/ lcags thom lnga bcu/ ja khra lnga bcu'i skor/ tshogs chen la gral gdan tshang ma/ bkra shis rting dkar ma bzhi bcu'i skor 'jog pa gnang / dbyar chos kyi chos mtshams la 274

nya tshang smanasapas gdan drangs nas/ phebs pa:rno'/ma bsna du yin nam tog rte:/ bdebyedu thang la rje bzhugs skabs shig gnyan rje'ingos nas sprinayathid gi mdog can gyi dkyil nas gnyan rjes rang gi cha lugs bstan nas 'phrin las sgrub par khas blangag der ma zad rje3'di phyogs garaphebaru/ kyi gnas bdeg rnams kyi rang rang gi pe/zugs bstan nasazhabs tog dang 'phrin las mdzad/pa cigayod/ 4 de yang rwa 'khyongakas mdornagabazhugs skabs shig delnga/gzhi bdag g.yag khams pa mayon zhon pa dmag zor mo'i cha lugs 9radra ba cig tu gzisagayangarkang tsha'i3nga(la phebaru/ skabs shig khyung rtse rab byung gi cha lusas suphebasakhanas ston momang po phu'/ nas 'phrin las sgrub par khas — blangaca// zhal nas gzhi bdag 'dirnams sngon sangs rgyas kyi.adun nasadage bsnyen misdong/ pa thob pa zha stab tu 'dug gsungaka de nas tshang 'khor la phebs/ sman pa dang ko(sdu dbe bla ma sanyis mirten rnams la rab gnab/ 'bring poganang khrom chen la kun rig godabang lan 'asa' gnang/ slar dgon paraphebs nas glingabasre sogs/ gnangaka ༅khar thab kyi dus dka' rams reganyesal liṅga 275

sngags can sngags med 'phen pa dgu sogs kyi man ngag gnang /dgung lo nga brgyad pa srin bu zhes pa shing yos kyi lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam la skyes rabs dang gser phreng gsungs 'di dus slan chad mgon khang gi dus gtor nyin gcig yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la gyis gsung /de skabs dpon rgan bsnyung nas rje gdan 'dren zhus pa na rje'i zhal nas sang lcags mkhar gyi dus dpon rgan la rmi lam ngan pa cig byung da res dka' ba 'dra gsung / zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin phebs khar rgyud pa dpon slob smon lam gyi mjug ma chag pa gyis gsung nas rma cha'i khar phebs/ dpon po la bum chu sku rim yun ring mdzad nas/ zhal las ga'/na yin na rtags gcig yong dasos kyang da res ci yang mi 'char gi gsung / snga dus kyi rje'i zhal bkod ltar dpon tshang gis dbus nas jo bo'i sku che ba gcig gdan drangs pa/zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig si nyin urges steng du phebs pa la/ rjes sku 'khor rnams la khyed rang rnams kyis spos ring dang bcas ma lus ma'i dbyangs then la jo bo rma chu'i gru steng du phebs pa na bsu ba gyis gsung ba ltar bsus/ de nyin dpon po yang sku bde nas jo bo la 276

mjal/ rjes jo bo la spyan 'dren khrus gsol mdzad/ rje'i gcung dge slong la dpon tshang nas no yon dpon po zhes cho lo gnang / dpon pos khong bla ma dad mnyam du dgon par phebs e thub de min kyang rtse gzhung du phebs dgos gsung nas gzims gur spos te/ mig rgyang tsam du phebs pas/ de nub nas bsnyung lci ru song / tshes lnga la dpon po gshegs pas dgongs rdzogs la bdun phrag gcig tu khrus chog ma dzad/ gnyer ba thog med la dpon po'i sku gdung ci ltar byed rgyu zhes dris pa na/ de na re/ dpon po'i gdung bzhu mkhan gyi bla myo5 zhig stabs ma 'grisas pas dpon mo yang thugs ma bde bar 'dug zhus pas/ rjes 'jig rten na bu bzang pos pha'i bem po gzhan la bsreg tu mi 'jug pa bzhin du dpon po'i gdung gzhan la bzhu gin mi 'jug dpon rgan 'di nga tsho la sku drin che ba pha 'dra ba yin pas/nged kyi sbyin sreg byed dgos gsung ba de thog med kyis dpon mo la zhus pa na/ dpon mo thugs dgyes nas nged kyi sems la de 'dra ma shar sku phyogs phebs nas yun ring la sku rim gnang / dpon po gshegs nas kyang bdun phrag gcig bzhugs pas zhu ma spobs pa 277

yin/ nged kyi dpon po'i gdung bzhu mkhan gyi bla ma khyed 'dra ba cis ga nas rnyed zhus/ de nas rje dpon slob kyis dpon gyi sku gdung 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi sbyin sreg si sgo nas zhugs la phul te/ dpon mo la dpon po 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra bab/ gdung rus nged kyi khyer nas dgon par mchod rten cig byed rgyu yin gsung bas dpon mos gdung rus kyi phyed dang 'bul chen phul/ 'di dus rjes dpon po 'di tā ra na ba'i sku'i skye ba yin zhes nang 'khor rnams la gsung snang ngo/ /phyir phebs dus lam du rje'i chibs 'gyel bas zhal nas da dung dpon tshang la 'tshub cig 'dug gsung ba ltar cher ma 'gyang bar dpon mo chung ba gshegs/ dgon par phebs nas dpyid chos sogs la 'chad nyan sngar ltar dang chos grwa'i gsung chos la rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi ljags bshad ma/dzad/ chos myo5 tshams la ko'u dge ri khrod pas zhus nas grwa mang dang lhan cig lam rim dmar khrid smin rgyas mdzad cing sems bskyed cho gas 'dzin pa dang ston mo sogs rgyas par gnang / ston chos steng du dpon mo rnam rgyal bsnyung nas rje 'di gdan 'dren zhus 'baladu phebs/ mgon po'i zhi 278

ba'i gtor sgrub mdzad pas dpon mo'i bsnyun dwangs nas phyir phebs skabs rje 'i sku phyogs kyis jo bo mjal bas/ jo bos rje la zhalda gsung byon/ de'i tshe sku 'khor na 'khod pa 'ga' zhig gi nyams la jo bo sku bskyod pa cig mdzad dam snyam pa dang / yang gzhan dag gis jo bo 'dzum zhal zhig mdzad dam snyam pa dang / yang phal cher gyi ci yin ma sher she sgra zhig grags snyam pa shar zhes sna tshogs su gleng / de skabs rje'i sku phyogs nas dpon tshang gi mi bzang rnams la jo bos nged la gsung byon nas dgon par phebs rgyu yin pas khyed tsho sus kyang bar chad ma byed gsung ngo / /'di dus phyogs 'di'i bla chen dang dgon sde 'ga' zhig sis dpon tshang gi mi bzang 'ga' zhig lkog zan gyis brid nas jo bo kho rang tshos e thob lhur byos 'dug tshur phebs lam nas rjes dpon mo la gsung bskur nas jo bo dgon par gdan 'dren byed dgos gsung bas/ dpon mos rje la da lta nas gdan drangs kyang chog zhus/ de nas rje dpon slob kyi lam skabs nas dgon par mi btang nas jo bo rin po che dgon par gdan 'dren byed rgyu yin pas / dung chen gyi rgya gling gdugs spos phor sogs khyer shog las sna 279

rnams dang dpon chos mdzad dka' rams rnams jo bo bsu bar shog ces gsung bskur nas/ rje dpon slob phyir phebs nas 'bal gyi nye ma lung gi mdo la slebs/ dpon tshang gis jo bo gdan 'dren zhus nas yang de la phebs/ der dpon mo la legs 'bul du rje'i sku phyogs nas rta gsum dang spyi so nas rta gcig dang bcas pa phul/ de nas dpon bstan 'dzin dbang phyug dang dpon mo er khe sha ra rnam gnyis kyis jo bo skyel ma byas nas phebs/ lam skabs su rje rang gi gzims gur jo bo rin po che'i bzhugs sar phul/ phebs bzhugs pa jo bo'i steng du gdugs dang / mdun du spor phor phul/ rgya gling yang yang thong gsung / dgongs mo gzims dus ma gtogs gro bab sogs thams cad kyi dus su jo bo rin po che'i mdun nas bzhugs/ gsol ba thamab/ cad kyi phud jo bo rin po cher phul/ de ltar rim gyis phebs pa la dka' rams rta ba brgya lhag gis rgyang nas bsus shing / dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs sogs srid zhu dpag tu med pa dang bcas te hor zla dgu ba'i yar tshes dgu la bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos sde chen por phebs/ jo bo rin po che 'du khang steng gi rab gsal du gdan 280

drangs/ der mong nag dang gos chen gang bzang gis gnam rgyan rab gsal nang khor yug tu kheb pa sku rgyab tu mañdzu khyad 'phags dang g.yas g.yon dang mdun ngos su gos chen ljang4 gu'i yol ba gsar bzo gnang / mdun gyi ka phreng la ling kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lda ldi rgyal mtshan dang 'phan du ma rab gsal gyi phyi ngos su rab dkar gyi yol ba/ sku 'a/ snam sbyar dang ma dun du dung dkar legs pa bdun gyis thog drangs mchod pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas bkur sti phul tu byung ba mdzad de/ bdun phrag gcig tu rab gnas byed rgyu yin gsung zhing / nyin gcig rab gnas 'bring ba cig gnang nas jo bo la nga rang tshos rab gnas ga nas dgos/ sangs rgyas dngos yin 'dug pas de la su zhig gis rab gnas byed gsung ngo / /de nas dpon mo gnyis 'a/ lesas 'bul mdzad/ dpon bstan 'dzin dbang phyug dang dpon mo er khe sha ra rnam gnyis ni rang dbang la dgon par phebs nga/'i thog ma 'di yin pa dang / 'di dus thub dbang gi sku'i phye la ma ngang sbyim bdag bi gtso bor song bas rten 'brel phun suca/ tshogs ba 'a/ rje'i sku phyogs thugs lhag par dgyes shing / lam 281

rsha bas su dpon sras/ kye 'phong skyen pa dang rtsal rnams gzigs te 'a' nas kyang 'di dag ya rab kyi spyod tshul dang ldan la/ 'di gnyis kyi dgon pa 'dir bya ba'i thog ma thub pa bdud 'dul ca/ godan 'dren byasapa rten 'brel shin tu legs pas/ 'di gnyis kyis bla ma dpon po de gnyis kyi bstan srid 'dzin zhing bstan nga 'i bdag ngo yo nga nges su 'dug ces 'jiyo/sa pa med pa'i bsu nga bis 'dom sa par ca/ja da do/ /'o 'dir rje gong ma'i sku gdung gi mdun du mchod rdzor brgya phrag gsum gsar grub dang / brgya ma chod gsar du phul du sa bla ma'i shangs nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi dam/ra ser btung ba rtsis nge nas ma dzod dge sgar bas gdan 'drem zhus / der 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang 'don chos mang ngo gnang mas slar phebs / sto na chos gnyis pa sogs la tshis/ bzhag btang ba sogs 'dra/ 'di lo ma/bar thab kyi dus su der tshosas rnam/sa la sre rgyud kyi sgra gcan 'khor lo sogs drug cu ba'i 'al shes phran 'ga' zhis gnang zhing / zhal nas lcab/sa mkhar 'di sku phyogs kyi sku ring nas da lta'i bar la ma chag pa yin / phyin chad khyod rang tshos dmigachu/ pa gzhan ma byung na'ang /282

'don cha dang dbyangs phyag len rnams cung zad kyang ma nyams par byas nas lha 'di dag bskul tsam byas na des chog 'di'i phyag len sosas gzhan la ma 'khyar zhis gsu nga ba 'di yang 'dir tha ma'i gsung du snang ngo / /dgung lo nga dgu ba me lo zhes pa 'i me 'brug gi lo'i cho 'phrul chen ngo/'i dus skyes rabs dang gser bre nga ba/nyib sasungs rgyud bla ma dbu ma jad pa sogs dka' rams rnams kyi 'bul ba phul nas/ rje 'jam/ dbyangs ba nad nga 'i 4 kasang ba'i rnam thar tshobs 'a 'dzugs/ dgos zhus pa na dngo na ngo dbe slong gis rnga bo gnyis la dar yu ba/ ring bo btabs/ nas 'bu' rgyu khyer 'ong ba dang 'gribs pas dgyes te/ mi rkang gling bu gsang ba'i rnga chung dang /nas / ma thun pa'i dngos grub ma lus bsu'1 du saso' / /ces ba'i bar gsang zhing rnga bo che phyag yis brdung bar ma/dzad/ dgrom pa 'dir sku phyogs nyid kyis zhal bkod gnang ba ma gtog rirwa ga' na ma 'jugs gsung yod kyang / da res 'di sku phyogs/ nyid kyi rnam thar yim pa dang / de ring gi rten 'brel shin tu legs byung bas/'dzugs na grwa ba tshos myur du bzung nas 'dzugs thabs kyis ga su nga 283

ba ltar/ mu stegs ston pa drug btul ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin tshogs 'don la btsugs/ de'i dga' ston la smon lam gyi sbyin bdag blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis dge 'dun la kha btags/ kyi 'gyed btang / 'di dus nyi ma parnyi ta gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la spyan drangs/ dad gus zhabs tog da /ga med zhus/ rje dgyes pa chen pos yang dag pa'i la ma la bkod/ chos grwa'i gsung chos la rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal dang / mngon pa kun btus gnyis gnang /dpon tshang nas rgyud khang du 'jog rgyu'i jo bo'i sku zhig gdan 'dren zhus pa la/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung sogs nang rten phul zhing rab sanas mdzad/ 'di'i tsha/ra ston jo bo rin po che lha khang gsar ba la rje 'dis spos sna dang dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas spyan drangs/ der spyan 'dren khrus gsol sogs rgyas pa gnang / de nas 'du khang rab gsal 'di li ma lha khang byed dgos gsung nas/ byams sku gtso byas li ma mang po dang / gnam brgyan yol ba chu dar snyan dar 'phan chung bzhi dung dkar gsum/ ra dung gcis sbub sasum/ bdun tshar/ martsel gcig me long gnyis 284

sogs bzhag gtor rgyag la 'phyar dar gcig rkang gsum/dngul phor/ steng khebs/ bzlog dar sogs 'jog pa gnang /dpon po bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gi sku bsnyung gi don du rjes gnang zab mo mang po dang / bsrung 'khor bum chu rdo rje'i 'jigs byed kyi zhal thang phyag dril ṭā ma ru sogs gnang / dpon mo er khe shar la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang sanang de dus dpon mo la sras gcig skyes pa la ming dga' ldan bsam 'grub zhes btags/ zla ba bzhi ba'i nyi shu lnga'i nub bzang ngo/ 'gag rmis kyang nyams snang ma byas/drug gi tho rangs sgo mang grwa khang nang gi shar ngos na nga'i khri 'di'i 'phro bla ma rang gi mdzad nas bzhugs khri bzang po'i steng na bzhugs te khri ston byed kyin 'dug nga mdun na gsol dpon ltar 'dug pa'i lag na me tog tsam pa ka gsang ba padma'i dbyibs lta bu la 'dab ma bzhi re yod pa lag pas tsam pa ka mang po brtsegs nas skud pas rgyud nas bzung / de'i steng na rgyu sa/nga yin mi shes pa'i dbyibs dung rtse chung ba 'ga' zhib/ snang / de nas bla ma rang gis dbu mdzad byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma mchod byas pa'i/ /bdag gis dge ba ci 285

bsags pa/ /'dis ni 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bde ba can du skyebar shog /zhes dbyangs 'then/ nga'i skad dbugs 'tshangs nas 'dar te legs po rang cig ma byung / blum po chung ngu de tsho phul/ de'i 'phro gsung e yong snyam kyang gsung ma yong / de'i grwa' tshur kha'i ma go na byang chub sems dpa' 'dug phar kha'i mgo na zung chu'i yi dwags 'dug pas de'i dbu mdzad byas nas/ sku'i skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /gsung gi skyon spangs ka la ping ma'i dbyangs/ / thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya rma tha' dag mkhyen/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma yis bkra shis shog /ces dbyangs 'then pas nga'i skad kyang bzang po byung bas dga' ba skyes mnal sad/ yang nub gcig mkhas grub rje la/ rgya' tshab gnyis pa lags/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa ni/ /'dis 'di na 'di ltar 'dug pa 'di/ /mgon khyod kyi thugs la 'bab lags sam/ /mi nga yi sems la mi 'bab si zer ba'i sang ces gsung ngo / /'di lo rigs grwa'i tshogs la 'chag med du phebs nas rigs lung la gsan/ tshogs lang ba rnams la dgyes pa'i gsung yang yang byon/ tshig sgra 'a/nga lo dus las rgyas nga gyir sasu nga 286

zhing rigs lung 'a sngar las lhag pa'i thugs dgyes po mdzad pa yang rje nyid rigs grwar phebs/ pa'i tshigs bkrar 'dug lo 'dir dpyid chos ston chos rnams kyi steng du rje nyid dbus su bzhugs nas 'dzin grwa phal cher la rtsod grwa byed bcugs nas gsan pa mdzad/rigs grwa'i chos mtshams la go'u dge ri khrod pas zhus nas ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa gnang / rjes dpon rgan gyi gdung rus la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku mang du bzhengs te nyid kyi phyag rdzas kyi dngul srang nyis brgya bdun cu dang dpon rgan mas lnga bcu ma gcig gis zhal 'debs phul ba rnams las/ lha babs kyi mchod rten rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra rgyan dang bcas pa che legs shib/ bzhengs pa la gdung rus las grub pa'i sku dang gzungs gzhug phul/ston rgyas pa'i gtor bsgrubs kyi dus mnal ltas ngan pa byung / grol nyin thun pa rnams thun grwal nas lang nas song ba la bka' bkyon gnang drag la sa la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya ba'i phyir thun pa rnams jun gral nas mi 'dus pa yi na mod/ 'di rgyas pa'i las yin —pas 'phro can du byed pa yin/ phyin chad de ltar ma/ byed khyed tshos phyas 287

len sogs gzhan du ma 'khyar zhig gsung ba 'di yang mtha'i sasal byed do/ /lo 'dir rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyod rgyas pa brtsams/zhal nas nged la rtsom pa byed dus mgo la rtags re dang mjug tu rtags re 'ong gin yod kyang 'di'i skabs su mjug gi rtag/sa de ma yong ba ci yin gsung ngo / /dgun chos steng la chos grwar ma 'ong ba rnams la bka' bkyon dang ming rdol bri bar mdzad cing / dge bskos gnyis la khyed tshos 'grigs mi gnon par 'dug ba/sung nas/ bka' bkyon gnang nas/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i gtsags gtsags mdzad/ de'i sngon tsam la sa/zhan la mi mngon par mdzad nas grwa rgan re gnyis tsam la man ngag zur tsam gnang 'dug de lo'i smo na lam gyi grwa skor ba rnams la khyod rang rnams kyi sku rim gyis khyed tsho'i dam bca' la bar chad cig yod pa e yin gsung ngo / /rmad byung legs bshad snang ba'i gter mdzod khyod/ /rnam dkar lhag bsam skya rengs gzhon nu yis/ /lus can phan bde'i mgron du bos pa na/ /thub bstan padmo dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ /'di na rigs tshul brgya yi byed po zhig /sngon med gsar ba'i mdo rgyud ba༅/da sgrub kyi/ / 288

kun dga'i dpal 'byor sprul ba'i grags pa yis/ /nyes bshad rnam 'byed rang nongs mthong zhing zhum/ /skyo med gzhan don khur gyis mi ngal zhing / /yid 'phrog mdzad bzang yid can rten gyur pa'i/ /lung rtogs yongs 'dzin mtsho gos khyod mtshungs ba'i/ srid dang zhi ba'i rtsa lag su zhig yin / /byis rmongs kya kyu'i yid ldan drang srong gi /dmo/da pa tshigs mda' bsnun pa'i nga las nu/ /khyod kyi bsod nams bden tshig ma thus gzir bas/ /pyo la5 lhung mu cor smra bo rang nyid phung / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa khyod/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid rgyal sras spyan ras gzigs/ /'jam dbyangs gsang mdzod rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /ring lugs spel la rgyal sras kun las lhag/de nas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs khar glo bur du snyung tshu'/ bstan pa na/ tshogs chen nas nyin mtshan khor yug tu zhabs brtan bsgrubs/ mgon khang nas dka' rams mang pos bskang gso btang / skabs shig mgon khang du btsog cung zad shor na yang nged la myur du rtags 'ong gin gsung / bla ma dbu mdzad 289

sogs dam/'a rarwa sa/ mang pos mgom po'i gtor bsgrubs btsugs /de skabs ma 'a gar sku skyes kyis rgya nag nas/ byams chen chos rje'i dus su ba'engab4 pa'i thugs rje chen po'i li ma chen po zhig dgon par gdan 'bye na gyin yod pas bsu mi thong zhes zhu shog phul ba ngang 'grig pas / rje'i zhal nas mason po'i gtor sgrub kyi dus spyan ras gozigs phebs pa thos nga / ni rtem 'brel le gas po byung / myur du bsu mi thong zhis tha/ngu nga ba lta ra bsu/ mi btang / rab 'byar/sa pa sgo ma pa rin chen rgya ma tsho solas kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'i ba'i 'a khru' 'khor bsdung— grwa ba tshan nga/ gsum/ gyis 'du khang steng nas khyung phra rnam 'jom/sa phyag rdor satum po nams bsgrubs / bla zang nachu dge 'dun la 'gyed mang ngo btang / slobs so so ra nga/nga mang 'gyed dang bcab5 nga / bskur / grwa mang sis 'bas brtan 'phul bas nged 'a skyo ma med lo dom ngagu'i bar du 'dug rgyu yin khyod rang tshodzo5 slo ba gnyer ra rim nga/su/ nga rnga / /dgung drug cu ba dam/ra ser can zhes pa me sbrul gyi sa 'o re cho 'phru‘3 smon lam 'a phebs ma thub kyang mchod nga/ zhal zas rgya mtsho ma ngo 4 nga 'o dus lngar dang / nyin re bzhi na jo bo dang jo'i sku 2 9 ()

gnyis la snyan dar 'bul ba sogs kyang lo dus ltar gnang / las sna rnams dang 'dzin grwa so so dang sbyin bdag sogs kyi sems mchog tu dad pas bskul te/ rang cag rnams kyi blang dor gsal ba'i sgron me mi shes pa'i smag rum sel ba'i nyi ma/ nyes pa'i tsha gdung zhi ba'i zla ba/ yang dag pa'i yo byad 'byung ba'i dpag bsam 'dod 'jo gcig pu 'di ma bzhugs na ci ltar bya snyam nas/ zhabs brtan la mang ja ches mang po btang ba sogs yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /dka' rams mang pos rgyud smad lugs kyi gtor cher bsgrubs/ zla ba gnyis pa'i bco lnga'i mtshan mo zham 'bring na 'khod pa rnams la da res nad 'di las nged e thar mi shes ma thar rung nged kyis chos ma dar ba'i yul 'dir 'chad nyan de tsam byas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten yang ci thub bzhengs/ lhag tu dge 'dun la zhabs tog gang drag byas pas ngas bya ba ma grub pa ci yang med gsung ba'i tshe/ mdun na 'khod pa rnams kyis deng sang khyed ma bzhugs na dgon pa 'di shin du rgud 'gro zhus pa la/ dgon pa la dar rgud 'di las che cig byung na ci byed/ da bsdad na mi bzang gsung ngo / /'di dus khya dge 291

dpon slob rin po cher rje'i sku don la brtags pa zhus pas/ dpon slob kyi zhal nas khams dwangs mi dwangs kyi gsal ka mi 'char gin/mdun gyi nam mkhar shākya thub pa zhig bzhugs 'dug pa'i zhal las/mdun sar chos bsgrags chos sgra sgrogag /bzang po spyod pa zhes pa zhig byung bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams zhabs brtan la bzang spyod 'don srol snang bas de bton na dga' ba yoyin ces gsung 'dugade dus ma'agar sku skyes kyi jo bo lo ki shwa ra'i li ma mi tshad yod pa zhig dang / sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung khyad 'phags gos ber la sogs pa phul ba la/ rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyod dang /rje bzhad pa'i rnam thar gnyis kyi phyag dpe rje bzhad pa'i khrungs rabs kyi ras ris rta sogs gnang sbyin mdzad/ sos ka khams cung zad bde nas tshig bzhag gnang rgyu yin gsung ba na/ zham 'bring bdag gis sku'i mi lcogs zhes bzlog kyang ma gsan par/ dpyid chos gnyis pa'i steng du nyin gcig chos grwar phebs nas tshig bzhag gnang / de nas bzung ste rab gsal dang gzims khang mdo gang rung du phebs nas dgun chos kyi bar du chos thog rnams nyin re la 292

tshig bzhag re re 'chag med du gnang / sngar sku khams bskun med dus dbu phar mdzod 'dul rnams kyi tshig bzhag la/ yig cha rnams kyi tshig zur tsam yang mi 'khrul bar gsungs zhing / tshig don so sor phye nas phra zhing mdzangs la zhib par gsungs pa zhig yod mod/ 'di dus kyi tshig bzhag rnams kyang lhag tu yig cha rnams kyi tshig las spu nyag tsam zhig mi 'khrul zhing / dka' gnas kyi ljags bshad gnang ba yang shin tu brling ba cig yod pas sku khams ma bde ba'i rtags ljags cung zad mi bde ba tsam ma gtogs ci yang mi mngon/ bsdus grwa rnams thugs thog nas gnang ba sogs phal ba'i blor shong dka' ba cig go/ dbyar der rje 'du khang chen mo'i rab gsal du gdan spos te bzhugs/ skabs shig zhal ras lha khang nas/ rje bzhad pa'i sku gdung la mchod pa dpag med phul te bstan 'gro'i don du smon lam mang po gnang / zhal nas ngas dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam yang yang btab pas/ rmi lam na 'du khang du dge 'dun thams cad tshogs/ dbu mdzad chen mos dbu mdzad byasaṃ/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab don/ /dam pa khyod kyi zhes dang / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 293

'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes 'don pa cig rmis zhes sho lo ka gcig rkasung ba zham 'bring ba rnams kyi bar gyi rkang ba phyed gnyis brjed 'dug de dus bsang stod du skyo sangs la phebs/ nyin 'ga' 'azhugs/ der zho phul ba rnams tshogs chen du skyes su drangs pa phyis kyi rten 'brel du go de rjes grwa ba 'ga' zhig bsnyen rdzogs gnang nas 'di ngas bsnyen rdzogs kyi tha ma yin gsung zhing / 'di'i lor rje'i sku phyogs nas dngul gnang te grub mtha' chen mo'i bar myur du brko bar mdzad/ dge bskos brje mtshams la da lo ngas dge bskos bskos ba'i tha ma yin pas ming legs po gnyis bsko dgos gsung nas rab 'byams pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / dka' bcu bzang po 'od zer gnyis bsko ba mdzad/ bla brang nas sbyin bdag byas te rgyas pa'i gtor ba yang sngar ltar mdzad/ dgun chos la nyin 'ga' tshig bzhag gnang / de nas sku bsnyung lci bar song bas tshig bzhag gnang ma thub/ de dus sku 'khor rnams kyis 'chad nyan ma thub rung zhabs pad re zhig la brtan dgos zhus pa la/ rje'i zhal nas nga'i phung po theng bo zhig byung nas 'chad nyan rnam dag cig byed rgyu ma byung na/ 294

rang dgar bsdad pa la dgos pa mi 'dug zhesayang yang gsung ngo / /'di dus bla brang nas rje gong ma'i sku gdung la rdo rje sa lam ma'i bla re khyad 'phags dang / gos chen gang yod rje nyid kyi spyan lam du phab nas gang bzang las 'du khang gi ka ring bcu gnyis la bshamasargyu'i 'phan ring bcu gnyis dang / mang 'gyed bogs sogs mang du btang nas/ de'i steng nas tshogs chen nas trīḥsnyiḥ dung phyur gcig rab gsal du grwa ba nyis brgya lhag 'tshogs nas tsasnye ma dung phyur gnyis/tshogs chen nas snga phyir ya ma rā dza dung phyur gsum sogs bsgrubs pas da ni dgon pa'i sku rim sgrubs gang dgos rnams kyang bsgrubs tshar/ mi gzhan gyis de ltar byas pa tshe 'di'i don yin kyang nged kyis de ltar byas pa bstan pa kho na'i don du bsngos yod pas shin tu legs gsung / de dus rje'i zhal nas khyed tshos spyod pa rtsing po ma byed par da lo sku phyogs kyi phyag len ltar gtor ma'i bzo dbyibs ji lta ba bzhin dang / gser dngul sogs kyi gtor snying la nged kyi the'u tse btab pa gzhugs ces phun tshogs lha bris la gsung ngo / /nyin gcig cung zhig gzims nas sang pa na sher snying thon gsung nas zlog pa 295

mdzad pa la de ci yin zhus pas/ ston chos na grwa ba tshogs yod pa'i nang du brnye hrul bo zhig gis bya khra zhig bzung nas grwa ba tsho la bkye gyin 'dug pa grwa ba tsho la gnod kyin 'dug gsung / skabs shig rje'i zhal nas tshogs kyi zhal 'don rnams kyang sku phyogs kyi bkod pa gnang ba ma gtogs nged kyi rang bzo byas pa gtan nas med/ phyin chad khyed rang tshos yang de ltar mdzod dang dgon pa 'phel rgyas legs po 'ong gsung ngo / /yang zhal nas dgon pa 'dir mdo sngags zung 'brel du btsugs pa 'di sku phyogs nyid kyi khyad chos yin/'di'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi phyag len 'di lta bu dgon pa gzhan gcig na yang med/ de ma go bar 'dir ngo log byas nas gzhan tu song nas/ mthar yang 'dir 'ong nas phyag len sogs slob dgos pa de 'dra byed mkhan nga rang tsho'i khrod na yang yod khyed tshos ha go bo gyis gsung / yang skabs shig zham ring ba rnams la khyed tshos nged kyi nad g.yog bzang po byag yun ring gi nad pa shul ring gi mgron po/ drin can gyi pha ma rnams la phan gnod kyi 'bras bu mnyam par gsungs yod/ nga yang khyed cag gi bla ma yin pas/ khyed cag la 'di 296

phyi kun tu legs po 'ong tshe rabs tham4cad du sheg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su 'dzin pa 'ong zhes degyis po mdzad/de'i tshe zhal nas khyed rnams kyis smon lam 'di ltar thob gsung nas nyid kyis dbu mdzad gnang nas/ ston pa pon med pa'i bstan pa dang / /nas rgyu rtsa bsdo /bshes gnyen dam pa'i rjes su bzung ba'i tshe/ /nas/ gnyes byed shog /bdag gi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa seng ge'i sgras/ /nas/ rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog /ces sku 'khor ba rnams la smon lam de ltar 'deb tu bcug cing rje rang nyid kyis kyang 'di dag tshe rabs thams cad du nged lta bu'i mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha stag tuskyebar shog cig ces smon lam gnang / yang zhal nas bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni gdung mchod 'di gal zhe nga rang gi thub tshod la sku phyogs kyi gdung mchod la g.yo sgyur med par rems rims byas/ khyad par du po ti bzhi ka sogs dpar du brko bcug pas bskal ba bzang zhes gsung / de yang rje 'dis zhal bzhugs kyi bar la rje gong ma'i gdung mchod kyi nyin ma/chod gdung la kha btags che legs kyi snyan dar dang 297

spos sogs 'bul ba chag med dang / rje rang nyid ni phyis kyi skabs 'ga' zhig ma gtogs gdung mchod phal cher gyi dus su smon lam la phebs nas nyid kyis dbu mdzad gnang gin yod do/ /dgung lo re gcig pa dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa rta la cho 'phrul spyon lam gyi dus zhal zas rgya mtsho ma dang nyin re zhing rje dang jo bo'i sku gnyis la sngar ltar snyan dar 'bul du bcug de dus 'khor rnams kyis rje la khyed kyi rnam thar gsung dgos zhus pas/ zhal nas dbus su slob gnyer tshul grwa rgan 'ga' zhig la bshad yod/ sku phyogs kyi phyag g.yog byas tshupa rnam thar na yod dgon 'di ru 'chad nyan byas tshul khyed rang rnams la nges pa de yin/ rnam thar khyed rang tsho gcig gis bsgrigs chog gsung ngo / /rnam dpyod rnyog bral rdzing bur mgon khyod kyi/ /rmad byung mdzad pa'i rgyu skar gzigs mo dngar/ /dad 'dun lha yi rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i rtser/ /snyan 'jebs chos kyi rnga chen rgyud mar sgrogs/ /ring nas goms pa'i thugs rjes rtag 'gro yis/ /yang dag gzigs pa kun gsal mtha' dang mnyam/ /rnam dkar las byung rnam 'gyur dpag med gzi/ /rnam med bde chen rnam bkra'i ris su shar/ /ya 298

mtshanaphul byung tha ma'i chos sgra dang / /chabs gcig bsnyel tshulami sdug zug rngu des/ /slob bu sbyin bdag sgra 'dzin yid zung ga /dga' dad skyo ba'i sim pa lhan cig bskyed/ / yang de dus rje'i zhal nas nged kyi ḍā ma ru dang dril bu phreng ba rten gsum rnams ma 'thor ba gyis/ sprul sku zhig myur du 'ong pas/ khyed rang tsho la la bla ma dang / la la dge rgan sogs kyis dang myur du phan thog yong / slob gnyer bzang po zhigabyed chug re zhig dkor la ma 'bags pa gyis gsung / sprul sku'i sku rimal zla med ston pa ma dang mgon khang nas bskang gso gang mang thon/ 'brom ston pa gshegs khar slob ma rnams la khyed rang rnams kyi bla ma mdo sde la gyis zhes gsung ba ltar/ khyed rang rnams kyi re zhig rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i bka' pod rnams la bla ma gyis/ nged kyi gdung rus la 'jam dbyangs kyi par sku mang du btab nas grwa ba rnams la re re phul/ lhag ma mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang zhig gyis la der gzhug gdung— sachod sku phyogs kyi gdung mchod ltar gyis gsung / skabs shig cung zad gzims te mnal sad pa na gung ri la nged kyi tshe 'dir drag — 299 ——‘—— —

las mang bas ltas yong gin 'dug sku phyogs kyis bstan pa'i don la lcags mkhar re 'phang na yig brgya 'bum ther re bton pa'i phan yon yod gsung ba yin nam gsung ngo / /yang sman pa gnyis la bdud rtsi chab tshan zhig byed dgos gsung ba na sman pa gnyis kyi dri bzang sna tshogs sbyar ba'i chu bskol de phul bas/ rjes dri bzang gi chu de'i sku la bdug nas khrus mdzad/ de nas khyod rang rnams kyis skar ma zhig ltos la shog gsung ba ga bla ma dbu mdzad kyis gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la phebs na gdung mchod sogs byed pa la stabs 'grig po 'dug zhes zhus pas tshe/ sku phyogs rin po che ni gza' skar ngan pa sogs’zil — gyis gnon pa'i rtogs pa mthon po yin/ da de dang mi 'dra de skar ma mi bzang gdung mchod 'dzin mkhan re byung na yang / gdung mchod gnyis gcig tu song nas grwa ba rnams la phan thog cher med pa dang /de tsam gyi 'phen pa yang med gsung / de tshun chad kyi skar ma cig ltos gsung ba la chad 'khor sman pas nged tshos mi bzhug par gsol ba btab pa 'dra bas de zhu mi nus zhes zhus pa la/ rjes de la skyon med gsungs pas/ kho na re 'o na dga' ldan gdung mchod ga 'dra 300

yin zhus na/ rje'i zhal nas de tshag gi da ni rgya rtsis dang mthun pa gyis gsung ngo / /de nas grwa mnge la mjal kha gnang mjal dar rnams sngar lugs ltar slar stsal/ de skabs dpon bstan 'dzin dbang phyug mjal bar phebs pa la rjes zham 'bring ba rnams la 'di dpon po yin nam gsung / de dag na re yin 'dug zhus pas/ dpon po la rje'i zhal nas khyod kyis dgon pa 'di la rem rem gyis gsung / de dus dpon mo er khe sha ras yel chi mngags nas khong mjal bar slebs rag la zhal bzhugs dgos zhus nas myur du phebs te 'jal kha zhus pa na/ dpon mos nga'i gam du mya ngan byed na 'jal kha mi yong mi byed na yong gsung nas 'gag la gtad nas mjal bcugadapon mos rten gcig zhus pa la paṇa zhwa gcig gnang / 'di dus grwa bu slob sbyin bdag sogs kyi snying khung rus ba'i gting nas dad pas rang rang gi gces dgu phul nas skyabs 'jug yang dag zhus pa la/rjes brtse dbyangs nas thugs dam gyi 'jug pa mdzad pa rnams ni ches mchog tu skal ba bzang ngo / /de dus rje'i sku phyogs la grwa mang gis bla ma cig bsko dgos zhus pa na/ zhas nas sku phyogs kyis nged la 301

khyod kyi 'phro'i bla ma bskos gsung ba med ces gsung / rgyud pa dpon slob mdun du yod pa la gtong sgrub dang lcags mkhar gnyis dgon pa dang bstan pa'i sku rim yin pa'i phyin chad ma chag pa byed dgos sngar nas grwa rgan rnams la yang bshad yod gsung / lcags mkhar gyi sbyin bdag dpon tshang gis byed kyin yod pas byas yod mod/ gtor sgrub ma chag pa gyis gsung ba ni rjes su bla ma yong ba gzigs pa'i gsung du 'dug go 'dor na rje 'dis chos sde chen po dga' ldan bkra shisa'akhyil gyi khrir zhabs sen nye bar bkod pa nas me 'brug lo'i bar la bsdus tshan nyer lnga blo rtags mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa rdzogs pa yang nyer lnga song / 'dzin grwa snga ma lnga tsam zhig la par phyin gyi yig cha yang tshig bzhag la rdzogs/ 'dzin grwa phal cher la skabs bzhi ba lnga ba'i bar rdzogs 'gro shing phyis su yang 'dzin grwa kha cig la phar phyin yongs rdzogs song ba de nas phar phyin gyi rgyugs ring 'bul mkhan gnyis byung ngo/ /dbu ma yang 'dzin grwa mang po la rdzogs shing /grwa rgan bcu lhag cig phyis kyi 'dzin grwa gcig la bsres nas dbu ma yongs rdzogs tshig bzhag tu btang zhing / rtsa 'jug gi rnam bshad 302

gnyis lhag mthong che chung legs bshad snying po stong thun rnams kyi dka' gnas rnams dang / gung bsgrigs pa'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis lhag par ngoms par mdzad/ 'dzin grwa de'i sems bskyed ston mo'i dus bzang la rje gdan 'dren zhus nas thams cad kyis leg sa 'bul phul/ rje'i sku phyogs nas 'dzin grwa la kha btags che legs kyi 'gyed gnang nas dgyes po mdzad/ 'dzin grwa 'di nas dbu ma'i rgyugs ring 'bul mkhan gnyis byung ngo/ /gzhan yang phar phyin yongs rdzogs tshig bzhag tu thob pa'i khrod nas phar phyin gyi rgyugs ring 'bul mkhan sngar yang 'ga' zhig byung zhing / skabs dang po'i rgyugs 'bul mkhan snga phyir mang po dang / 'dzin grwa phyi ma gcig nas bcu gnyis byung / bsdus grwa dang blo rtags rnams kyi rgyugs 'bul mkhan chad med du byung / sngar gyi grwa ba mang pos rje bzhad pa'i drangs nges rnam 'byed dang / 'grel ba don gsal gnyis kyi rgyugs phul zhing / bsam gzugs chen mo yang phul/ snga phyi'i rgyugs 'bul mkhan thams cad la gos phrug rta sogs dngos po'i gnang cha dpag med mdzad pas thams cad kyang 'ur lang gis 'dzin rgya che ru song / gling bsrel 303

la lo re bzhin po ti lnga res mo mdzad nas gnyis gnyis dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa sbrags nas ljags bshad 'byam rgyas dang / gzhan gsum sa bcad kyi sgo nas mdor bshad mdzad/ rje 'di'i thugs dam gnyugs ma'i rim pa la thun mong min pa yod dam snyam pa 'dug kyang zhal nag mi gsung bar 'dug thun mong ba ni tho rangs bzhengs te khrus mdzad nas ltung bshags tshar bdun rer sbrags pa'i phyag gnang / de nas rje gong ma'i zhal bkod dang phyag len ltar spyan 'dren khrus sku mnye mchod pa sogs cho 'phrul gyi dus ltar dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma gsung nas zhi khro'i bzlas pa gnang nas 4dpe gzigs mdzad gdugs tshod gsol nas sātstsha dang par sku mang du bzhengs/ phyag mdzod kyis nan zhus ngor skabs 'ga' zhig la 'dzam lha'i chu sbyin dang brgya rtsa gnang / de 'phral yang dpe gzigs dang ljags rtsom sogs gnang / phyi dro 'jigs byed mgon chos gnyis dang bcas pa'i gtor zhabul bskang gso rnams yang chag med du mdzad/phyis su drug cu ba yang chag med mdzad/༄ gtor sgam nang du rnam sras kyi gtor ma rgyun par 'jog gin yod 'dug pas de'i gtor 'bul 304

yang byed kyin yod par gsal lo/ /de ltar bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i mdzad ldan de nyid kyis thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa dang /bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud gtams shing mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yang rtser bzhugs nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang 'khor lo gsum gyis bya bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad cing sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdu bar phyogs pa na/ rje'i zhal nas nged snga mo rgyud la gcig song kyang da lta brjed nas ci yang mi 'char gin/ nged mtshan nyid kha rkyang la song bas thugs dam la mi sdod gsung ba'i lan du rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad kyis thal mo sbyar nas khyed grub chen nag po spyod pa yin pa'i dus su rdzogs rim pa yin na/ deng sangs khyed rdzogs rim pa ma yin par ci ltar 'gyur/ rje rang nyid ji 'dra byas bzhugs na yang nged tsho la khyad med kyang / khyed la ltos pa'i skya ser stong phrag mang po yod pa 'di rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du cis kyang thugs dam la bzhugs dgos zhes nan cher zhus pas lan du/ rjes de yin na lo gcig gi bar du nged kyi thugs dam ma grol na khyed tshos ci ltar byed 305

ces thams cad la rang dbang yod pa'i gsung byon/ rdo dus rgyud pa dpon slob bde bas mdo la yang theg chen sems bskyed kyi 'pho ba sogs thugs dam yod mod zhus pa ni/ thugs dam dang 'pho ba don gcig par dgongs pa'i gsung du snang ngo / /de dus rje'i zhal nas dbyig gnyen gyis shi ba la yang byin rlabs yod ces mdzod kyi gnas bdun pa nas thun mong gi lugs la sdom tsog bu sogs sbyangs yon gyi bag chags kyis bem po tshogs bur sdod pa yin zer ba'i lung de drangs nas de tsam zhig zhal bzhes gnang / de nas zhing 'di'i gdul bya rnams kyi don mdzad zin nas/ sku mya ngan las 'da' khar nye ba na nyin lnga thugs dam gnang nas hor zla dang po'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i skya rengs shar ba'i dus rje mya ngan las 'da' bar rtsom pa ne/ bla ma dbu mdzad pas da lta 'od gsal ma bu bsre ba'i skabs su babs zhes gsal 'debs zhus pas/ rje'i sku dkyil mo krung bcas/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad nas thugs dam la bzhugs/ zhag gsum nas thugs dam grol/ de'i tshe sprul pa'i gzugs sku rags ba'i za ma tog 'dir bzhag nas ye shes kyi sku'i 306

snang ba bde chen chos kyi dbyings su nye bar bsdus pa na me tog gi char/ pus nub tsam babs shing / ri thang thams cad kyi gos dkar gyon nas mchod pa byed pa snyam zhing / phyi rol gyi rlung gi rgyu ba 'gag te/ snod kyi 'jig rten yang mya ngan gyis rengs nas g.yo ba med la/sprin kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'ja' tshon nyin mtshan mang por bkra ba dang / nyi ma yang 'od mi gsal zhing / bya da nga ri dwags rnams kyang skad mi 'byin par 'khum mo/ /bu slob sbyin bdag sogs thams cad ni mgon med par gyur nas mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs shib smre sngags kyi cho nge la brtson pa lhur len par gyur to/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub ri'i phag la yib/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa thun rgosum mal du mnal/ /blo gsal tshogs rnams mya ngan khurnga bur zhugs/ /gzu lum spyod pa'i srin bya ci dgar spyod/ /rnam 'dren mig gi bdud rtsi gang du gshegs/ /phan dang bde ba'i lam ston gang du gshegs/ /bshad dang sgrub ba'i srog shing gang du gshe gas/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba'i mdza' bshes gang du gshegs/ /kye ma kye hudathugs rje'i bdag can des/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis bdag cag btang gyur na/ /bdag cag yongs 307

su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /phyogs dus kun las rnyed pa'i re ba lhod/ /sum rtsen bdag pos bdag cag gi/ skyabs gcig dam pa spyan drangs te/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi blobrid phyir/ /pad dkar 'thor la som nyi bral/ /yang na chos rje chos dbyings gzims pa na/ /mtha' dag 'gro 'di mgon med skyabs med zhes/ /mkha' yi bu mo bshums pa'i mchi ma'i rgyan/ /'dzin mar zags pa la ni the tshom ci/ /de nas sku gdung rin po che'i mdun du dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa dpag tu med pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu phul te/bdun phrag gnyis lhag la grwa tshang gnyis kyi grwa dpon slob thams cad kyi spyan 'dren khrus gsol dang smon lam rnams dang bstan 'bar ma rnams gsung zhing / bla ma dbu mdzad pa sogs dka' rams dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug par mdzad/ dka' rams 'dzin grwa'i gtso byas pa'i 'udzin grwa so sos gdung mdun du zhal zas rgya mtsho ma sogs phul/ zla ba gnyis ba'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin shing rta rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa la sku gdung rin po che bzhugs su gsol nas/308

dge 'dun gyis mchod rdzas dpag med thogs nas ser sprengs byas te/ dgon pa'i g.yas phyogs sa dkar yar kha la gdan drangs ste/rgyud pa dpon slob sde ba'i sku phyogs kyi gtso mdzad pa'i dge 'dun gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas zhugs la phul/ rgyud pa dpon slob sogs la 'bulab dang / dge 'dun la 'gyed phul/ bdun phrag gcig nas gdung khang zhal phye bas gdung rus shin tu dkar zhing dag la gsal ba dang / ring srel dang zhun thig mang du byon 'dug pa dang bcas pa sngar bkur ste dang bcas nas spyan drangs/ gzims khang du bzhugs pa'i mdun du bdun phrag lhag ma lnga'i bar du sngar ltar mchod pa dang / khrus gsol smon lam sogs dang / gdung mchod kyi bdun phrag bdun gyi bar la tshogs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang dbu ma 'jug pa bzang spyod rnams gsung /bdun phrag gcig la rgyud pas sger du bde mchog gsung / rje gong ma'i sku gdung dang / rgyud pa dpon slob sogs la 'bul ba dang / spyi so la dud tshang gsum dang rta nor lug sogs bzang mang bzhagadage 'dun la bogs sogs phul/ rje'i zhal bkod ltar gdung rus 309

las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi par sku re dang 'phel gdung dang zhun tig ci rigs pa'i 'gyed kyang phul/ gzims khang sngar gzhi 'dings tsam las ma grub pa 'di dus dpon pos myur du bsgrubs te phyag dpe rten gsum rnams der gdan drangs/ bla brang rnying ba nas rje gong ma'i sku dang zhal thang sogs rten 'brel mtshon byed la bzhad sos ka de nas mchod rten bzhengs pa'i dbu btsugs/ ston der grub pa la gzungs gzhug dang nang rten zhun thig rnams rje nyid kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin rab 'byams pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang rab 'byams pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho sogs kyis bgyis shing / nang du gdung rus sgam chung gang dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi par sku khri phrag du mas atams pa'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang dngul srang bdun brgya dang bcu gnyis las bskrun pa gser sogs rin po che'i phra rgyan du mas spras pa legs par grub nas/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku gdung gi g.yas phyogs su bzhugs su gsol zhing / gzims khang gsar ba dang lhan cig dge legs char 'bebs ltar rab gnas rgyas par byas dge 'dun la legs 'gyed phul/ de nas rje nyid kyis zhal 310

bzhes ji lta ba bzhin tu mchog sprul zla med pa 'khrungs tsam nas skyebo thams cad kyi yid tshim nas mthun par gleng ba/ ngos 'dzin dang lung bstan gang thad nas ches gsal po zhig byung ba spyan drangs nas da lta gdan sar 'khod de/ thugs gnyer gyi skabs lags so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos kyi khri la mnga' brnyes mchog gi longs spyod rol bas dgyes/ /chos tshul kun la dbang 'byor zab dang rgya che'i bdud rtsi 'gyed la rtag tu zhugs/ /'byam klas ting 'dzin sgo rnams 'dres min cig char 'dug cing gnas dang ldang ba mnyam/ /gcig ldang kun 'jug gnas sogs dpag dka'i rol ston bshes gnyen mchog la snying nas gus/ /rab yangs lha lam ngos na nyin byed ltar/ /bgrang yas bstan 'dzin dbus na mngon gsal zhing / /rnam mang rkang 'thung dbus na yongs 'du ltar/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog khyod rmad/ /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs ral ba'i khur 'chang zhing / /bslab gsum rim gnyis lus rtsal rab rdzogs pa/ /lung rigs snyan rgyud sbar khyim cher g.yo ba'i/ /bshes gnyen 'phrog byed bka' yi khur non pas/ /rmad byung rnam thar dad pa'i rin chen 311

snye ma ngo mtshar phreng ba legs par bstar pa'i mdzes sdug rgyan/ /rgyan mang kyis spras blo ldan rnams sad dga' ston spel phyir chos srid rna cha rtag 'chang mi yi dbang / /dbang phyug yab yum bka' yi khur lci tshangs spyod zla grogs mkhas mang gsung dang lhan gcig nyer bskul zhing / /zhing mchog mtshungs med bla ma mchog gi bka' drin dran pa'i dad pa sogs kyis mtshams sbyar mthu las grub/ /grub dbang grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba de'i/ /rnam thar rnam dag zla shel spun zla zhig /mtsho byung mtsho chen las byung 'dir skrun pas/ /rig byed rig pa'i mnga' bdag gzhan na su/ /btsani po'i dpung dang 'byor ldan nor dag dang / /tshangs dbang mthu dang sdug lus snying rus dang / skyes thob blo dang mang thos shes rab kyig /mthong min gsang ba'i sgo brgya 'dir phye gang / /mchog thun 'dod dgur 'jo ba'i yongs 'dzin zhabs/ /zolamed gtsug tu nyer bsten kho bos ni/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ngag sbyin ngag gi lhar/ /dad dang dam tshig gtsang bas tshul de rnyed/ /phra rab rdul snyed las 'das mdzad bzang gi /phra zhib pha mtha' rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /phra rags 'khor 312 /

ba'i rgya mtsho'i mthar thug par/ /phra mo'i 'phrul gyis brjod kyang rdzogs nus min/ /mang thos rnam dpyod lus stobs rab tu rgyas/ /bslab gsum gser sbyangs dra bas mdzes par spud/ /dam pa'i tog bzang spyi bo'i rgyan ldan pa'i/ /bshes gnyen bsod nams rgya mtshos dngos bstsal rnams/ /tshig gi sbyor bas ha cang bcings min la/ /grong tshig 'gal dum phreng ba rgyang dor nas/ /rgya che'i dpag dka'i rnam thar bgrangs yas lam/ /cha shas tsam zhig skal bzang bgo skal bgyis/ /'dir 'bad rnam dkar gangs ri las 'ong rgyun/ /sngon bsags chu klung stong dang chabs gcig tu/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub rin chen gter/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par shog /bdag cag deng nas khyod kyis rjes bzung ste/ /theg chen srog shing thabs shes zung 'brel dang / /rlabs chen spyod pa'i gzhir gyur rim gnyis kyi/ /lam bzang 'dzin zhing spel la zla bral shog /theg mchog bshes khyod bdag cag sgo gsum dang / /dad dang dam tshig mchog gis dus kun tu/ /mnyes byas gsung gi bdud rtsi rtag spyod cing / /yongs 'dzin 'phrin las spel la nyid mtshungs shog 313

ces chos kyi rje mtshungs pa med pa snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i srog shing gcig pu mtshan brjod par dka' ba 'jam dbyangs bla ma ngag dbang bkra shis dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i snye ma ngo mtshar phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje 'jem dbyangs bzhad pa'i dpon rgyud du 'khrungs shing sku'i rim gro'i sgo nas de nyid mnyes bar mdzad pa'i kun dga' bo gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma yab sras las mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med du myang pa'i thugs sras/ lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyud pa dpon slob 'jam dbyangs dpal pa'i sku phyogs nas kha btags gos yug dang bcas pa'i gsung spyi bor phebs pa dang / gnam bskos sa'i tshangs pa dpon ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug dang / lugs gnyis la mkhyen dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i dpon mo er khe shar rnam gnyis kyi bka' yi me tog rin chen suwarṇa dang zho snying sogs kyi — gnang cha bzang po dang bcas bstsal ba dang / gzhan yang rje btsun de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing gsung las skyes pa mdo sngags yongs rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ gang de'i 314

lugaso bzang spel ba la rings par chas pa'i grogs rdo rje 'dzin pa du ma'i gsung gis bskul zhing / rang nyid kyi dad pas kyang mtshams sbyar te/ rje nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba la 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa mchog tu dge ba yongs 'dzin dam pa —bsod nams rgya mtsho la rjes dngos su bstsal ba dang / shog dril la gzhi byas/ grwa rgan 'ga' zhig gi zhal 'gros kyis brgyan nas rje bla ma'i bka' drin gyis bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i snyom las pa blo bzang don 'grub kyis rnam byung zhes pa sa 'brug gi lo'i nag pas nya la dbu btsugs sa gas nya la mjug rdzogs par rtse gzhung yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i/ yi ge ba ni rje'i dngos slob dad brtson rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i dka' bcu blo bzang bsam 'phel lo/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /rje btsun bla ma'i rnam par thar ba 'di/ /ching wang mdun 'don dar mkhan dge slong dang / /rta mgrin tshe ring yi ge'i rig byed 315

mkhas/ /dag byed 'jam dbyangs gnas brtan 'phrin las zung / /ngag dbang grags pa'i thabs mang 'tshams sbyar te/ /ska gsar spar brko mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrubs/ /'dir 'bad legs spyad rab 'byams dge tshogs dang / /gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu las 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mi yi gar mdzad blo bzang grags pa gi /dri med ring lugs phyogs dus thams cad du/ /'gro kun dpal du rtag tu 'bar gyur cig /'di'i ched 'bad bgyis kun kyang gnas skabs su/ /mi mthun nyer 'che'i tshogs zhi tshe bsod rgyas/ /yang srid kun tu mtshan ldan bla ma mchog /dgyes bzhin legs gsung bdud rtsis tshim byas nas/ /mthar thug sku gsum don gnyis myur 'grub shog /smras pa/ dpag med bskal ba'i sngon du sangs rgyas kyang / /thun mong snang ngor chu nang zla ris bzhin/ /zhing 'dir ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rnam rol ba/ /spaba'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs bla ma gi /rmad byung rnam par gtsang ma'i pusti ka /par du bsgrub pa'i yig 'dri blo ldan dang / /spar brko mkhan dang mthun rkyen sgrub rnams kyis/ /tshul 'dir 'bad stsol bgyis pa'i dge 'dis mtshon/ /dus gsum legs 316
